name: ACCOUNT
description: For financial services, this entity is used for accounts that are external to the enterprise such as accounts payable payment accounts, and external standing order accounts. There is a one to zero/one relationship between AGREEMENT and ACCOUNT. For external accounts the enterprise only knows about t

name: ACCOUNTING_CALENDAR_TYPE
description: This entity supports all types of accounting or fiscal calendars as required by the enterprise.

name: ACCOUNTING_CURRENCY
description: This entity tracks the changes to the Internal Accounting Currency (IAC) over time. For example, if the country is Germany, then the internal accounting currency could be marks. There is one instance for marks. When the change is made to go to the Euro as the IAC then there is an instance for Euro.

name: ACCOUNTING_TYPE
description: This minor entity specifies the type of accounting currency such as global or local currency.

name: ACCOUNTS_PAYABLE
description: The entity that provides details of ACCOUNTS PAYABLE for a company. ACCOUNTS PAYABLE records how much a company owes suppliers for the purchase of supplies or services on credit.

name: ACCOUNTS_RECEIVABLE
description: The entity that provides details for the ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE accounts. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE is the payment a company expects to collect from a PARTY, generally from a completed transaction of sales or services rendered. ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE accounts are types of current assets.

name: ACCOUNT_INVOLVEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This is a subtype discriminator that indicates whether the enterprise is one of the parties to the account. "Internal" indicates the enterprise is a party to the account, and "external" indicates that the enterprise is not a party to the account.

name: ACCOUNT_METRIC
description: This entity contains any kind of metric applicable to this account over time such as current monetary balance, current point balance, and current past due balance amount. This entity can track any kind of metric over time.

name: ACCOUNT_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of metric such as current monetary balance, current point balance, and current past due balance amount.

name: ACCOUNT_PURPOSE_SUBTYPE
description: This is a subtype discriminator based on the purpose of the account such as a transaction account or a loyalty account.

name: ACCOUNT_RENEWAL
description: This entity tracks history information regarding account renewal start and end dates for renewable accounts. Each instance is one renewal period including the original or first period.

name: ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: This is a classification of the account.

name: ACCRUED_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the accrued liabilities. Accrued liabilities recognize expenses incurred during the accounting period but not yet paid.

name: AFFILIATE_PRODUCT_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the financial institution and a company to provide financial products to that company's employees at a discount.

name: AGENCY_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This is the credit report containing data elements specific to an agency such as Experian, Equifax, and Trans-Union. It can also include information from other reports such as Dunn & Bradstreet, Moody's, and Standard & Poor's.  The attributes in this entity will vary by reporting agency. A few attri

name: AGENT_BROKER_AGREEMENT_DETAIL
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY AGREEMENT and defines additional information for the combination of party and agreement when the role code indicates an agent or a broker relation.

name: AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about arrangements between two or more parties where there are terms and conditions. It includes legally binding contracts and arrangements that are not legally binding.

name: AGREEMENT_ABUSE
description: This entity tracks abuses, such as first party fraud, second party fraud, or kiting that occur against an account over time. 'Kiting' is taking advantage of float. 'Float' is the time between the deposit of the check in a bank and payment.

name: AGREEMENT_ACCESS_DEVICE
description: This entity relates an ACCESS DEVICE such as a credit or debit card to an account. An account can have many devices associated with it (e.g., one each for husband and wife) and a device can be used with many accounts (e.g., savings and checking). If a noncustomer used a channel such as an ATM, then

name: AGREEMENT_ACCESS_DEVICE_FEATURE
description: This entity identifies the conditions (features) that are valid for this ACCESS DEVICE for this account.  Examples of conditions are: - Card can only be used for types of purchase types explicitly stated (e.g., supplies) - Card is temporary and will expire in 90 days  The standard yearly fee of $20

name: AGREEMENT_ACCESS_DEVICE_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the relation between AGREEMENT and ACCESS DEVICE such as 'is primary card for' or 'is secondary card for.'

name: AGREEMENT_AGREEMENT_CLASS_XREF
description: This entity provides for an AGREEMENT to be classified many ways. The classification scheme and classification value together will identity the specific classification.  The business rule says that for a given classification scheme an agreement has only one value at one point-in-time (that is why th

name: AGREEMENT_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This associative entity relates agreements with the agreement group.

name: AGREEMENT_AGREEMENT_GROUP_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the reason why the agreement is related to this group of agreements.  Examples: - The agreement is part of this securitization pool, - The securitization agreement resulted in this pool.

name: AGREEMENT_APPLICATION
description: This entity identifies relationships between agreements and applications.

name: AGREEMENT_APPLICATION_ROLE
description: This minor entity describes the relationship between an agreement and an application.  Examples: - Agreement created from application - Agreement supplemented by application - Agreement is collateral of application

name: AGREEMENT_ASSET
description: This associative entity relates agreement to an asset along with the role that the asset has with the agreement. An example of a role of an asset to an agreement is a collateral role.

name: AGREEMENT_ASSET_ROLE_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity contains the role of the asset to the contract and is used as a subtype code. Roles can include is collateral for, is insured asset for, or is subject of a lease.

name: AGREEMENT_BALANCE_TYPE_METRIC
description: This entity contains summary agreement metrics at the end of a time period (the time period to be determined by each financial institution using this model) for a particular balance category. Even though the information is technically derivable from events and should not be in a logical model, it is

name: AGREEMENT_CASE
description: This entity relates a case to an agreement and allows a case to span agreements and an agreement to have many cases.

name: AGREEMENT_CHANNEL
description: This associative entity identifies the various roles that a channel plays with a specific account. Roles include 'belongs to,' or 'is managed by.'

name: AGREEMENT_CHANNEL_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the role that the channel plays with the agreement.  Examples: - Belongs to - Is managed by - Was acquisition channel for - Is most used

name: AGREEMENT_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the channel types related to this agreement with a role such as: - Is managed by - Was acquisition channel for - Is most used - Is preferred

name: AGREEMENT_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS
description: Over time an agreement that is an asset or liability account can relate to more than one chart of accounts number. For example, a loan account may be, at one point-in-time, active and another point-in-time it could be in write-off status.

name: AGREEMENT_CLAIM
description: This associative entity relates claims to the insurance account the claim is reported against.

name: AGREEMENT_CLAIM_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This entity describes the relationship between an agreement and a claim.  Examples: - Policy of the party that caused the claim - Policy of the party that is making the claim - Group policy of claim - Individual policy of claim

name: AGREEMENT_CLASS_ADJUSTMENT_PARAMETER
description: This entity contains the adjustment rates to be applied to this classification of agreements when determining the value of the exposure for this agreement. These are often referred to as "haircuts" within risk management.

name: AGREEMENT_CLASS_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains the risk grades for a given classification of agreements for a given period of time.  Examples of classifications include mortgages, commercial real estate loans, derivatives, personal loans, and purchased receivable debt.

name: AGREEMENT_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the schemes for classifying agreements. Examples of schemes include tax purposes, Basel 1 purposes, Basel II purposes, and marketing purposes.  The hierarchy in this structure allows you to roll up a classification into another classification. For example, a swap agreemen

name: AGREEMENT_CLASS_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are classifications of agreements. There is one instance for each agreement classification such as insurance policies that have been in force for over one year.

name: AGREEMENT_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme, these codes represent the various values for that scheme. For example, for tax reporting purposes the possible values may be individual, joint, or corporate. For Basel II purposes the possible values could be corporate/sovereign/bank, retail, equity, purchased rece

name: AGREEMENT_COLLATERAL_ITEM
description: This entity contains those assets used as collateral where the assets are customer deposits or investment holdings held with your institution that are pledged as collateral. More than one agreement could be bundled into a collateral item.

name: AGREEMENT_COLLECTION_STATUS
description: This entity keeps track of the collection status for an account that is past due and considered to be in collections. There is one instance for each type of amount (e.g., principal or interest) and for each past due type (e.g., 30, 60, or 90 days) and when that money became associated with that past

name: AGREEMENT_COST
description: This entity tracks the changes to the cost of an agreement over time. Agreement costs are those costs allocated to each agreement such as facilities, data processing, product advertisement, underwriting, collections, customer service, or closing agreements.

name: AGREEMENT_COVERAGE_EVENT
description: This entity contains those events that are related to agreement coverage for each insurable interest.

name: AGREEMENT_COVERAGE_EVENT_BASE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the basis of the policy coverage event.  Examples: - 1 = direct - 2 = assumed - 3 = ceded

name: AGREEMENT_COVERAGE_EVENT_CATEGORY
description: This minor entity identifies the policy coverage transaction category.  Examples: - 1 = billed - 2 = received - 3 = cancelation - 4 = retro/contingent - 5 = other adjustment

name: AGREEMENT_COVERAGE_EVENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the types of policy coverage transactions.  Examples: - 1 = premium - 2 = fee - 3 = commission - 4 = underwriting expense - 5 = taxes

name: AGREEMENT_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This links an agreement to a credit report that is run to determine the potential health of this agreement in light of the obligor's other obligations and credit standing.

name: AGREEMENT_CREDIT_RISK_TYPE_METRIC
description: This entity tracks the values of risk metrics for a given agreement/exposure as of a certain risk calculation date for a given type of risk metric. This entity can be used instead of AGREEMENT RISK METRIC, which gives the specific attributes.  Possible risk type values are:  1 – Basel 1 Acct Exposur

name: AGREEMENT_CURRENCY
description: This entity tracks changes to the account level currency over time. There is one instance for each account number, currency code, currency use, and date combination.

name: AGREEMENT_DATE
description: This is a generic structure to contain the many possible dates associated with an agreement and tracks the changes to those dates. Examples of dates include due date, last payment date, processing date, original funding date and many more.

name: AGREEMENT_DATE_TYPE
description: This code describes the type of date for agreements such as due date, last payment date, first payment date, processing date, approval date, funded date and more.

name: AGREEMENT_DIRECT_EXPENSE
description: This entity contains the direct expense amounts for a given agreement for a given unit cost type (e.g., standard versus actual). This entity allows for many types of unit cost and direct expense calculations. There is one table for each profit cycle.

name: AGREEMENT_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates documents with agreements such as financial reports, copies of identification documents, and copies of executor authority.

name: AGREEMENT_EVENT
description: This entity is a subtype to EVENT and contains only those events that involve agreements.

name: AGREEMENT_EVENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity is a category discriminator for events that involve an account. If the event involves the posting of money to the account then it is a FINANCIAL AGREEMENT EVENT. If it involves a card (e.g., insurance card, and reward points) then this is an ACCESS DEVICE EVENT.

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE
description: This entity associates the agreement with features that are specific to the agreement. Examples could be to defer interest charges until account closes, or mail interest to account holder. This would include all agreement level features.  This entity also includes the possibility of one feature repl

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_GROUP
description: This entity relates agreements to group of features.  Example: - Features can be grouped into tiers, and the agreement is related to the tier feature group. This is useful for deposit term agreements where the agreement is for Tier 1, which represents minimum balance of $10,000 for 5 years with a se

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_GROUP_ROLE
description: The role that this feature group has with this agreement.  Examples: - Is included - Is excluded

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_METRIC
description: This entity tracks the "sub-balance" over time for a given account feature metric.  This is especially useful for credit card companies where a balance can be divided into portions (balance segments) and the amount of that balance needs to be tracked over time.

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_METRIC_TYPE
description: This entity contains the various metrics that are reported about this account feature at a point-in-time.  Examples of metrics include principal balance owed and interest balance owed.

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_RELATED
description: This associative entity allows for an override of a subfeature by another subfeature or the override of subfeature metrics at the agreement level.  Examples of subfeatures include: - A credit card agreement has a card (feature), which has an annual card fee (subfeature), which is overridden by a des

name: AGREEMENT_FEATURE_ROLE_TYPE
description: The relationship of the feature to account related subjects; account, application, quotation:  Examples: - Negotiated override standard product feature - Non-negotiated override of standard product feature - Underwriting exception

name: AGREEMENT_FINANCIAL_RULE
description: This entity relates a financial rule to a specific agreement to identify a rule that governs this agreement.

name: AGREEMENT_FORMAT_TYPE
description: This classifies the agreement as written, verbal or other format. You can also use this to distinguish signed in person contracts or electronically signed contracts.

name: AGREEMENT_FUNDING_SOURCE
description: This entity identifies the third-party source of funding of various amounts for an agreement such as deposit monies and loan down payment monies. This entity allows for more than one source for a given amount.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This entity represents a grouping of agreements. For example, a group could be a securitized package of loan accounts or a "tranche." Agreement groups can also be used internally by the Financial Institutions for account analysis and reporting purposes. An agreement group can also be considered a "s

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_BALANCE
description: This entity contains derived balance information at the AGREEMENT GROUP level over time. It could be derived from the individual agreements that make up the group. The balance is in the currency of the books.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS
description: Accounts may be grouped into portfolios and then that portfolio is related to a GL account number. For example, for a given portfolio a bank may set aside money for loan loss provisions. These are general provisions (at the portfolio level) versus specific provisions, which are at the account level.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_CRITERION
description: This entity identifies the criterion that can be used to group agreements together, such as balance > 3000 or delinquent more than 120 days.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_EVENT
description: This entity is a subtype entity of EVENT and is directly related to one agreement group.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_FEATURE
description: This entity contains the terms and conditions for this group of agreements. For example, if agreements are grouped into "tranches" for securitization, that tranche may have some conditions such as duration and rate. This allows for that possibility.  Another example of features related to agreement

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_FEATURE_ROLE
description: The role of this feature to this agreement group.  For example, if the feature is used as selection criteria and if one feature is the beginning value of a time band and another feature is the ending value of the time band and a third feature is the currency then the role indicates: - Beginning band

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_LIMIT
description: This entity tracks the limit for groups of accounts over time. Examples of types of limits include "gross limit" (sum of debit balances only) and "net limit" (includes credit balances). Used by Basel II for on balance sheet netting arrangements.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics for a grouping of agreements.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of metric that measures one account group compared to another account group or that measures a group.  For example, for asset liability management, one of the metrics might be duration gap, which is the difference between the duration of an asset portfolio (account group) and a l

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason for the grouping of accounts such as for securitization or risk retail pooling, and market risk banding.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RELATED
description: This entity relates agreement groups to other agreement groups.  For market risk, one group of agreements can be used as a hedge against another group of agreements.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RELATED_METRIC
description: This entity keeps track of metrics of the relationship of one group of accounts to another.  For example, for asset liability management, one of the metrics might be duration gap, which is the difference between the duration of an asset portfolio (account group) and the duration of a liability portf

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RELATED_ROLE
description: This entity identifies the reasons why one group of agreements is related to another group of agreements. Possible values include one group hedges another group, and market risk.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RISK
description: This entity contains various calculations at the AGREEMENT GROUP level over time for the purposes of determining risk. name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains the risk grade at the agreement group level. This entity contains both externally provided and internally calculated risk grades.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_RISK_TYPE_METRIC
description: This entity is used for metrics associated with groups of agreements or financial instruments for credit risk and market risk.  ================  For credit risk: This entity contains a history of various risk metrics over time for a given group of exposures. The metrics are usually an amount, a cou

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_SCORE
description: This entity contains a score associated with this group of agreements for this scoring model (e.g., probability of default).

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are groupings of agreements. There is one instance for each agreement grouping such as all insurance policies written by a certain agent.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_TEXT
description: This entity contains free-form text information about a group of agreements.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_TYPE
description: A code for the type of group such as a securitization group where a group of exposures are sold to a third party, or a group of exposures that share some characteristics such as past due 90 days, and high credit risk.

name: AGREEMENT_GROUP_TYPE_XREF
description: This entity contains the many ways to classify an agreement group. An agreement group can be classified as securitized, part of a risk pool, and whether it can be deducted from capital on the balance sheet. For insurance policies may be grouped into ring-fenced funds.

name: AGREEMENT_HOLDER
description: This entity is a placeholder for the parties who are legally bound by the terms of the agreement - the customer. They could be the named insured for an insurance policy or the account holder in a banking agreement.  This entity is in the model to show completeness and may be removed.

name: AGREEMENT_ID_TYPE_JAPAN
description: Indicates whether when the account matures if the rate goes to the liquid rate or to the new term rate.

name: AGREEMENT_INDIRECT_EXPENSE
description: This entity contains the indirect expense amounts for a given account. This is an entity because there can be many indirect expense amounts – one for each version/view. There is one table for each profit cycle.

name: AGREEMENT_INSURANCE_RISK_CATEGORY
description: This associative entity tracks the combination of agreement and risk category over time.

name: AGREEMENT_INSURED_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to AGREEMENT ASSET and contains details of the customer asset in relation to the agreement or policy in the role of being insured by.

name: AGREEMENT_INSURED_ASSET_COST
description: This entity contains the information on the costs incurred by the combination of the asset and account, such as estimation costs.

name: AGREEMENT_INSURED_ASSET_FEATURE
description: This entity associates assets that are insured by a specific policy to the product features that apply to that insured asset. name: AGREEMENT_INSURED_ASSET_FEATURE_RELATED
description: This entity associates subfeatures (e.g., limit and deductible) to the coverage features that apply to an insured asset for a specific policy. For example, a limit of $500 may apply to the property damage coverage. The limit amount and the coverage are each separate features.

name: AGREEMENT_INVESTOR
description: In a banking Securitization Agreement or Reinsurance Agreement, one party sells the risk (or part of the risk) and another party buys the risk. This is the party that bought the risk or has assumed the exposure in some manner. This may or may not be your enterprise.  This is a subtype entity to the

name: AGREEMENT_IVR_STEP_TRANSACTION
description: This links the agreement to the IVR step transaction.

name: AGREEMENT_LEASING_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to AGREEMENT ASSET and contains details of the customer asset in relation to the account in the role of being leased.

name: AGREEMENT_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity keeps track of the legal history applicable to an account.

name: AGREEMENT_LIMIT
description: This entity tracks the changes to an agreement's limit over time. There is one instance for each agreement-limit change date combination.

name: AGREEMENT_LIMIT_METRIC
description: This entity keeps track of metrics for limits that are related to agreements such as the approved limit amount, the amount used or the amount on hold.

name: AGREEMENT_LIMIT_RELATED
description: This entity relates one limit approval to another limit approval along with the reason for the relationship such as overrides or replaces.

name: AGREEMENT_MARKET_RISK_FACTOR
description: This entity contains the factors that affect the price sensitivity of this agreement to market factors. For holdings, there is one investment agreement for each holding.  For example, an option's price can be influenced by the price sensitivity of the underlying instrument, by the time to expiration

name: AGREEMENT_MARKET_RISK_TYPE
description: This entity tracks the interim and final metrics when calculating market risk for a given agreement. These agreements can be either in the banking book or the trading book.  This entity can be used as a generic way of capturing any market risk metrics at the agreement/account level.

name: AGREEMENT_METRIC
description: This entity contains derived metrics at the agreement level for a given point-in-time or time period. If it is a point-in-time then the start and end dates are the same. Examples of metrics include point-in-time cleared balance, number of withdrawal transactions for a month and reward points.  For i

name: AGREEMENT_METRIC_PROJECTION
description: This entity contains a projection of metrics for this agreement.

name: AGREEMENT_METRIC_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the types of account metric. name: AGREEMENT_OBJECTIVE_TYPE
description: This minor entity contains the objective for this agreement or quotation. For example, for a loan it might be for education, home improvement, and pension.

name: AGREEMENT_OBTAINED_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes how the agreement was obtained such as existing agreement, and promotion.

name: AGREEMENT_PAYMENT_OPTION
description: This entity defines the payment amount that is due each period for this account. The customer may be given several choices of payment types such as for a loan – minimum payment due, 15-year payment due, 30-year payment due. This is commonly used for fixed price real estate loans where the payer has

description: This entity associates an agreement with a customer portfolio. The financial institution receives

name: AGREEMENT_PORTFOLIO_EVENT
description: This entity contains those events that affect an agreement/portfolio combination such as an investment holding within a portfolio within an agreement/account.

name: AGREEMENT_PORTFOLIO_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This entity translates the code into a description.  Examples of relations between agreements and portfolios are: - Agreement is contract for investment services - Agreement is for paying investment purchases - Agreement is for receiving dividends and interest - Agreement is for receiving dividends

name: AGREEMENT_PRIVACY_PREFERENCE
description: A customer's privacy preferences for the collection and use of personal data at the agreement level.

name: AGREEMENT_PRODUCT
description: This entity tracks the products associated with an AGREEMENT at one point-in-time and over time.  In banking, it is possible for an account to be associated with more than one product over time, but with only one product at any given time. An example of this is the account may be a certificate of de

name: AGREEMENT_PRODUCT_FEATURE
description: This entity tracks terms and conditions at the level of product for an agreement.

name: AGREEMENT_PRODUCT_FEATURE_RELATED
description: This entity contains features that can describe/override other features that are related to a product for an agreement.  For example, if an insurance policy is for more than one insurance product then this could be the limit for a coverage for a given product for a given policy.

name: AGREEMENT_PRODUCT_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the role that this product has with this agreement:  Examples: - Is offered product (e.g., stock option), - Is primary purpose of agreement (insurance policy, deposit, swap investment) - Is underlying financial instrument (Teradata stock, U.S. dollars) - Is a product that

name: AGREEMENT_PROFIT
description: This entity tracks the changes to an agreement's profitability over time. This entity has the agreement profitability that is calculated outside of this system. name: AGREEMENT_PROFIT_COMPONENT
description: This entity contains the final profit numbers for this account along with the amounts for other components that make up the profit number such as net interest revenue, other revenue, cost/value of funds, and economic value add.

name: AGREEMENT_PROJECT
description: This entity relates agreements with projects such as a loan to fund a project for a customer.

name: AGREEMENT_PROJECT_ROLE
description: This entity describes the role the project has with the agreement such as is the subject or a loan (when the loan funds the project for a customer).

name: AGREEMENT_PROMOTION_OFFER
description: This associative entity tracks offers targeted to specific accounts for a given promotion.

name: AGREEMENT_PROMOTION_OFFER_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the various roles that how an account relates to the promotion offer, for example, targets account and created account.

name: AGREEMENT_PROVISION
description: This entity tracks the amount of provision allocated to this agreement over time. This would normally be specific provision as opposed to general provision. name: AGREEMENT_QUOTATION_ROLE
description: This minor entity identifies the role that accounts have with insurance quotations. Possible roles include 'is subaccount for,' and 'was converted from.'

name: AGREEMENT_RATE
description: This entity contains rate for this account, for this time period, for this "as of date" and for this type of rate. description: This entity identifies relationships between agreements and identifies the type of relationship. An example would agreements that are linked

name: AGREEMENT_RELATED_REASON
description: This minor entity describes the type of relationship between two agreements such as one agreement replaces another agreement, one agreement is a subset of another agreement, and one agreement is an amendment to another agreement.

name: AGREEMENT_REMEDIATION_PLAN
description: If an agreement looks like it is going into default or indications are that it is in trouble of meeting the terms of the agreement then this entity contains the plans to mitigate the risk of this agreement going into default. name: AGREEMENT_REMEDIATION_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of the remediation plan.  Examples: - Remediation plan established - Remediation plan in process - Remediation plan was able to prevent default - Remediation plan had no effect

name: AGREEMENT_RENEWAL
description: This entity tracks actual history information regarding agreement renewal start and end date for renewable contracts. name: AGREEMENT_REVENUE
description: This entity contains the direct and indirect revenue allocated to an agreement.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains the risk grade assignment for this account for this date for this type of grading.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_GRADE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one risk grade assessment to another risk grade assessment to identify when one risk assessment replaces or overrides another risk assessment for an account. Risk assessments done by different methods or parties can result in different assessments.  This structure allows for one

description: This entity contains various calculations and credit risk related metrics at the account/exposure level over time for the purposes of determining risk. name: AGREEMENT_RISK_METRIC_INTERNAL_INVESTMENT
description: This entity tracks credit risk metrics for internal investments, which are investments in security instruments held by your enterprise where there may be some credit risk involved.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_METRIC_OFF_BALANCE_SHEET
description: This entity tracks credit risk metrics for off balance sheet exposures.  Some facilities may be included in this scope.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_METRIC_OTC_DERIVATIVE
description: This entity tracks credit risk metrics for over-the-counter derivative exposures.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_METRIC_PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE
description: This entity tracks credit risk metrics for purchased receivable exposures.

name: AGREEMENT_RISK_METRIC_SECURITIZATION
description: This entity tracks credit risk metrics for securitization exposures.

name: AGREEMENT_SCORE

There is one instance for each valuation of the asset as it relates to this exposure. The adjustments are due to haircuts to the value of the asset.

description: This entity contains adjustments to the value of the asset as it relates to the exposure being covered for various reasons including Basel II "haircuts." name: EXPOSURE_AGREEMENT_COLLATERAL_ITEM
description: This entity relates the agreement that creates an exposure (e.g., loan) to the asset that is covering the exposure (e.g., real estate or a customer account). description: This is a subtype to entity AGREEMENT RELATED and contains details of the relationship between agreements that have an exposure (e.g., loan agreement) and agreements that mitigate risk (e.g., collateral, third-party guarantees, and internal accounts such as deposits or investments).

name: EXTERNAL_ACCOUNT
description: This is an account between two third parties where the enterprise is not an active party (either on the debit or credit side) or is not a signatory on the account agreement.

name: EXTERNAL_AGREEMENT
description: This entity identifies agreements where your institution is not a party to the agreement but has an interest in knowing information about that agreement.  This may be of interest for mortgages to understand the fire and earthquake insurance for the structure being mortgaged.  It is also if interest

name: EXTERNAL_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the other insurance type code into a description. Examples are external collateral agreement where another bank has claim to an asset, and external insurance policy of dental, health, property and casualty, or life.

name: EXTERNAL_MARGIN_AGREEMENT
description: This is a margin agreement where your enterprise holds a margin brokerage account with another institution that is a broker. description: A facility is an umbrella agreement that sets the broad terms and conditions of 'subagreements' that are linked to it.  For example, commercial bill is an agreement that has a limit. name: FACILITY_OPERATING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to facilities. Facility expenses are related to the maintenance of a physical facility.

name: FINANCE_EXPOSURE_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about those agreements that have some credit risk (exposure) associated with it. name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains those agreements where your enterprise is performing a banking function and offering a banking service to your customers. description: This entity contains adjustments to the value of the exposure or the value of the risk mitigation as a result of volatility of the underlying financial instrument. These are referred to as "haircuts." It also contains any metrics that were used to calculate the haircuts for this exposure such as the

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_BASEL_II_APPROACH
description: This entity contains the Basel II approach that is assigned at this point-in-time to this agreement for this type of risk (e.g., credit risk, operational risk, and market risk).

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_EVENT
description: This is a subtype entity to EVENT and includes those events that involve both agreements and money. Examples are deposit, withdrawal, payment, and interest payment. This entity also includes the requests for authorization and for settlement where the amounts are specified on the requests.  If the fi

description: This entity contains information that is specific to the Value Family application used in Japan. It contains various codes that direct the processing and calculation for profitability for a given account.

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_PASSBOOK
description: This entity allows an agreement to have more than one passbook over time.

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity is used as a category discriminator for financial agreements.  Examples: - Investment agreements - Credit agreements - Cash management agreements - Other financial services agreements  There are many other types of accounts that are included in the domain of financial agreements that are

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the classification of this financial agreement into major relevant classes such as: - Mortgage loan - Credit card - Term loan - Checking/saving - Time deposit - Internal investment - Foreign exchange agreement - Derivative agreement - Financial services agreement - Purchase

name: FINANCIAL_AGREEMENT_TYPE_JAPAN
description: Identifies whether this agreement is cash at other banks, cash from central bank or a customer term deposit.

name: FIXED_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the types of fixed asset accounts. Fixed assets are long-term, tangible property not expected to be converted to cash in the current fiscal year. Examples are manufacturing equipment, real estate, and furniture.

name: FIXED_ASSET_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that identifies the type of FIXED ASSET ACCOUNT like DEPRECIABLE ASSET ACCOUNT or NONDEPRECIABLE ASSET ACCOUNT.

name: FOREIGN_CURRENCY_ADJUSTMENT_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies a NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT as a foreign currency adjustment. Foreign currency adjustments are the gains or losses resulting from a translation of one currency into another.

name: FOREIGN_EXCHANGE_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains those agreements for spot foreign exchange between two parties. Your bank may or may not be the buyer or seller but may be the broker to the deal. The role that your institution and any other party play with this deal is found in PARTY AGREEMENT (e.g., buyer versus seller versus

name: FORWARD_CONTRACT
description: This entity contains information about the holding of a forward contract. This is in contrast to a spot contract, which is a

name: FORWARD_RATE_AGREEMENT
description: Forward Rate Agreement (FRA) allows the purchasers and sellers to fix the interest rate on a certain principal for a specified period in advance. They are similar to Eurocurrency Futures contracts but can be customized for any maturity. One party pays fixed, the other an agreed upon floating rate. F

name: FUTURES_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains the details about holdings in future contracts.  A futures is a contract to purchase or sell a given amount of an item for a given price by a certain date in the future. It is a deal made now to take place in the future. The seller of a futures contract agrees to deliver the ite

name: FUTURES_CONTRACT_PRODUCT
description: A standardized traded contract traded on a futures exchange, to buy or sell a certain underlying instrument at a certain date in the future, at a specified price. The future date is called the delivery date or final settlement date. The preset price is called the futures price. The price of the unde

name: FX_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies a foreign exchange agreement as to the method the exchange is accomplished. name: GENERAL_AND_ADMINISTRATIVE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to general and administrative. These expenses are typically classified as administrative in nature, for example, advertising, salaries, commissions, and office expense.

name: GL_ACCOUNT_COA_CODE_SEGMENT
description: This entity provides an association between a GL MAIN ACCOUNT and subtypes of COA CODE SEGMENT for the purpose of financial reporting. For example, a product segment could be associated to a specific GL MAIN ACCOUNT to report the product revenue on an income statement. Not all segments relate to a G

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates accounts used in financial transactions for a company. This includes both the general ledger and subsidiary ledger transactions.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_CATEGORY
description: This entity categorizes GL MAIN ACCOUNTs according to the type of financial reporting related components it contains, for example, balance sheet or income statement.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_CLASS_VALUE
description: This is a code for the value within the scheme. For example, if the scheme is Basel III classification for an asset that is a high-quality liquid asset for purposes of calculating the liquidity coverage ratio then this value could be cash.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_CLASS_XREF
description: This entity relates a GL main account to a classification scheme value. For example, it would classify a GL account as cash for the purposes of Basel III calculation of liquidity coverage ratio.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This is a classification scheme for the GL main account. An example is Basel III classifies certain assets as a "high-quality liquid asset" when calculating the liquidity coverage ratio (LCR). The scheme would be "Basel III classification scheme for high quality liquid assets."

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_SEGMENT
description: The entity that indicates the GL MAIN ACCOUNT SEGMENT of the accounts used in financial reporting for a company. Selling expense is an example of a GL MAIN ACCOUNT.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_SET_OF_BOOKS_XREF
description: This associative entity links GL MAIN ACCOUNT to SET OF BOOKS for this date.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a GL main account over time. An account can be suspended and then lifted.

name: GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity tracks the status of the GL main account. An account can be suspended and then later the suspension could be lifted.

name: GL_SUBACCOUNT_SEGMENT
description: The entity that indicates the subaccounts used in financial reporting for a company.

name: GOODWILL_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for goodwill. These details could include the cost differential between the acquisition cost of a business and the market value of the asset acquired.

name: GUARANTEE_CRITERIA_TYPE
description: Code to define the criteria for the types of guarantors a financial institution will recognize for regulatory capital purposes such as certified check, personal guarantee, government mortgage, government paper, letter of credit, maintenance bond, performance bond, rate lock, and signature guarantee.

name: HOME_EQUITY_LINE_OF_CREDIT_AGREEMENT
description: A home equity line of credit is a form of revolving credit in which a house serves as collateral. name: IBAN_AGREEMENT_IDENTIFIER
description: This entity contains the IBAN associated with the account.  The International Bank Agreement Number (IBAN) is an international standard for numbering bank accounts. It was originally adopted by the European Committee for Banking Standards, and was later adopted as ISO 13616:1997 and now as ISO 13616

name: INCOME_STATEMENT_GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates a general ledger account is in the income statement reporting category. Types of this category include expense, and revenue accounts.

name: INCOME_STATEMENT_GL_MAIN_ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: This entity indicates the types of general ledger accounts that are on the Income Statement financial statement. Examples are revenue account and expense account.

name: INCOME_TAX_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides the expense details for the income taxes.

name: INCOME_TAX_PAYABLE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the income taxes. Income taxes are the amount due to taxing authorities.

name: INFORMATION_RELEASE_TYPE
description: Indicates whether the provider has received permission for release of medical data. name: INSURANCE_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about all insurance related contracts, such as insurance policies.  This is a subtype entity to AGREEMENT.

name: INSURANCE_AGREEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: A subtype category discriminator that classifies the type of insurance agreement.  Examples: - Insurance policy – individual - Insurance policy – group - insurance policy – group member - Reinsurance agreement (buy or sell)

name: INSURANCE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: Classifies this agreement as an insurance policy, a reinsurance agreement, or other kind agreement.

name: INTANGIBLE_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the other asset is intangible. Types of intangible assets are patents and goodwill. These assets have no physical existence, such as a brand, franchise, trademark, or patent; yet have a substantial value to the company.

name: INTANGIBLE_ASSET_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of an intangible asset account, for example, patent or goodwill.

name: INTEREST_BASED_AGREEMENT
description: These are agreements where the pricing is based on interest rates such as loans, deposits, and debt instruments (bonds).

name: INTEREST_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the expense account is an interest expense. Interest expense is paid to bondholders for the use of their money.

name: INTEREST_INCOME_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the REVENUE ACCOUNT is for interest income. Interest income is received by the company from its investment in stocks and bonds.  Note: Some business might treat interest income as a negative expense. In this case, the entity is a subtype of EXPENSE ACCOUNT.

name: INTERNAL_ACCOUNT
description: An account where the enterprise is an active party (either on the debit or credit side) and a signatory to the agreement.

name: INTERNAL_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This entity includes the data elements that went into the internal calculation of a credit report and score. This does not include brokerage investments where securities trade in and out of a portfolio related t

name: INVESTMENT_AGREEMENT_ALLOCATION
description: This entity keeps track of investment allocation objectives for this investment account. It varies by asset class or product group such as stock, bonds, and cash.  This is related to agreement because it could include investment accounts and life insurance policies.

name: INVESTMENT_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for investments. These investments in debt securities with a positive intent and the ability to hold these securities until they mature.

name: LABOR_AGREEMENT
description: For a specific HR POSITION, LABOR AGREEMENT is a contract that defines the related employment terms and conditions. name: LEASE_AGREEMENT
description: A lease agreement is a contract giving the right or possession and use of an asset for a specified period in exchange for payments. name: LEASE_TYPE
description: A classification of the lease such as business or personal.

name: LIABILITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates a general ledger account is a LIABILITY ACCOUNT. These accounts are related to a potential loss, or a financial obligation, debt or claim of money owed to owner party. Types of LIABILITY ACCOUNTs include current liability and noncurrent liability.

name: LIABILITY_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that identifies the type of liability account. Types of liability accounts are current liability and noncurrent liability.

name: LIFE_LINE_AGREEMENT
description: This is a subtype to INSURANCE AGREEMENT and describes policies for the line of life insurance.

name: LOAN_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains only those customer accounts that are loans (assets) from the financial institution's perspective. Loan accounts include mortgages, loans, credit cards, and leases.  It is a subtype to CREDIT AGREEMENT.

name: LOAN_GL_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the loan account. Loan is by far the largest asset item for a bank.

description: The modification type that identifies the specific terms that were altered through loss mitigation efforts. name: LOAN_PROVISION_CHANGE
description: This entity tracks changes to general and specific provisions for losses that have not been recorded directly to the income statement. name: LOAN_RESTRUCTURE
description: This entity contains information about restructuring the loan, which may be due to the inability of the borrower to pay, but it may also be due to the borrower seeking better terms and conditions for the loan such as a refinance. This may be a result of the remediation plan.  A loan that is restruct

name: LOAN_REVIEW
description: This entity tracks the results of the loan review procedures over time.

description: This minor entity identifies the result of the loan review process.  Examples: - No further action required - More detail review required - More information required

name: LOAN_TERM_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity contains the code for the type of loan such as consumer loan, real estate mortgage, automobile loan, lease, or letter of credit.

description: This entity contains information about loans that do not have a term such as credit card and current accounts. It currently has no attributes so is a placeholder for future attributes specific to loan transaction accounts.  This is a subentity to LOAN AGREEMENT.

name: LOAN_TRANSACTION_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the type of loan transaction account such as credit card or home equity line of credit.

name: LONG_TERM_DEBT_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the long-term debt. Long-term debt is the liability amount due in a year or more.

name: LOSS_ADJUSTED_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity is the GL account for the loss and loss adjustment expenses incurred.

name: LOSS_ADJUSTED_RESERVE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity is the GL account for loss and loss adjustment reserves.

description: This entity groups loyalty account earnings by type.  Examples: - Rebate earning - Merchandise earning - Travel earning

name: LOYALTY_ACCOUNT_REDEMPTION
description: This is a subtype of transaction associated with an account balance transaction that tracks all award disbursements from a rewards account.  Examples: - Usage of credit card points for airline travel or merchandise purchase

name: LOYALTY_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement issued by an enterprise to a customer to encourage purchase or usage behavior by issuing rewards in the form of discounts or the accumulation of points.

name: LOYALTY_AGREEMENT_LEVEL
description: This associates a loyalty program level to a loyalty account over time.

name: MARGIN_AGREEMENT
description: A brokerage account in which the broker lends the customer cash to purchase securities. The loan in the account is collateralized by the securities and cash. name: MARKETING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to marketing. Marketing expenses are related the actual marketing of a product (i.e., advertising).

name: MERCHANT_SERVICE_AGREEMENT
description: MERCHANT SERVICE AGREEMENT is a type of AGREEMENT the company enters into with a merchant to provide a service such as fraud checking, debit service, interchange, and merchant discount.

name: MORTGAGE_AGREEMENT
description: A contract for a loan for real estate and is usually long-term. It is a debt instrument giving conditional ownership of an asset secured by the asset being financed. name: MORTGAGE_BACKED_SECURITY

name: MORTGAGE_TYPE
description: Code to indicate the type of mortgage, for example, first time borrower, refinance, or standard.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_LOAN_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information specific to motor vehicle loan agreements that are not leases.

Due to their large denominations, negotiable certificates of deposit are bought most often by l

name: NETTING_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of netting agreement such as payment netting, closeout netting, bilateral netting, or multilateral netting.

name: NETWORK_PARTNER_AGREEMENT
description: NETWORK PARTNER AGREEMENT tracks transactions and balances for a network service partner contract.  Examples include agreements with ATM network service partners such as Cirrus and Pulse.

name: NETWORK_SERVICE_AGREEMENT
description: NETWORK SERVICE AGREEMENT is an AGREEMENT the company enters into with network participants such as merchants, acquirers, issuers, and processors to provide a network related service such as fraud checking, debit service, and interchange.

name: NETWORK_SERVICE_AGREEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: A classification of a network service agreement into a merchant service agreement or a network partner agreement. Used as a category discriminator.

name: NONCURRENT_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the liability account is a noncurrent liability. Noncurrent liabilities are not due in the next twelve months. Types of noncurrent liabilities include deferred income taxes, long-term debt, and reserves.

name: NONCURRENT_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that identifies the type of NONCURRENT LIABILITY ACCOUNTs. Types of noncurrent liabilities include deferred income taxes, long-term debt, and reserves.

name: NONDEPRECIABLE_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies the NONDEPRECIABLE ASSET ACCOUNT. NONDEPRECIABLE FIXED ASSETs include things like raw land.

name: NONDIVIDEND_EQUITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies the type of NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT. Types of NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNTs include retained earnings, Treasury stock, and foreign currency adjustments.

name: NONDIVIDEND_EQUITY_ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: The entity that identifies the type of nondividend equity accounts. Types of nondividend equity accounts include retained earnings, Treasury stock, and foreign currency adjustments.

name: NONINTEREST_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for expenses that are not interest.

name: NONINTEREST_INCOME_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details on noninterest income, which includes loan service fees, other service fees and service charges, and security fees and commissions.

name: NONVOTING_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: This entity identifies common stock dividend equity as a nonvoting stock. Nonvoting stock equities of a public corporation do not possess voting rights.

name: OFFER_COLLATERAL
description: This entity identifies the communication collateral associated with an offer.

All other off-balance sheet securitization exposures will receive a 100% CCF

name: OPERATING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the expense account is an operating expense. Operating expenses are those that are required to run a company.

name: OPERATING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of OPERATING EXPENSE ACCOUNTs. Operating expenses include selling, marketing, general and administrative, research and development, and facilities.

name: OPPORTUNITY_AGREEMENT
description: This entity relates an agreement to a proposal/opportunity combination that may have triggered the creation of this agreement. It allows for an agreement to be triggered by many proposal/opportunity combinations and for a proposal/opportunity to create many agreements.

name: OPTION_AGREEMENT
description: An option is a contract giving you the right (not the obligation) to buy or sell a specified number of shares of an asset at a set price for a given time period.
