name: OTHER_AGREEMENT_IDENTIFIER
description: Identifiers other than the ones explicitly described in the other subtypes.

name: OTHER_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the ASSET ACCOUNT is an OTHER ASSET ACCOUNT. Types of OTHER ASSET ACCOUNTs include investments, deferred charges, or intangible assets.

name: OTHER_ASSET_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of other asset, for example, investments, deferred charges, or intangible asset.

name: OTHER_CURRENT_ASSET_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the asset account is an OTHER CURRENT ASSET ACCOUNT. Types of OTHER CURRENT ASSET ACCOUNTs include business leasehold improvements, employee leasehold improvements, and other refundable deposits.

name: OTHER_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the expense account is for other operating expense. Other expenses are those that are required to run a company and cannot be classified as one of the other types of expenses.

name: OTHER_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the other expense account type, such as provision for loan loss, underwriting expense, and loss and loss adjustment expense.

name: OTHER_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the OTHER LIABILITY ACCOUNT. For an insurance company includes: unearned premium reserves, policyholder funds, and loss and loss adjustment reserves.

name: OTHER_LIABILITY_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that describes the type of another liability account, for example, policyholder fund account.

name: OTHER_OPERATING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to other operating expenses. These expenses are general in nature and cannot be classified as one of the other types of operating expenses.

name: OTHER_REVENUE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that represents income from activities other than normal business operations, such as investment interest, foreign exchange gains, rent income, and profit from the sale of noninventory assets.

name: PATENTS_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for patents. These details could include the legal cost a company paid an individual or a company to obtain a patent.

name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ACCOUNT
description: If the money originated from a different financial institution, then this is the external account number.

name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_AGREEMENT
description: This is the internal account where the money will be deposited. It may also be another account from which the money originated.

name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_AGREEMENT_ROLE
description: This describes the relationship between an agreement or account and the payment instruction such as "is originating account" or "is destination account".

name: POLICY_HOLDER_FUND_ACCOUNT
description: Policyholder surplus representing the difference between admitted assets and liabilities on a statutory accounting basis and subdivided on a statutory basis into special surplus funds, capital paid up, gross paid in and contributed surplus, unassigned funds, and Treasury stock.

name: PORTFOLIO_COLLATERAL_ITEM
description: This entity contains those assets used as collateral where the assets are investment holdings within a customer portfolio managed by your institution. More than one portfolio asset could be bundled into a collateral item.

name: PORTFOLIO_PRODUCT_AGREEMENT_HOLDING
description: This entity associates portfolios for a given agreement with investment products. This entity tracks investment holdings that come in and out of the portfolio for a given account. The quantity of the holding and the value of the holding are in separate entities.  For those portfolio(s) that distribu

name: PORTFOLIO_PRODUCT_AGREEMENT_HOLDING_QUANTITY
description: This entity tracks the changes to the number of units held of this investment product as part of this portfolio over time.

name: PORTFOLIO_PRODUCT_AGREEMENT_HOLDING_VALUE
description: This entity tracks the values of the investment over time for this holding. The values can include book value (as represented on the balance sheet), fair value, and market value. This value changes frequently.

name: POSITION_LABOR_AGREEMENT
description: The relationship of LABOR AGREEMENTs to ORGANIZATION POSITIONs. The organizational positions could be related to different labor agreements over time.  Example: - Union contract with bank teller position

name: PO_DELIVERY_RELEASE
description: This entity identifies the enterprise-supplied request for immediate scheduling of a delivery against a VENDOR PO LINE. The PO DELIVERY RELEASE can, for example, allow a blanket purchase order to be delivered in pieces over time and to specify the delivery schedule just in time.

name: PO_DELIVERY_RELEASE_LINE_ITEM
description: This entity defines the authorization by enterprise of a particular delivery of a release quantity that was requested, based on a particular PO LINE DELIVERY RELEASE LINE.

name: PO_DELIVERY_RELEASE_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a PO DELIVERY RELEASE LINE ITEM over time.

name: PO_LINE_DELIVERY_RELEASE_LINE
description: This entity associates the VENDOR PO LINE to the PO DELIVERY RELEASE LINE ITEM. It identifies the quantity of the VENDOR PO LINE that has been authorized for release.

name: PO_RELEASE_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: Lists the possible reasons for a PO DELIVERY RELEASE STATUS.  For example, the reason a PO release reflects a status of on hold could be due to a pending change in delivery schedule.

name: PO_RELEASE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the types of purchase order release status.  Examples: - Incomplete - In process - Approved - Preapproved - Rejected - Returned - Requires reapproval - On hold - Frozen - Open - Closed - Finally closed - Canceled

name: PRECREDIT_TYPE
description: The charges before starting the actual regular payments on a mortgage. Sample values are prepayment charges and preinterest amount.

name: PREFERRED_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies dividend equity as preferred stock. Preferred stock has preference over common stock in the payment of dividends and the liquidation of assets.

name: PREMIUM_WRITTEN_ACCOUNT
description: The GL account for the amount of policy premiums billed less premiums returned to the insured.

name: PREPAID_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the PREPAID EXPENSE ACCOUNTs. Prepaid expenses are those expenses that have been paid in advance like insurance. PREPAID EXPENSE ACCOUNTs are types of current assets.

name: PRODUCT_TO_AGREEMENT_CLASS_VALUE
description: This entity was created for the Loss Give Default Business Function View for enterprise risk management.  This entity classifies a product according to a certain classification scheme.  In this context, a product is associated with an exposure type where the exposure type is a classification of agre

name: PROJECT_TASK_CHART_OF_ACCOUNTS
description: This entity associates project tasks and resources to a chart of accounts number to enable revenue and expense reporting for the project.

name: PROMOTION_COLLATERAL
description: This entity identifies the communication collateral associated with a promotion.

name: PROPERTY_CASUALTY_AGREEMENT
description: This entity is a subtype to INSURANCE AGREEMENT and contains the details of applications for property and casualty insurance.

name: PROPOSAL_AGREEMENT
description: This entity relates an agreement to a proposal that may have triggered the creation of this agreement. It allows for an agreement to be triggered by many proposals and for a proposal to result in many agreements.  This allows for the creation of an agreement without the existence of an opportunity.

name: PROVIDER_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: Code indicating the type of agreement under which the provider is submitting this claim. One example is a nonparticipating provider is sending a participating claim as allowed under certain plans.

name: PROVISION_FOR_LOAN_LOSS_ACCOUNT
description: This provision account is really a noncash expense. Its purpose is to shelter a portion of the bank's current earnings from taxes in order to help prepare for a bad loan. The annual loan loss provision is deducted from the current revenues before taxes are applied to earnings.

name: PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE_ISSUER_AGREEMENT
description: This agreement contains information about the agreement between the bank and the issuer for whom the bank is to collect receivables for. This may also be known as the "factoring contract."  The financial institution (the factor) may have factoring contracts with the issuer party who provides to debt

name: PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE_ISSUER_DEBTOR_AGREEMENT
description: A purchased receivable contract in which the following parties are involved.  Examples: - The bank that purchases the receivables (the factor) - The bank's client that issues the receivables (the issuer) - The bank's client's customer (debtor) who owes the money  Related to a factoring contract, the

name: PURCHASE_TRANSACTION_AGREEMENT
description: This is a type of credit card and represents accounts that allow purchasing only at specific business organization types.

name: QUOTATION_AGREEMENT
description: This associative entity defines the hierarchical relationship that will exist between existing accounts and the account that this quotation might be converted into. A quotation may have many subaccounts; an account may be subaccount to many quotations.  In addition, this associative entity can be us

name: QUOTATION_COLLATERAL_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to entity QUOTATION ASSET and contains details of the asset in relation to the quotation in the role of to be collateral.

name: REINSURANCE_AGREEMENT
description: Reinsurance is a means by which an insurance company can protect itself against the risk of losses with other insurance companies. Individuals and corporations obtain insurance policies to provide protection for various risks (e.g., hurricanes, earthquakes, and lawsuits ).

name: REINSURANCE_AGREEMENT_RESTRICTION
description: This entity identifies each restriction to the reinsurance agreement. This is in addition to the terms and conditions as described in Features. These are actually the rules that define the kinds of policies that this reinsurance agreement covers.  For example, if the reinsurance agreement is restric

name: REINSURANCE_CONTRACT_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the reinsurance contract type code into a description.  Examples are: - Automatic - Facultative - Facultative-obligatory  Automatic reinsurance treaty: - This is a reinsurance agreement in which the reinsurer agrees, for a stipulated type of risk, to accept each risk or a

name: RELEASE_TYPE
description: Describes whether release is for a blanket or planned purchase order. Possible values are therefore "Blanket" or "Planned."

name: REPURCHASE_AGREEMENT
description: This is a form of short-term borrowing for dealers in government securities. The dealer sells the government securities to investors, usually on an overnight basis, and buys them back the following day. Also known as, "repo" and "reverse repo." Securities Lending is also included in this entity.  Fo

name: REPURCHASE_AGREEMENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity indicates if this is a repurchase agreement, or a reverse repurchase agreement, or a securities lending agreement.

name: RESEARCH_DEVELOPMENT_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates the operating expense pertains to research and development. Research and development expenses are related to research and development of products or services for a company.

name: RESERVES_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the reserves. Reserves are the accrual of anticipated expenses to be paid out in the future, such as product liability, and litigation.

name: RETAINED_EARNING_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies a NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT as retained earnings. Retained earnings are net profits kept to accumulate in a business after dividends are paid.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that indicates a general ledger account is a REVENUE ACCOUNT. Types of REVENUE ACCOUNTs include interest income and other revenue.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT_REVENUE_TYPE_XREF
description: This entity associates a REVENUE TYPE with REVENUE ACCOUNT. The many-to-many relationship allows for a more flexible way to roll up GL accounts to various revenue types. For example, roll up all GL revenue account for product revenue types.

name: REVENUE_ACCOUNT_SUBTYPE
description: The entity that indicates the type of revenue account. Types of revenue accounts include sales revenue and other revenue.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains agreements that that are being used to mitigate the risk of another agreement (e.g., loan). It includes agreements that mitigate your enterprise's risk and also agreements that mitigate other institution's risk where you both share claim to the same collateral item.  These risk

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_ITEM
description: This entity relates a risk mitigant agreement (e.g., collateral agreement) to the customer asset that the agreement is for (e.g., real estate or customer account). The terms of the agreement describe how this asset can be used as collateral.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_RELATED
description: This entity contains information about the relationship between two different risk mitigant agreements. Examples of the relationship could be "is senior to" or "is equal in seniority to" when both risk mitigant agreements cover the same exposure.

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_SENIORITY
description: This entity tracks the history of seniority of one risk mitigant agreement to another risk mitigant agreement. The seniority designates who gets paid in which order if the customer defaults using the asset associated with the collateral agreement as the basis for payment. The party with the highest

name: RISK_MITIGANT_AGREEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity classifies the type of risk mitigant agreement such as a collateral agreements, credit derivative, third-party guarantee agreements, securitization sell agreements, deposit agreements (internal customer asset pledged as collateral), investment agreements (internal customer asset pledged

name: SAFE_DEPOSIT_AGREEMENT
description: This entity contains information about safe deposit boxes.

name: SALES_REVENUE_ACCOUNT
description: A type of REVENUE ACCOUNT that provides details on revenue from delivery of goods and services. Sales revenue is the primary source of revenue earned by the company from its customers.

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_ACCOUNT_CAMPAIGN_XREF
description: This entity captures information that provides a linkage between paid search accounts and paid search campaigns.

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SYSTEM_ACCOUNT
description: This entity captures customer paid search engine system access account information.

name: SECURITIES_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the SECURITIES ACCOUNTs. Securities are short-term investments with a maturity of three to twelve months. Securities accounts are types of current assets.

name: SECURITIZATION_AGREEMENT_TO_SECURITIZATION_POOL
description: This entity shows those securitization agreements that caused this pool to be formed.

name: SECURITIZATION_CLEAN_UP_CALL_TYPE
description: A code for the option to call a securitized bond when the balance of the outstanding deal assets (collateral) falls below some threshold (typically 10%).

name: SECURITIZATION_EXPOSURE
description: This summary entity tracks various measures of a bank's asset securitization activity, including total current outstanding securitization exposures, and the amount of securitization exposures incurred during the period.

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL
description: This entity is a type of AGREEMENT GROUP and contains only those groups that are a collection of loans and other bank assets that are offered for sale to investors. This process is known as securitization and this entity contains one instance for each group or pool of assets that are offered for sal

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL_OBLIGOR_METRIC
description: In the case where the agreement group is a securitization pool, it is a requirement in Basel to determine all the exposures to the same obligor and the total EAD and LGD for those exposures for that pool for that obligor.  Securitization June 2004 Accord paragraph 633/634

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL_RISK
description: This entity tracks risk related metrics for a securitization pool (group of accounts that are securitized) over time.

name: SECURITIZATION_POOL_STRUCTURE_TYPE
description: A code for whether this securitization pool is traditional or synthetic.  Traditional securitization involves the pooling of assets where the assets are divided into tranches and the tranches are sold as bond securities on the open market and are collateralized by the cash flow of the underlying ins

name: SECURITIZATION_ROLE
description: The role played by the bank in an asset securitization transaction, for example, originator, investor, servicer, and sponsor of asset-backed commercial paper facility.

name: SECURITIZATION_SELL_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the loan-originating bank (your enterprise as the seller) and an investing bank (or other investor) that is purchasing and assuming the risk on an underlying exposure (e.g., loan). The originating bank may be performing a collection service and would also be considered a

name: SECURITIZATION_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of securitization sale this agreement represents.  Examples: - Mortgage-backed security - Loan backed bonds - Sponsoring agreement to an asset-backed commercial paper (issuing notes against receivable

name: SELLING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: The operating expense category that indicates selling expenses, related to the actual selling of a product, for example, sales salaries and commissions.

name: SETTLEMENT_DELIVERY_TYPE
description: A code for the method of delivery of the goods such as: - B = Book (security being traded is registered in the street name where the brokerage is designated the security nominee by the client. This allows securities to settle electronically as book entries in the broker's account at the depository t

name: SETTLEMENT_DIRECTION_TYPE
description: Indicates whether your enterprise is the deliverer, the receiver or both of the settlement.  Examples: - D = delivery - R = receive - B = delivery and receive

name: SETTLEMENT_PRODUCT_REASON_TYPE
description: A code for the reason this group of products is associated with this settlement instruction such as "applies to" and "does not apply to."

name: SHORT_TERM_DEBT_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that provides details for the short-term debt. Short-term debt is all debt obligations coming due within one year.

name: SPLIT_SETTLEMENT_TYPE
description: Indicates whether the settlement of securities is handled separate from cash settlement.  Examples: - Together - Separate

name: STORED_VALUE_AGREEMENT
description: STORED VALUE AGREEMENT is a type of FINANCIAL AGREEMENT, implemented as a prepaid card, single use or renewable with new deposits of money. This entity contains only those card member agreements that are liabilities from the company's perspective. An example of a STORED VALUE AGREEMENT is a gift car

name: STRESS_TEST_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This entity identifies the group of agreements or 'portfolio' that is being tested or stressed as a result of this test.

name: SWAP_AGREEMENT
description: A swap is an agreement between two parties to exchange future streams of cash flows generated from other agreements (e.g., loans). Swaps involve exchanging the terms of one asset (loan) for another to improve the quality of a loan portfolio for risk management or asset/liability management purposes.

name: SWAP_AGREEMENT_LEG
description: This entity identifies the cash flow terms for a swap agreement. A swap can have many "legs" where one leg represents a unidirectional exchange of money with associated terms and conditions. Examples of types of legs can be "flat," "amortizing," "zero coupon," and "capped/floored."  A leg represents

name: SWAP_AGREEMENT_LEG_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics for swap leg. This can be any calculated metric associated with the swap leg (other than what is specified in the other entities) such as exposure amount and volatility.

name: SWAP_LEG_AGREEMENT_EVENT
description: This entity contains information about events that affects the leg of a swap such as payments against a specific leg.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION_AGREEMENT
description: This associative entity allows for a campaign strategy, such as a collection/recovery campaign promotion, to target more than one account and for an account to be targeted by more than one promotion.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION_AGREEMENT_GROUP
description: This associative entity allows for a campaign, such as a collection/recovery campaign promotion, to target more than one account group and for an account group to be targeted by more than one promotion.

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_AGREEMENT
description: This is an agreement between the firm and a third party (e.g., custodian or agency) and specifies the terms and conditions for all trades under this agreement with these third parties. This entity contains the third-party identifiers.

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_INSTRUCTION
description: This entity contains those predefined settlement instructions that are considered standing instructions at the account level and do not vary by trade. These would be related to the investment account but the values of the various instructions for an account (code values) can change over time.  These

name: TRADE_SETTLEMENT_PRODUCT_GROUP
description: This entity contains the group of products that are the class of securities that this settlement instruction covers at the account level. This allows for an instruction to cover multiple product groups for different reasons.

name: TRANCHE_TO_AGREEMENT
description: This entity identifies any agreement or account that is related to a tranche.  If the agreement is the exposure (e.g., a loan) then this shows which tranches that loan was put into. It is possible for one loan to be split between more than one tranche such as when interest goes to one tranche and pr

name: TRANCHE_TO_AGREEMENT_ROLE_TYPE
description: The role that the agreement has with the tranche such as "is being securitized by" or "is risk mitigant for."

name: TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT
description: This is the account that is used by the financial institution to pay for invoices and other debt. It is not a customer account.

name: TRANSACTION_ACCOUNT_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the type of transaction account such as credit card account, checking account, or current account.

name: TREASURY_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: The entity that identifies a NONDIVIDEND EQUITY ACCOUNT as Treasury stock. Treasury stock is reacquired by a corporation to be retired or resold to the public. Treasury stock is issued but not outstanding, and is not taken into consideration when calculating earnings per share or dividends, or for v

name: UNDERWRITING_EXPENSE_ACCOUNT
description: A broad classification of expense excluding loss adjustment and investment expenses. Underwriting expenses include acquisition, field supervision, collections, taxes, licenses, and fees.

name: UNEARNED_PREMIUM_RESERVE_ACCOUNT
description: The unearned premium reserve is the liability for the unearned portion of premium of a policy in force or the amount required to provide for losses and expenses during the unexpired term of the policy.

name: UNITED_STATES_BANK_ACCOUNT_IDENTIFIER
description: This is the bank account number that is assigned to a bank account for a financial institution in the United States, and which follows the numbering system as assigned by the American Bankers Association including a routing transit number.  This entity tracks the history of account numbers associate

name: UNPAID_CLAIM_ACCOUNT
description: The unpaid claim account is the liability provision for unpaid losses and includes claims approved for payment not yet paid, pending claims, and closed claims reopened for payment.

name: VOTING_STOCK_ACCOUNT
description: This entity identifies common stock equity as a voting stock. Voting stock equities of a public corporation have voting rights.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_CONTRACT
description: The entity represents the agreement made between the one party and another (e.g., ad service provider and the advertiser) that states the time period for the contract, the number of impressions and click-throughs guaranteed to the advertisers and the cost for each impression and click-through.

name: WORK_PROCESS_LOAN
description: This is the work process required for this loan. The types of work processes could be processing a loan, default remediation, or repossession steps.

name: APPLICATION_ASSET
description: This associative entity relates an application to an asset along with the role that the asset has with the application. An example of a role of an asset to an application is a collateral role.

name: APPLICATION_ASSET_ROLE_SUBTYPE
description: This code contains the role of the asset to the application and is used as a subtype code. Roles can include is collateral for, is insured asset for, or is subject of a lease.

name: APPLICATION_INSURED_ASSET
description: This is a subtype to entity APPLICATION ASSET and contains details of the asset in relation to the application in the role of to be insured.

name: ASSET_APPRAISAL_REASON_TYPE
description: A code for the reason for the appraisal such as: - Applying for a loan - Estate valuation due to death of owner or joint owner - To determine cost basis at point-in-time - Insurance salvage purposes - Regular appraisal for risk management purposes

name: ASSET_CLASSIFICATION_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are classifications of assets. There is one instance for each asset classification, such as houses worth over $1 million.

name: ASSET_CLASS_TO_OBLIGOR_TYPE
description: This entity maps a Basel asset class to an obligor type (party class value) for Basel II calculation purposes.

name: ASSET_DETAIL_CODE_XREF
description: This associative entity combines tangible objects with the detail codes and specifications that are valid for the tangible objects. An example is occupancy type (retail office, manufacturing, food processing, and hotel) for real estate.

name: ASSET_DETAIL_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This is a higher-level classification of the asset detail type.  The code represents the coding scheme. If the asset detail scheme type is "fuel line location" then the asset detail type is "front of dwelling."

name: ASSET_DETAIL_TYPE
description: This entity contains codes describing details of tangible objects. Examples are given for motor vehicles and real estate.  Motor vehicles: - Vehicle passenger restrictive device codes - Vehicle anti-theft device codes - Vehicle damage codes - Vehicle performance codes  Real estate: - Construction co

name: ASSET_INSPECTION
description: This entity keeps track of physical inspections of customer assets. This may be done to value assets such as raw materials, work-in-process goods, finished goods, dealers' inventories of autos, and equipment.  Basel II QIS paragraph 470

name: ASSET_INSPECTION_RESULT
description: This entity tracks the results of the inspection. There can be many things to look at during the inspection such as general condition, number of rooms, presence of smoke alarm, occupied or not. Each thing being observed has a result. The result may be a code (such as poor, good, excellent) or it may

name: ASSET_INSURANCE_REFUSED_TYPE
description: This is a code that describes whether insurance was refused for this asset.

name: ASSET_LIABILITY_TYPE
description: Indicates whether the type is an asset or liability or both.  Examples: - Asset - Liability - Allocated capital - Neither asset nor liability - Both asset and liability – depends on balance

name: ASSET_MAINTENANCE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of maintenance to this asset such as: - Real estate plumbing maintenance - Real estate electrical maintenance - Real estate heating maintenance - Automobile check up

name: ASSET_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the asset role code into a description. Examples of asset roles could be owner, co-owner, beneficiary, or insures. There is one instance for each role code.

name: ASSET_SCORE
description: This entity contains predictive scores that are a result of a calculation model/formula. An example of a score could be a liquidity score or a risk score. An example of a score for an asset could be probability of damage due to fire or earthquake.

name: ASSET_USE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the asset use code into a description.

name: ASSET_VALUATION_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: Code for the various amounts related to this valuation event. Value types include: - Valuation amount - Market value - List price - Selling price - Value prior to adjustments for Basel II - Value after adjustments (haircuts) for Basel II

name: ASSET_VALUATION_METHOD_TYPE
description: A code for the method used to value this asset such as: - Basel II calculation rules - Fair market value - Blue Book - Geographic index

name: ASSET_VALUE
description: This entity tracks the changes to the value of the asset over time. There is one instance for each change in value to the asset. This would include appraisal values for houses and land.  Examples of amounts include: - Market value - Listed value - Selling value - Value for risk management before adj

name: CASH_ASSET
description: This entity contains information about cash, foreign exchange, or a deposit of money that resides at another institution. (If your institution has this asset then it would be an instance of AGREEMENT).

name: DEPRECIABLE_ASSET_DEPRECIATION
description: This entity identifies the DEPRECIATION METHOD TYPE that can be used for a given DEPRECIABLE FIXED ASSET.

name: DEPRECIABLE_ASSET_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the type of depreciable asset like property, equipment, or plant.

name: DEPRECIABLE_FIXED_ASSET
description: The entity that identifies a DEPRECIABLE FIXED ASSET.

name: DEPRECIABLE_PROPERTY
description: The entity that provides details for the property accounts. DEPRECIABLE PROPERTY is a type of a DEPRECIABLE FIXED ASSET.

name: DWELLING_TYPE
description: This is a code that identifies a type dwelling.  Examples: - Single family - Multifamily

name: EQUIPMENT_ASSET
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes the equipment asset.

name: FINANCIAL_ASSET
description: This entity contains information about assets of a financial nature. These types of assets include cash, stocks, bonds, futures, options, and commodities.

name: FINANCIAL_ASSET_SUBTYPE
description: A code used as a category discriminator for party assets.

name: FIXED_ASSET
description: This entity identifies all the known FIXED ASSETs of the organization. FIXED ASSETs are tangible property used in the operation of the business. Examples of FIXED ASSETs are land, plant, machinery and equipment, furniture, and fixtures.

name: FIXED_ASSET_AMOUNT
description: This entity identifies the monetary amounts associated with a FIXED ASSET.  Types of amount that are tracked for a FIXED ASSET include: - Salvage value - Predicted salvage value - Original cost - Adjusted cost - Depreciation amount

name: FIXED_ASSET_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: This entity contains monetary amount types and descriptions that can be associated with a FIXED ASSET.  Examples: - Historical cost - Gain on disposal - Loss on disposal - Rental income - Capital appreciation - Impairment loss - Refurbishment cost - Present value minimum lease payments - Salvage val

name: FIXED_ASSET_BOOK
description: This entity is a book or collection of assets, along with a record of the transactions performed on those assets, including addition, and depreciation.

name: FIXED_ASSET_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This entity contains the various schemes or ways that a fixed asset can be classified. An example of a scheme would be Solvency II Complementary Industry Classification (CIC). Another scheme might be for internal reporting purposes.

name: FIXED_ASSET_CLASS_VALUE
description: This is the value of the code. For example, if the scheme is Solvency II Complementary Industry Code then possible values are commercial property, residential property, property for own use, property under construction, plant and equipment for own use, and other. One instance is one value of the cod

name: FIXED_ASSET_CLASS_VALUE_XREF
description: This relates the fixed asset to the code value.

name: FIXED_ASSET_GROUP
description: This entity defines a category into which assets may be classified for tracking and reporting.  An example is asset classes that group assets together based on depreciation method and the asset's estimated useful life.

name: FIXED_ASSET_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity tracks the group to which a FIXED ASSET is assigned. For example, FIXED ASSETs may be grouped by asset classes for depreciation tracking and reporting purposes.

name: FIXED_ASSET_OWNERSHIP_TYPE
description: FIXED ASSET OWNERSHIP TYPE describes whether a FIXED ASSET is leased or purchased.  Examples: - Purchased - Leased – capital lease - Reclassed from owner-occupied to investment property - Investment property under finance lease - Investment property owned

name: FIXED_ASSET_PO
description: This entity tracks the purchase orders associated with a fixed asset.

name: FIXED_ASSET_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a FIXED ASSET such as in use, retired, idle, or disposed.

name: FIXED_ASSET_STATUS_TYPE
description: The status or conditions that can be assigned to a fixed asset.  Examples are: - In use - Retire - Idle - In repair - Disposal – withdrawn from use - Disposal – sale - Disposal – finance lease to third-party

name: FIXED_ASSET_TYPE
description: The entity that identifies the type of internal FIXED ASSET like depreciable asset or nondepreciable asset.

name: INSURED_ASSET_UNDERWRITE_CLASS
description: This entity relates an insured asset to the underwriting class codes.

name: INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY
description: This entity includes intellectual property that is considered a corporate asset such as patents and copyrights.

name: INTELLECTUAL_PROPERTY_TYPE
description: A code for the type of intellectual property such as patent or copyright.

name: INTERNAL_ASSET_SUBTYPE
description: This entity further classifies an internal asset as either fixed or consumable.

name: INTERNAL_ASSET_TYPE
description: This is the list of types of items or assets that your business purchases to conduct operations. It is related to purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and returns.  Examples include supplies, desks, chairs, and personal computer. This is a classification of the asset and not the asset instance.  Thi

name: INTERNAL_CONSUMABLE_ASSET_TYPE
description: This is an internal asset that is consumable such as supplies.

name: INTERNAL_FIXED_ASSET_TYPE
description: This is an internal asset that classified as a fixed asset such as buildings.

name: JEWELRY
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes the jewelry.

name: JEWELRY_GEM_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the jewelry gem code into a description.

name: JEWELRY_METAL_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the jewelry metal code into a description.

name: JEWELRY_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the jewelry type code into a description.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes the motor vehicle. Motor vehicles include passenger cars, busses, ambulances, trucks, and vans.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_DETAIL
description: This entity represents the motor vehicle attributes that may change over time.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_SPECIFICATION
description: These are the motor vehicle specifications that are unique to this specific vehicle and cannot be derived from the make/model/year standard specifications.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the motor vehicle type code into a description. Examples include passenger car, motorcycle, pickup truck, van, recreational vehicle, taxicab, and bus.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_USAGE_METRIC
description: This entity tracks various measurements reported for this vehicle at a point-in-time such as odometer reading, oil level, brake fluid level, and tire pressure. This is different from valuation and code specifications. These metrics can change over time based on the usage of the vehicle.

name: MOTOR_VEHICLE_USAGE_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of metric such as odometer reading, oil level, brake fluid level, and tire pressure

name: NONDEPRECIABLE_ASSET_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the type of nondepreciable asset like raw land.

name: NONDEPRECIABLE_FIXED_ASSET
description: The entity that identifies the FIXED ASSET is nondepreciable. NONDEPRECIABLE FIXED ASSETs include things like raw land.

name: OTHER_ASSET
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes assets other than real estate, motor vehicles, jewelry, or boats.

name: POLICY_ASSET_COVERAGE_METRIC
description: This entity tracks various insurance metrics over time for this policy for this coverage for this insured asset. For example, it tracks written and earned premium, and discount amounts.  The time period will specify whether this is point-in-time or a time range, which starts from the start date.

name: PROJECT_RESOURCE_FIXED_ASSET
description: This entity lists a specific FIXED ASSET assigned to a PROJECT TASK.

name: VEHICLE_MAKE_MODEL

name: OPPORTUNITY_SEGMENT
description: This entity relates a market segment to an opportunity for the purpose of tracking over time the marketing related to this segment. Promotions may result from this association.

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS
description: The status of this opportunity as of a date such as: - Pending acceptance or rejection - Accepted internally - Rejected internally - Won - Lost - Timed out (too costly in sales stage)

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_REASON
description: The reason(s) this opportunity was won or lost or changed status.  Examples: - Incorrect lead - Prospect financials - No sales budget - Lead not qualified - Good lead - Competition won - Lower price - Location - Product  This entity allows for more than one reason to be entered for this opportunity.

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason why a campaign opportunity has a given status such as the reason it was won or lost.  Examples: - Incorrect lead - Prospect financials - No sales budget - Lead not qualified - Good lead - Competition won - Lower price - Location - Product

name: OPPORTUNITY_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of this opportunity such as: - Pending acceptance or rejection - Accepted internally - Rejected internally - Won - Lost

name: OPPORTUNITY_STEP
description: This entity captures information regarding an action to be taken during an opportunity; each step is one action that could be taken.  Examples: - Send letter 1 via mail - Send application form 2 via mail - Send letter 2 via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: OPPORTUNITY_STEP_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the possible actions that may be taken during an opportunity.  Examples: - Send letter 1 via mail - Send application form 2 via mail - Send letter 2 via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: OPPORTUNITY_STRATEGIC_VALUE_TYPE
description: A code for the ranking of strategic value of this opportunity such as: - High - Medium - Low

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT
description: Any textual notes about this opportunity.

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to opportunity text unstructured data.

name: OPPORTUNITY_TEXT_TYPE
description: A code for the type of text for this opportunity such as: - Product or service being offered - Status information - Conversation information

name: OPPORTUNITY_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of opportunity such as loan, lease, deposit, and investment.  This will be customized based on the enterprise offerings that are complex enough to go through the opportunity and proposal process.

name: OPPORTUNITY_VISIBLE_TYPE
description: A code for how visible this opportunity is in the enterprise such as: - Board of directors - Executive management - Middle management - Line of business

name: PAID_SEARCH_PROMOTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding paid search promotion status types.  Examples: - Successful - Failed - Incomplete

name: PROMOTION
description: A narrowly defined marketing effort designed for a specific purpose and can be part of a larger campaign. It usually has a specific start and end date. A promotion can contain multiple offers and ads. For example, a promotion is created to drive DVD sales. It consists of two offers (one for free shi

name: PROMOTION_CELL
description: A cell is a specialized treatment strategy for a grouping of parties for campaign promotion purposes. name: PROMOTION_CLASSIFICATION
description: This entity provides information regarding the classifications of promotions.  Examples: - Increase brand awareness - Increase product sales

name: PROMOTION_EXPENSE_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of expenses use in a campaign and/or promotion.  Examples: - Printing - TV spot - Consulting

name: PROMOTION_EXPENSE_XREF
description: Tracks the budgeted and actual expenses for a promotion.

name: PROMOTION_METRIC
description: This entity captures any kind of metric associated with this promotion including results such as number of hits, number of purchases, number of positive responses, number of negative responses, and budget and actual costs.

name: PROMOTION_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of promotion metric such as number of hits, number of positive responses, number of negative responses, and number of sales.

name: PROMOTION_OFFER
description: A specific incentive made available to customers. Usually, contains two parts: a.) condition(s) to be met, and b.) the reward for a.) It is usually a narrowly defined marketing effort designed for a specific purpose. Can be part of a larger campaign. It has a specific start and end date. A promotion

name: PROMOTION_OFFER_SEGMENT
description: A mapping of a group of market segments to a specific promotion offer. A promotion offer can be made to more than one market segment.  Example: - All customers whose purchase went down over 50% over the last 6 months are offered $20 off their next order.

name: PROMOTION_OFFER_TYPE
description: This is the type of promotion offer such as a product offer or a product feature offer.

name: PROMOTION_PROSPECT
description: This entity contains information about this promotion for this prospect.  For example, a threshold describes how many times this prospect can be offered this promotion before stopping or going to the next step.

name: PROMOTION_RESPONSE_SCORE
description: This associative entity relates a response score with a party for this promotion. A response score is the probability that a party will respond positively to a promotion.

name: PROMOTION_SCRIPTED_MESSAGE_XREF
description: This entity provides for a promotion to have more than one script and for a script to be used by more than one promotion.

name: PROMOTION_SEGMENT
description: A mapping of a group of market segments to a specific promo offer. A promo offer can be made to more than one market segment.  Example: - All customers whose purchase went down over 50% over the last six months are offered $20 off their next order.

name: PROMOTION_STATUS
description: This entity defines the status of a promotion over time.

name: PROMOTION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the promotion. Examples would be active, under development, on hold after being active, and closed for deletion.

name: PROMOTION_STEP
description: This entity represents an action to be taken during a promotion. Each step is one action that could be taken.  Examples: - Send letter one via mail - Send application form two via mail - Send letter two via email - Phone call - Open agreement

name: PROMOTION_STEP_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the next step given a response to a promotion step for a cell. The response may be no response in which case the next step is a "timeout" step. If the next step is null then no further action is taken.  These are planned responses to a step.

name: PROMOTION_STEP_TYPE
description: A code for the classification of a step used during a promotion.  Examples: - Send letter - Send application - Follow-up phone call

name: PROMOTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes whether the promotion is a mass, micro, or target marketing. Mass marketing is usually radio, television, and newspaper and covers a wide area. Micromarketing targets a smaller audience, usually a geographical area that has certain characteristics. Target marketing refers

name: REWARD_EVENT
description: This entity is a subtype to AGREEMENT EVENT and contains only those events that involve earning and redeeming loyalty points based on usage of an account such as a credit card account.

name: REWARD_EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This code describes a kind of loyalty account action  Examples: - Loyalty account earning - Loyalty account redemption

name: REWARD_EVENT_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of reward event such as initial bonus event, points earning, points redeeming, and reward points transfer.

name: ROAD_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of road. Possible values are highway, motorway, street, and dirt track.

name: SPREAD_OPTION
description: A type of option that derives its value from the difference between the prices of two or more assets. Spread options can be written on all types of financial products including equities, bonds, and currencies. This type of position can be purchased on large exchanges, but is primarily traded in the

name: SURVEY_COST
description: This entity contains the cost of surveys over time.

name: SURVEY_EVENT
description: This entity associates a survey with events such as the event that issued the survey, the event that is the response to the survey or an event that is a question about the survey.

name: SURVEY_EVENT_REASON_TYPE
description: This is a code for the reason the event is related to the survey such as the event that issued the survey, the event that is the response to the survey, or the event that is a question about the survey.

name: SURVEY_FEEDBACK
description: This is feedback received in a formal, controlled, or structured format, where specific responses are solicited, and responses (typically) are constrained to selecting one of several choices presented.

name: SURVEY_FEEDBACK_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This associates survey feedback to a specific survey response.

name: SURVEY_QUESTION_RESPONSE
description: This entity associates a questionnaire question to a response to that question.  By capturing the date and time of the response (if known), the sequence of the survey responses may be reconstructed, and the overall time taken for the survey and time between responses may be calculated.

name: SURVEY_RESOLUTION
description: Captures all the findings or resolutions made in response to a Survey that was conducted.  Examples: - Improve associate training - Improve item quality inspections

name: SURVEY_RESOLUTION_TYPE
description: Defines a Global Quality-related resolution or action taken to resolve or address feedback received as part of a Survey.  Note: This is a global action, as opposed to the contact level resolution entity that captures the response to an individual party's feedback instead.  Examples: - Improve associ

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This is a unique response to a questionnaire received by the enterprise. It represents the "completed" questionnaire or survey session with answers filled in.  Examples: - An anonymous questionnaire received in a "suggestions" box - A formal face-to-face interview - A web survey taken by a known cus

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_ANSWER
description: One or more preformed answers to a survey question given by the responding party.  This entity provides for: - Multiple-choice answers to a question (where only a single answer is expected), for example, income range or quality of service rating - "All that apply" answers (where none or many answers

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT
description: Records one or more free-form answers to a question.  Examples: - Question: "Explain how we can best win your loyalty."  Response Text: "Always give the best pricing you can" - Question: "Please enter the given names of your children"  Response Text (3 instances): "Sarah," "Janice," and "Luke"

name: SURVEY_RESPONSE_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to survey response text unstructured data.

name: SURVEY_SUBJECT_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the subject of the survey question such as employee (party), organization (party), channel, claim, or account.

name: TARGET_PROMOTION
description: This is a subtype entity to PROMOTION. A lowest level campaign may be a target promotion. A target promotion is directed towards individuals based on individual characteristics. This entity has no attributes other than the primary key but was created to show the different types of promotions.

name: TENDER_OFFER
description: An offer to purchase some or all of shareholders' shares in a corporation. The price offered is usually at a premium to the market price.

name: TRAILER_AD_SUBTYPE
description: This entity captures information that provides a classification scheme used to organize trailer ads. The classification can be used to provide summary information about the performance of various trailer ads.  Examples: - Video game - TV show - Book - Concert event - Movie

name: UPLOAD_ITEM
description: This entity captures information regarding items that are uploaded to the web site.

name: VISIT_PROMOTION_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor promotion offers received during their session.

name: WARRANT_OFFER
description: Call options offered exclusively to shareholders.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_SUMMARY
description: This provides statistics about web ads that are useful in measuring their effectiveness. These values are usually collected by the ad agency.  For example, banner ad 'blue sweater' on mysite.com has 100 impressions and 20 click-throughs over the last month.

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_TEXT
description: This entity contains text associated with a web ad placement such as: - URI Text – the URI of the advertisement, whether that advertisement be a banner displayed on a publisher's page or a web page interposed between a link of interest to a visitor and the target of that link - URI Stem – the URI St

name: WEB_AD_PLACEMENT_TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity is the link to web ad placement text unstructured data.

name: WEB_AD_TYPE
description: A classification scheme used to organize WEB ADs. The classification can be used to provide summary information about the performance of various WEB ADs.  Examples: - Premium banner ad - Discounted banner ad - Keyword related banner ad

name: WEB_CAMPAIGN_EVENT
description: This entity captures information specific to campaign events.

name: WEB_PAGE_AD_VIEW_XREF
description: This entity provides linkage between web pages viewed and the advertisements displayed on those pages.

name: WEB_PAGE_VIEW_AD_SUMMARY
description: This entity captures summary information regarding the advertisements associated with visitor session activities.

name: ASSET_VALUATION_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code that describes why this valuation was done such as: - Required for risk management regulatory capital calculations - Appraisal

name: ATM_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific automated teller machine that is used as a channel instance.  If the ATM is owned by your institution then it is also a fixed asset and will have a Fixed Asset Id.

name: ATM_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is an Automated Teller Machine (ATM).

name: BENEFIT_PLAN_OPTION_POSITION
description: This entity defines which benefit plan options are available to a specific position. For example, full-time permanent positions may include different benefits than part-time or temporary positions may offer.

name: BILLBOARD_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: A type of CHANNEL INSTANCE that identifies communication through billboards. This represents a specific billboard.

name: BOND_ISSUE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code for the reason the issuer issued the bond such as research and development, roads, equipment, or cash backup.

name: BRANCH_SITE
description: This entity is a subtype of site, which is a physical branch.

name: CALL_CENTER_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is a call center.

name: CALL_CENTER_TERMINAL_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific call center terminal that is used as a channel.

name: CALL_CENTER_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the types of call center such as inbound, outbound, or inbound and outbound.

name: CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL_TYPE_MULTIMEDIA_OBJECT
description: This associative entity identifies those multimedia objects that are used for this campaign for this channel type. name: CAMPAIGN_CHANNEL_TYPE_XREF
description: This associative entity identifies the types of channels that are planned for the campaign at any level. For example, a high-level campaign may use several channel types. The lowest level in the campaign (campaign event) uses one channel type.

name: CAMPAIGN_OBJECTIVE_POSITION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the positioning type used for the campaign.  Examples: - Guaranteed - Requested

name: CELL_TARGET_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity contains those channel instances that are the target of a marketing campaign cell.

name: CHANNEL_CAPACITY
description: This associative entity identifies the volume of transaction per unit of time and, by channel characteristics set by bank business rules.

name: CHANNEL_CHANNEL_CLASS_XREF
description: This entity relates a CHANNEL CLASS VALUE with a CHANNEL INSTANCE. A CHANNEL INSTANCE can be classified many ways.  This entity contains the various descriptive classifications for channels.  The business rule says that for a given classification scheme a channel has only one value at one point-in-t

name: CHANNEL_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the schemes for classifying channels. Examples of schemes include proximity to business and daytime usage (e.g., high, medium, and low).

name: CHANNEL_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme these value codes represent the various values for a given classification scheme. For example, if the classification scheme is daytime usage then the possible values could be high, medium, or low.  The hierarchical structure allows you to create a relationship betwe

name: CHANNEL_COST
description: This entity tracks allocated costs related to channels that cannot otherwise be derived from events and accounts.

name: CHANNEL_EVENT
description: This entity tracks the servicing and downtime for each channel that is susceptible to downtime.

name: CHANNEL_EVENT_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the reason for the downtime of the financial institution equipment.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity brings together all the specific touch points in the enterprise. It identifies all the specific channels that customers and other parties use to interact with the enterprise. One instance exists for each specific channel. For example, each ATM has its own ID; each point-of-sale terminal

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one channel instance to another channel instance and describes the relationship between the two channel instances. This structure allows for both a hierarchical relationship and a network relationship between channel instances.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_RELATED_REASON
description: A code for the role that one channel instance has with another channel instance such as "replaces," "is part of," or "contains."

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_SITE_XREF
description: This entity tracks the site of a channel instance over time.  Channels such as specific ATMs can move from site to site over time.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the change to the status of a channel instance over time.  Status examples could be active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_SUBTYPE
description: A code for the subtype instance such as kiosk, electronic channel, call center terminal, party, radio station, print, television, and location.

name: CHANNEL_NETWORK
description: This associative entity describes those networks to which a channel has access. ATMs and point-of-sale devices have access to third-party networks for communication between the device and the financial institution.

name: CHANNEL_OPERATING_HOURS
description: This entity describes the operating hours for a channel. This structure allows for a channel to operate at different hours for different days. name: CHANNEL_PROCESSING_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the type of processing for a channel type for customer communications. It is specifically defined for the Teradata Relationship Management.  Examples: - 1 = use party channel link - 2 = allocate all parties to channel instance # 1

name: CHANNEL_PROFIT
description: This derived entity contains the profit for a channel and is derivable from channel costs (CHANNEL COST) and event revenues. Technically, it does not belong in the model but is here for those banks that cannot yet derive profit from the model.

name: CHANNEL_REPLENISHMENT
description: This entity identifies the quantity that was replenished when the channel ran out of its delivery product. Delivery products include anything returned to the customer such as cash, stamps, or tickets.

name: CHANNEL_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the channel for purposes of using it for customer communications. Examples would be active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This entity defines the major classifications of channels; consider, for example, call center, web site, and brick and mortar. name: CHANNEL_TYPE_CAPACITY
description: This associative entity identifies the volume of transaction per unit of time and, by channel type.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_GROUP
description: This entity is a grouping of channel types into higher levels. For example, a kiosk could be grouped into a self-service classification. A billboard could be grouped into a marketing classification.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_GROUP_XREF
description: This entity is the association of a channel type with a grouping of channel types. It allows for a channel type to belong to more than one group.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SITE
description: This entity identifies the channel types related to a SITE. A SITE can have one type of channel that represents its main or major type of channel. This entity then identifies all other types of channels related to a SITE.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_STATUS
description: This is the status of the channel for purposes of using it for customer communications. Examples would be, active, in development, on hold, no new campaigns, or closed for deletion.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity is a subtype discriminator to CHANNEL TYPE. Examples include ATM, kiosk, and telephone.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_SURVEY_RESPONSE
description: This subentity identifies the channel type that is the subject of this survey question.

name: CHANNEL_TYPE_USAGE
description: This entity identifies the ways this channel can be used such as for sales, marketing, fraud prevention, and general notification.

name: CHANNEL_USAGE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the ways a channel can be used such as: - Sales - Marketing - Fraud prevention - Information delivery

name: CURRENCY_POSITION_METRIC
description: This entity tracks metrics at the level of currency type for a given position - long or short. There is one instance for each type of currency (e.g., USD) for each type of position (long or short), for each type of metric and for each calculation scenario.  From this entity, the derived short and lo

name: DIRECT_MAIL_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This is a type of channel that is physical mail.

name: ELECTRONIC_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific electronic address (e.g., web site address, and email address) that is used as a channel instance.

name: EVENT_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This lists the channels that are involved with an event as specified by the event reason.

name: EVENT_CHANNEL_REASON
description: This is the reason a channel instance is involved with an event such as for sales, for marketing, for fraud prevention, or for taking a survey.

name: EXTERNAL_CLAIM_VEHICLE_DISPOSITION_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of the vehicle being claimed such as repaired, stolen, totaled, damaged, no compensation or other.

name: FINANCIAL_RULE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code that identifies why this rule exists such as regulatory compliance or guideline.

name: HR_POSITION
description: A HR POSITION that can be filled by an ASSOCIATE (e.g., manager, assistant manager, and sales clerk).  Specific functional role within an organization with defined job scope and responsibilities, usually identified by a job title and grade.

name: HR_POSITION_RELATED
description: Indicates a relationship between positions. For example, one position may serve as relief backup to another in case of absence.

name: HR_POSITION_RELATED_ROLE
description: Defines the role served by the related position. Sample values are relief and replacement.

name: HR_POSITION_SITE
description: This entity links human resource positions with sites such as the site(s) where these positions are valid or are filled.

name: HR_POSITION_SITE_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason the site is associated with the human resources position such as "is valid in" or "is filled in."

name: HR_POSITION_TRAIT
description: A generic construct to describe characteristics of an HR POSITION, for example, spending approval limit or stock purchase eligibility grade.

name: HR_POSITION_TYPE
description: The type of position that can be filled by an ASSOCIATE.  Examples: - Permanent full-time - Permanent part-time - Temporary full-time - Temporary part-time

name: INSTITUTIONAL_TREATMENT
description: Treatment plan information reported on an institutional claim.  Required when Home Health Agencies (HHA) need to report "Plan of Treatment" information under various payer contracts.

name: INVESTMENT_PORTFOLIO_POSITION_SUMMARY
description: This is a derived summary entity that reports the investment position by investment product and portfolio (agreement group). name: INVESTMENT_POSITION
description: This entity tracks the values of the investment over time for this holding. The values can include book value (as represented on the balance sheet), fair value, and market value. It gives a point-in-time position value for a holding in a financial instrument. The values could be actual or projected.

name: INVESTMENT_POSITION_SPECIFIC
description: This entity tracks the values of the investment over time for this holding. The values can include book value (as represented on the balance sheet), fair value, and market value. It gives a point-in-time position value for a holding in a financial instrument. The values can be actual or projected.

name: INVESTMENT_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A description of the purpose of this investment.  Examples: - Steady income for retirement - Maximize cash flow - Long-term - Short-term - College savings - Hedge another investment

name: IVR_ACTION
description: User interaction function performed in an IVR step. Determined by override process and implemented by the application entry. A function combines operational characteristics such as language.

name: IVR_LEG
description: An action performed within the Interactive Voice Response determined by a distinct call record. If the call is routed to a different call center or server then a new leg is created.

name: IVR_LEG_ACTION_TYPE
description: A code identifying the IVR action that started the IVR leg.

name: IVR_STEP_NAVIGATION
description: Processing segment of the call leg consisting of an interaction with the caller supported by a single action (override) begun with an entry into the application. The step may transfer to another step, transfer to a different call leg, or end with a caller disconnect.  Each step has a recorded result

name: IVR_TERMINATION_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of outcome at termination of the step or leg.

name: JOB_TITLE_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This entity contains channel types that are job titles. A job title such as Financial Planner, Relationship Manager, Branch Representative, or Call Center Representative may be treated as a type of channel for marketing, collections, or fraud prevention purposes. In this situation, persons with thes

name: KIOSK_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific kiosk that is used as a channel instance.  If the kiosk is owned by your institution then it is also a fixed asset and will have a Fixed Asset Id.

name: LEDGER_POSTING_STATUS
description: The entity that indicates the posting status of a general/subledger batch.  Possible examples may be: - Posted (ready to be entered in the general/subledger) - Do not post

name: LIENHOLDER_POSITION_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the position that the lienholder has with the asset such as first, second, and primary.

name: LOCK_BOX_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: Lock box is a channel provided by the bank where the bank establishes a 'Post Office Box' address for each corporate customer. name: MEASUREMENT_EVENT_PURPOSE
description: This entity describes the purpose of the MEASUREMENT EVENT.  Examples: - Ensure product quality - Analyze equipment maintenance rates

name: METRIC_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This is a code to describe the purpose of the metric. For example, a site that is a company building might measure physical characteristics such as square footage.

name: MODEL_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: Describes the purpose of the analytical model.  Examples: - Churn analysis - Growth analysis - Acquisition analysis - Defection analysis - Probability of default - Los given default

name: MODEL_RUN_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the purpose of the model run such as testing, training, ongoing maintenance, back testing, or forward prediction.

name: MORTALITY_TABLE_PURPOSE
description: This entity captures the reason why the mortality table is assigned to the individual such as for pricing, repricing, or for reserves.

name: MULTIMEDIA_MESSAGE_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: Multimedia Messaging Service (MMS) is a standard for telephone messaging systems that allows sending messages that include multimedia objects (images, audio, video, rich text) and not just text as in Short Message Service (SMS). name: OBLIGOR_BORROWING_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code for the reason the obligor is borrowing money such as: - Home financing - Child education - Capital improvements for business - Car loan

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_ACCESS
description: This entity captures information regarding online applications programs that have been launched by users.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_ACCESS_AD_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding ads displayed on mobile applications.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_ACCESS_SUBTYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the specific types of online applications that are run by users.  Examples: - Media Player - Audio Player - Interactive set-top box application - Video game - Content reader - Content downloader

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_DEVELOPER_XREF
description: This entity links an online application programs to the developer or developers that created it.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_GAME_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the various types of online application games.  Examples: - Roulette - Poker - Blackjack - Racing - War - Social - Monopoly - Life - Strategy - Football - Baseball - Tennis

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM
description: This entity captures information regarding the application programs used online that provides users access to information, entertainment, products or services. name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_CATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding the category classification of the application.  Examples: - Business - Educational - Leisure

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_COUNTRY_GROUP
description: This entity captures information that specifies the countries targeted by a specific online application program. Multiple countries can be served by the same online application program.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_DEVICE_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding devices the interactive application is supported on.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_GENRE
description: This entity captures information regarding the nature/subject matter of an online application program.  Examples: - Music related - Movie related - Education related - Games related  Note: This is a recursive structure, allowing a hierarchy of genres.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_METRIC
description: This entity captures information regarding application metrics experienced by the user. name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_PAGE_VIEW_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding online application programs displayed on a given web page.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_RATING
description: This entity captures information regarding specific rating (or certification) that can be assigned to an online application program.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_RATING_REASON
description: This entity captures information regarding the reason a certain online application program is assigned a rating.  Note: A recursive structure can be added if a hierarchy (or subdivisions) of reasons are required.  Examples: - Adult themes - Strong language - Sexual content - Violence

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_RATING_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding online application programs and their associated ratings and the reason for the ratings.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_PROGRAM_RELATED
description: This entity identifies the relationships between online application programs.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_RELATED_ROLE
description: This entity identifies the roles that can be filled when online application programs are related.

name: ONLINE_APPLICATION_SUBCATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding the subcategory classification of the application.  Examples: - Commercial business - Higher educational - Young adult leisure

name: ONLINE_CAMPAIGN_CHARACTERISTIC

name: ONLINE_DOCUMENT_INFORMATION

name: ONLINE_IMPRESSION_EXPERIENCED
description: This entity captures information regarding the delivery of an impression to a user via an interactive, online device.  Interactive online devices receive impressions indicating actions the viewer is directed to take.

description: This entity captures information regarding the attributes of a given online promotion during a session.

name: ONLINE_PROMOTION_SUMMARY
description: This entity captures summary information regarding the online promotions associated with visitor session activities.

name: ONLINE_PROMOTION_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the various types of online promotions presented during a session.  Examples: - Upsale - Cross-sale - Free shipping - Buy 1 and get 1 free - % Off

name: PACKAGE_CHANNEL_LINEUP

description: This entity tracks different positions available on a page.  Note: The page could be physical such as in a print ad or catalog, or virtual, such as on a web page.  Examples: - Lower right-hand corner - Top middle - Middle left

description: This subentity to CHANNEL INSTANCE contains information about the point-of-sale terminals that exist in stores that can be used by customers to make purchases with a debit, credit or prepaid (smart) card. description: This is the status of the applicant as related to the position applied for. Examples include unreviewed, reviewed, interviewing, rejected, offer extended, or withdrawn.

name: POSITION_ASSIGNMENT_STATUS
description: This entity defines the types of status that can be assigned to an ORGANIZATION POSITION over time. Examples include vacant, offer extended, filled, on hold, or eliminated.

name: POSITION_FX_METRIC
description: This entity contains the derived metrics for foreign exchange risk. description: This tracks the status of the applicant as related to the position applied for. Examples include unreviewed, reviewed, interviewing, rejected, offer extended, or withdrawn.

description: This entity defines the actual value of the TRAIT.  Examples: - Trait = maximum buying limit  Trait Value = 10,000 - Trait = stock eligibility grade  Trait Desc = employee position grades eligible to purchase company stock  Trait Values = 1, 2, 3, 4, S1

description: An address that is a post office box.

description: This subentity to CHANNEL INSTANCE identifies those print media used for advertising. This includes newspapers and magazines. There is one instance for each print media used (e.g., Los Angeles Times).

name: PROGRAMMING_CHANNEL_GROUP_TYPE
description: Captures information regarding the grouping of channels.  Examples: - Sports - Entertainment - Sci-fi

name: PROPOSAL

name: PROPOSAL_FINANCE
description: This entity includes any financial information associated with this proposal such as proposal cost, projected revenue, or profit.

name: PROPOSAL_FINANCE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of financial metric such as: - Proposal cost - Proposed price - Expected revenue - Expected profit - Spread rate - Term number

name: PROPOSAL_STATUS
description: The status of this proposal over time.  Examples: - Not yet started - In process - Finished - Submitted

name: PROPOSAL_STATUS_TYPE

name: SCENARIO_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the purpose of the calculation such as Basel II calculations or economic risk calculations.  Examples are stress testing, back testing, and current period calculation.

name: SITE_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific location that is used as a channel instance.

name: SITE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: A code for the primary purpose of this site such as customer branch, corporate office, technology center, and warehouse.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_POST

name: TELEVISION_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This subentity to CHANNEL INSTANCE identifies those channels that are television stations used for mass advertising.

description: This minor entity describes the purpose of this scheme such as commodity risk time band and interest rate risk time band.

description: This entity associates the trade execution with the over-the-counter post-trade indicators per the MiFID field 63 requirements. There can be more than one type of indicator for each trade execution.

name: TRADE_PURPOSE_TYPE
description: This code identifies the reason for the trade such as to hedge the risk created from another trade or investment, or to mitigate the risk of another position.

name: TREATMENT_TYPE
description: Identifies the plan of treatment. An example source could be treatment codes from CMS code set 359.

description: This entity contains information regarding the database repository for the web site.

name: ASSET_INSURABLE_INTEREST

name: CLAIMANT_INSURABLE_INTEREST_STATUS
description: This entity contains the history of the status of the claim for each claimant for this insurable interest.  Examples would be open, closed, settled, reopened, settled again, and closed again.

name: CLAIMANT_INSURABLE_INTEREST_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the status of the claim to each claimant. Examples would be open, closed, settled, reopened, settled again, and closed again.

name: CLAIM_ADJUDICATION
description: A decision on the settlement of a claim.

description: This associative entity relates the claim with the amounts for the claim, such as the total claimed amount, lawyer fees, and claims adjuster fees.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_ATTACHMENT
description: This entity relates the attachments associated with the claim authorization.

description: A category for the type of claim authorization requested.  Examples: - Admission review - Claim services review - Specialty care review (referral)

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_CERTIFICATION
description: These are the certifications related to the claim authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_DIAGNOSIS_CODE
description: This entity identifies the diagnostic code(s) associated with a claim authorization.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_END_REASON_TYPE
description: The code for the reason that this authorization terminated such as maximum number of treatments exceeded or maximum amount exceeded.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFIER
description: This entity provides trace numbers assigned to the claim authorization as specified by a party.

name: CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_REASON

name: CLAIM_CLASS_VALUE_XREF
description: This entity relates the claim to the classification scheme code value. For example, if the classification scheme is weather condition at time of accident then the value could be heavy fog.

name: CLAIM_CLIA
description: This entity relates the claim to Clinical Laboratory Improvement Amendment (CLIA) numbers.  This is required on Medicare and Medicaid claims for any laboratory performing tests covered by the CLIA Act.

name: CLAIM_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity contains information about the recovery of costs for this claim such as recovery due to subrogation legal action.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_ADJUDICATION_AMOUNT

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_AMOUNT

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_COST_RECOVERY
description: This entity contains information about the recovery of costs for this claim coverage such as recovery due to subrogation legal action.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_INSURABLE_INTEREST
