name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_INSURABLE_INTEREST_REINSURANCE
description: This entity creates the association between claims, coverages being claimed, the insurable interest involved in the claim coverage and the reinsurance agreement that covers this claim coverage for this insurable interest.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity relates legal actions to claim coverages and allows a coverage for a claim to have many legal actions against it.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to claims on coverages such as probability of eligibility for subrogation of bodily injury coverage.

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of a coverage for a claim over time such as "paid," "not paid," and "in process."

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_TEXT

name: CLAIM_COVERAGE_TEXT_SECTION

name: CLAIM_DIAGNOSIS_CODE
description: Identifies the diagnosis code(s) that are associated with a claim at the header level. This might be relevant for bodily injury claims.

name: CLAIM_DOCUMENT

name: CLAIM_FILING_TYPE

name: CLAIM_GROUP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes how claims are grouped. Examples of groupings can be diagnosis codes, incident, claim status, and services claimed.

name: CLAIM_INSURABLE_INTEREST_TYPE
description: A category discriminator that classifies the type of insurable interest for this claim. It could be an asset such as automobile, or house, or a life.

name: CLAIM_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity tracks legal actions against this claim.

name: CLAIM_MANAGEMENT_AUTHORITY_TYPE
description: A code for the degree of authority this agent has with managing claims.

name: CLAIM_MEDIA_TYPE
description: The code for the type of medium sent via a channel such as disk, network, or paper.

name: CLAIM_MOTOR_VEHICLE
description: This entity represents the information that is specific to the motor vehicle in relation to the claim.

name: CLAIM_OBLIGATION_TYPE

name: CLAIM_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to claims such as probability of eligibility for subrogation.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_ADJUDICATION

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_ASSET

description: This entity relates the claim service to the various claim service dates.  Examples: - Settlement date - Recorded date - Shipped date

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_DATE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the claim service date types.  Examples: - Settlement date - Paid date - Recorded date - Shipped date

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity relates legal actions against a claim service and allows a service for a claim to have many legal actions against it.

name: CLAIM_SERVICE_REQUEST

description: For an ASSOCIATE PAYROLL TRANSACTION, deductions from earnings reduce amounts paid to an ASSOCIATE. BEFORE TAX DEDUCTIONs may not be subject to income taxes, as in medical insurance costs, or

description: The types and descriptions of before-tax deductions.  Examples of BEFORE TAX DEDUCTIONs include: - Savings plan – before-tax contributions - Health insurance – associate portion - Dental insurance – associate portion

name: LEAVE_PLAN

description: Aggregate record of the monetary amounts for salaries, wages, bonuses, net pay, and deductions paid on a periodic basis by an enterprise to its associates.  Transaction information includes earnings and deduction details, payroll tax obligations, and leave accrual.

name: PENSION_INDIRECT_EARNING
description: An employer pension paid indirectly as a noncash benefit.

name: REGULAR_EARNING
description: This entity captures information related to associate's regular or direct fixed pay received in the form of cash, for example, salary.

name: REGULAR_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types of regular earnings, such as: - Standard pay: wage based on a per hour rate or a salary that is paid at regular intervals. - Overtime pay: extra pay that is provided for working more than the standard number of hours or when working holidays or other unique situations.

description: Defines type codes assigned to REGULATED BENEFITs, for example, Workers' Compensation or State Unemployment Insurance.

name: VARIABLE_EARNING_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code for the types of variable earnings such as bonus and commission.

description: This entity holds information about taxes that employers are required to withhold from associates' pay. Types of withholding taxes vary depending on the employer's tax jurisdiction. Examples of withholding taxes include federal income tax, state income tax, and local tax.

name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_SUBTYPE
description: This entity holds information about the types and descriptions of withholding taxes, which vary depending on the employer's tax jurisdiction. Examples of withholding taxes include federal income tax, state income tax, and local tax.

name: WORK_SHIFT_DAY_OF_WEEK_HOURS

name: WORK_SHIFT_TYPE
description: Denotes the shift a PARTY works at a SITE, for example, day, night, weekdays, and weekends nights.

name: AMERICAN_EXERCISE_OPTION
description: A type of option that is exercisable at any time during the life of the option.

name: APPLICATION_INVESTMENT_DETAIL
description: This entity contains the investment products of the application  For each investment product, the attribute Application Detail Investment Pct specifies the percentage of the total available amount of money that should be used for this investment product.

name: ASIAN_OPTION
description: Asian options include European average price and average strike options.

name: ASIAN_OPTION_TYPE
description: A code for the type of Asian Option such as Average Price Option and Average Strike Option.

name: ASSET-BACKED_SECURITY_PRINCIPAL
description: This entity tracks the principal for an asset-backed security over time.

name: ASSET-BACKED_SECURITY_TYPE
description: A code for the type of asset-backed security such as mortgage-backed securities (MBS's), collateralized mortgage obligations (CMOs), and collateralized debt obligations (CDOs).

name: AVERAGE_PRICE_OPTION
description: An average price option is an option whose payoff is the difference between the strike price and the average price of the underlying asset during the averaging period.

name: AVERAGE_STRIKE_OPTION
description: An average strike option is an option whose strike price is set to the average price of the underlying asset at the end of the averaging period.

description: A classification of a barrier option. description: Captures the components of an organization's benefit plan. Examples include life insurance, pension, and vacation.

description: The status or conditions that can be assigned to a BENEFIT PLAN OPTION such as active, inactive, pending, or canceled.

name: BEST_OF_OPTION
description: A put or call option on the best or worst return of two or more securities or indexes for a given measurement period.

name: BINARY_OPTION
description: A binary option is a type of option where the payoff is either some fixed amount of some asset or nothing at all. name: BOND
description: A bond is a debt security, in which the authorized issuer owes the holders a debt and is obliged to repay the principal and interest (the coupon) at a later date, termed maturity. name: BOND_DELIVERY_FORM_TYPE
description: Categorization of delivery forms.  Examples: - Book entry - Registered - Bearer

description: A percentage of the face or principal amount that remains fixed over the entire investment period.

name: BOND_FLOATING_INTEREST_RATE
description: A bond interest type that is adjusted periodically based upon on a predefined formula, which is typically linked to an index.

name: BOND_FUTURES
description: A bond future is a contractual obligation for the contract holder to purchase or sell a bond on a specified date at a predetermined price. A bond future can be bought in a futures exchange market and the prices and dates are determined at the time the future is purchased.

description: Bonds that have no periodic interest payments and the investor receives a single payment at maturity equal to the purchase price + interest earned, compounded semiannually at the original interest rate.  These are known as zero coupon bonds.

name: BOND_PUT_SCHEDULE
description: This is a list of dates on which the holder of the bond can sell it back to the issuer. The list includes dates and prices.

name: BOND_REDEMPTION
description: The return of an investor's principal in a fixed income security, such as a preferred stock or bond, or the sale of units in a mutual fund. name: BOND_TO_EQUITY_CONVERSION

name: AD

description: This entity identifies the specific reason for an adjustment within an ADJUSTMENT TYPE. name: ADMINISTRATION_ROUTE_TYPE
description: Describes the route of administration for a drug.  Examples: - Oral - Intravenous - Intramuscular - Topical

description: This entity identifies a type of ALERT EVENT such as notifications that scheduled maintenance have been performed or that scheduled testing has been done. description: Identifies the source of admission. name: AFTER_TAX_CHARITABLE_CONTRIBUTION
description: An after-tax deduction for a charitable contribution, such as United Way.

name: AFTER_TAX_SAVINGS_PLAN
description: A savings plan that consists of deductions from an associate's pay on an after-tax basis.

name: AGENT_APPLICATION_DETAIL
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY APPLICATION when the subtype indicator, Party Application Role Cd, indicates a relationship between an agent and an application.

name: AGENT_INDEPENDENCE_TYPE
description: The degree to which the agent is independent of the insurance company it represents such as employed, fully independent, and limited independence and tied.

name: AGENT_PARTICIPATION_TYPE
description: This minor entity translates the participation type codes into a description.  Examples of participation types are: - Branch manager - Primary sales agent - Apprentice sales agent

name: AGENT_REPORT
description: This entity is a subtype of AGENT APPLICATION DETAIL and provides additional information on the application, as noted by the agent.

name: AGE_DETERMINATION_TYPE
description: A code for whether the age was determined based on the next birthdate or the last birthdate.

name: ALARM_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the alarm type code into a description.

name: ALERT_PRIORITY_TYPE
description: The priority or urgency level of an ALERT EVENT.  Examples could include: - Advisory and immediate - Low, mid, high, top, and lowest - Minor, moderate, severe, extreme, and life-threatening

name: ALERT_RESOLUTION_TEXT
description: This entity identifies unstructured textual comments related to the resolution of an ALERT EVENT, for example, initial comments from the person investigating the alert or feedback from conversations concerning the alert.

name: ALERT_SETUP
description: This entity sets the standard business rules that would cause an ALERT EVENT to occur. The

description: This entity identifies the standard comments that should be included in any ALERT EVENT triggered by an ALERT STANDARD TRIGGER, for example, a canned textual statement of the type of conditions that have occurred and a separate text stating the priority of the alert. These textual statements can app

name: ALERT_SETUP_CONDITION
description: This entity identifies the conditions that would cause the creation of an ALERT EVENT. The actual conditions are stored in an SQL statement as the conditions could rely on actual attribute values.  Example: - Issue an alert if a financial transaction is above $10,000.

name: ALERT_SETUP_NOTIFICATION_LEVEL_TYPE
description: The code used to represent the level of the party to be notified such as is the primary person for first level alert, second level alert, escalation level alert, or should be simply copied on the alert.

name: ALERT_STANDARD_TRIGGER
description: This entity identifies a type of ALERT EVENT that was triggered by an ALERT SETUP.

name: ALERT_TRIGGER_SUBTYPE
description: This entity identifies whether the ALERT EVENT is triggered by an alert that was set up or by some other means such as an alert created by an external system or piece of equipment.

name: ALERT_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of alert. For online banking, these could be password change, username change, suspended access, tax payment reminder, or unusual account activity.

name: ALERT_WEIGHTING_VALUE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the currency cost of an alert such as cost of food expiring on a shelf, cost of scrap, and cost of downtime.

name: AMBULATORY_PATIENT_GROUP_TYPE
description: A system used to classify patients into nearly 300 pathology groups rather than the 14,000 International Classification of Diseases. Ambulatory Patient Groups (APGs) provide a means of packaging services during a visit into a single unit of payment.

name: AMORTIZATION_METHOD_TYPE
description: This reference entity contains the method or type of gradual and periodic reduction (amortization) of any amount, such as the periodic write-down of the cost of an intangible asset or periodic payment of debt.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL
description: Describes a process used to predict, cluster, or classify information. Typically, used in data mining and knowledge discovery.  Example: - Customer scoring and segmentation, and a model that describes the propensity of a customer to engage in a particular activity.  Modeling note: This modeling is d

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates specific documents with the analytical model such as regulations, model governance, or standards documents. If necessary a role code can be added to track the role the document has with the analytical model.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_GROUP
description: This entity groups models for various reasons. It was created to support Basel II Credit Risk so that business users can quickly locate a model by first going to the group. name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_RUN_REVIEW
description: This entity tracks reviews made of the results of the execution of an analytical model such as the calculation of Probability of Default (PD).

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_STATUS
description: The status of a model over time.  Examples: - Active - Inactive - In test

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_TO_GROUP
description: This is the association of an analytical model to an analytical model group. This entity allows a group to contain many models and a model to belong to more than one group.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_VALUE
description: This entity contains the possible output values for the analytical model. The domains of the model could be a range or an amount. A given model can have many possible valid values.

name: ANIMAL
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes an animal.

name: ANIMAL_BREED_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the animal breed code into a description.

name: ANIMAL_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the animal type code into a description.

name: APPLICANT_FRAUD
description: A type of application fraud that is fraudulent by the applicant.

name: APPLICANT_INTERVIEW_RESULT_TYPE
description: This is the result of the interview with an applicant as related to the position applied for. Examples include scheduled, canceled, rescheduled, no-show, and completed.

name: APPLICANT_RÉSUMÉ
description: The résumé of the applicant, also known as a CV. When integrating into an industry data model that has a document subject area use the foreign key Résumé Document Id as the foreign key to a subtype of that data model's document entity. This integration may cause some attributes in APPLICANT RÉSUMÉ t

name: APPLICATION
description: This entity identifies all applications for a financial institution product, for which a PARTY needs to qualify. name: APPLICATION_ACTIVITY
description: This entity tracks the application activity changes over time including what has happened and what will happen such as planned dates, for example, planned review date.

name: APPLICATION_ACTIVITY_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the activity of the application such as receive application, verify assets and liabilities, do credit scoring, call employer, verify fire insurance, approve application, fund loan, close application, and establish account.

name: APPLICATION_CHECKLIST
description: This entity contains a checklist of items to validate as part of the application approval process. name: APPLICATION_CHECKLIST_ITEM_TYPE
description: A code for each item that needs to be validated from the application such as income, number of children, number of cars, value of property, and credit risk score.

name: APPLICATION_CHECKLIST_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of validating this item for this application.

name: APPLICATION_DOCUMENT
description: This entity identifies the documents that are associated with an application such as income tax document or pay stub to support the income specified on the application, or a passport to support proof of citizenship.

name: APPLICATION_FORM
description: The list of valid printed business forms available for use when documenting the application information for a specific product such as a loan or insurance application.

name: APPLICATION_FORM_QUESTION
description: This entity identifies the questions on the form. There is one instance for each question for a given form.

name: APPLICATION_FORM_QUESTION_TYPE
description: This associative entity contains the valid combinations of application forms and question types.

name: APPLICATION_FRAUD_CASE
description: This is a case that involves researching potentially fraudulent activity related to an application for products or services such as insurance, loan, or credit card.

name: APPLICATION_FRAUD_TYPE
description: A classification of the type of application fraud such as identity theft or first party fraud (misrepresentation of information on the application by the applicant).

name: APPLICATION_IDENTITY_THEFT
description: A type of application fraud that is due to identity theft.

name: APPLICATION_METRIC
description: This entity contains any kind of metric reported on the application. For example, for a mortgage loan it could be the loan to value ratio, the requested mortgage amount, anticipated down payment, and interest rate.

name: APPLICATION_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of metric such as loan to value ratio, the requested mortgage amount, anticipated down payment, and interest rate.

name: APPLICATION_PERFORMANCE_RATING
description: This entity captures information regarding the standardized user rating. In the USA, this would typically be the VNU/Nielsen rating.

name: APPLICATION_QUESTION_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the response to the question on the application.

name: APPLICATION_QUESTION_TYPE
description: The code for the type of application question, such as: - Income type question - Recreational sports type question - Education type question

name: APPLICATION_RELATED
description: This entity identifies relationships between applications and identifies the type of relationship. An example would be one application replaces, supplements, or is part of another application. There is one instance for each application-application relationship.

name: APPLICATION_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of relationship between two applications such as replaces, supplements, and is part of.

name: APPLICATION_REVIEW_METHOD_TYPE
description: This identifies the method used to review the application such as manual review, automated or combination.

name: APPLICATION_SCORE
description: This entity maintains the application scores. This entity has the application score value that is calculated outside of this system. name: APPLICATION_SECOND_SOURCE_XREF
description: This entity captures information regarding second source review of information relating to content being shown on the primary source.

name: APPLICATION_STATUS
description: The application status history entity tracks the application status changes over time.

name: APPLICATION_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the reason for the account status such as credit score, income, insurance, or did not meet conditions of product. It can also be used to explain why an application was accepted that did not appear to meet requirements.

name: APPLICATION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the account status type such as open-active, on hold pending approval, closed-accepted, or closed-rejected.

name: APPLICATION_TEXT
description: This entity contains any text associated with this application such as applicant comments or underwriting/review text.

name: APPLICATION_TYPE
description: A minor entity to indicate whether this is an application for a product or for a product feature.

name: APPLICATION_UNDERWRITE_EXCEPTION
description: This associative entity links applications with underwriting requirement type codes, to identify which underwriting requirements are not needed for this application.

name: APPLICATION_UNDERWRITE_REQUIREMENT
description: This associative entity links applications with underwriting requirement type codes, to identify which underwriting requirements apply to this application.

name: APPLICATION_UNDERWRITE_REQUIREMENT_STATUS
description: This entity contains the results or status leading up to the results of the underwriting decision for this requirement.

name: APPLICATION_UNDERWRITE_REQUIREMENT_TEXT
description: This entity captures any comments about this requirement for this application.

name: APPORTIONMENT_VERSION_TYPE
description: This entity contains the various ways that indirect expense amounts can be apportioned to the account. The various ways (or views) are customer, product, and organization.

name: AP_RECURRING_EXPENSE
description: This entity is a subtype of AP INVOICE. It is one of four subtypes. The other three are AP REIMBURSABLE EXPENSEs, AP RECURRING EXPENSE, and OTHER INVOICE EXPENSEs. AP REIMBURSABLE EXPENSE pertains to expenses submitted for reimbursement via employee expense reports. Expense reports cover the purcha

description: This entity contains AR scheduled payment activity information. There is one instance for each scheduled payment for each activity type and each occurred date. name: AR_COLLECTION_ACTIVITY_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the types of AR COLLECTION ACTIVITY, for example, dispute, customer contacted, and follow-up.

name: ASSOCIATION
description: Associations are external organizations that are not legal entities. Examples include joint accounts, clubs, and college graduating classes.

name: ASSOCIATION_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of association such as joint account, social club, golf club, and graduating class.

name: ASSUMPTION_SET
description: This entity identifies the assumption set that was used as input to the analytical model. description: This captures information regarding online audio play actions. name: AUDIO_PLAY_RADIO_STATION_XREF

name: AUTHORIZATION_APPROVAL_TYPE
description: Indicates the outcome of the review of the authorization request.  Examples: - Total request approved - Partial request approved - Alternative plan given - Denied

name: AUTHORIZATION_EXCEPTION_REASON
description: This entity identifies the various service authorization exception codes. name: AUTHORIZATION_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of authorization for access to this agreement such as pin code, thumb print, or palm scan.

name: BACKLOG_TEMPORAL
description: This entity/table demonstrates the high-level design for a bitemporal implementation alternative where rows are never updated. Changes are accomplished by the insertion of a canceling row followed by a replacement row.

name: BALANCE_CATEGORY_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the balance categories such as purchase balance, balance transfer, cash advance balance, asset balance, or liability balance. It can also designate a tier level if amounts are tracked by a balance tier.

name: BALANCE_CATEGORY_USE_TYPE
description: A code that describes how a balance category is used such as for credit card balance segmentation purposes or deposit agreement balance tiering (a balance in a certain range has a given interest rate).

name: BALANCE_RATE_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the types of rates such as simple rate, compound rate, rate adjusted for day basis, insurance rate, and more.

name: BALANCE_SHEET_TYPE
description: This is a code that describes whether the type is on or off the balance sheet. An example of an off-balance sheet type is float.  Code values are: - On (most common) - Off - Neither

name: BANKERS_ACCEPTANCE
description: A banker's acceptance, or BA, is a promised future payment, or time draft, which is accepted and guaranteed by a bank and drawn on a deposit at the bank. name: BANKRUPTCY_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the type of bankruptcy such as Chapter 7 or Chapter 11 (American classification).

name: BANK_DRAFT
description: A draft is a payment order in writing directing one party (payor) to pay another party (payee) a specified sum of money. A check is a type of draft that is payable when presented. Drafts may also be payable at future dates (e.g., time draft).

name: BEFORE_TAX_MEDICAL_INSURANCE
description: Medical insurance copay that consists of deductions from an associate's pay on a before-tax basis.

name: BEFORE_TAX_SAVINGS_PLAN

name: BLOCK_JAPAN
description: A district consists of blocks referred to as "banchi."

name: BOFD_CHECK_IMAGE
description: This entity is a subtype to CHECK IMAGE, and contains attributes that apply only to checks received at the BOFD (Bank of First Deposit).

name: BONUS
description: This entity contains information about an ASSOCIATE's bonus, a form of variable earning usually tied to achievement of a goal and paid as a lump sum.

description: This code captures information regarding the types of breadcrumbs used as navigation aids in user interfaces. name: BREAK_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the type of break utilized in this placement.

name: BUY_SELL_TYPE
description: This is a code to indicate whether this is a buy agreement or a sell agreement.

name: CAPACITY_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the type of channel capacity such as maximum, minimum, and limit.

name: CARD
description: This entity identifies all the cards that can be used with accounts held by this financial institution. There is one instance for each physical card issued. name: CARD_ASSOCIATION_TYPE
description: A code that classifies a card by the card association that develops the product for card issuers. Examples are Master Card, VISA, and American Express.

name: CARD_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code that classifies the card into major types such as debit or credit. It is also a category discriminator.

name: CART_ACTION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the type of shopping cart event the visitor experienced.  Examples: - Add - Remove - View

name: CASE_AMOUNT
description: This entity contains amounts related to the case such as the amount of the fraud, the amount recovered, the amount written off, and adjustments.

name: CASE_AMOUNT_TYPE
description: The type of amount related to the case such as amount of fraud, amount of any write-offs of principal or interest, amount of any adjustments such as credits or transfers.

name: CASE_CATEGORY_TYPE
description: A classification of the case such as insurance claim research, credit card transaction fraud, and application fraud. This is used as a category discriminator.

name: CASE_DETAIL
description: A case is a business process that involves managing the research of an activity that has happened. name: CASE_DOCUMENT
description: This entity contains information about documents that may support or be the result of this case. These can include police reports, field agent reports, photos, and testimonies.

name: CASE_RESOLUTION_TYPE
description: A code for the resolution of the case such as fraud confirmed and handed over to legal authorities, not fraudulent, and in process with no resolution.

name: CASE_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to this case such as the probability that this case is fraudulent. The score can change over time as more information is collected and the model is rerun.

name: CASE_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status of this case over time.

name: CASE_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the type of status such as in process or resolved.

name: CASE_TEXT
description: This entity contains textual notes about the case such as field notes and research notes.

name: CASE_TYPE
description: This is another classification of this case such as credit card fraud, claim fraud, application fraud, identity theft, and application misrepresentation.

name: CASH_MANAGEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity is used as a category discriminator for cash management agreements.

description: This identifies the type of certificate of medical necessity.  Examples include: - Ambulance - Chiropractic (spinal manipulation) - Oxygen therapy - DMERC - Home health

name: CERTIFICATION
description: Certifications that are earned through completion of training or meeting other criteria required to achieve qualification. description: This entity represents those certifications of medical necessity.

description: This identifies the type of certificate of medical necessity.  Examples include: - Ambulance - Chiropractic (spinal manipulation) - Oxygen therapy - DMERC - Home health
