name: PURCHASE_REQUISITION_LINE_ASSIGNMENT
description: This entity identifies the VENDOR PO LINEs that should be fulfilling one or more PURCHASE REQUISITION LINEs.

name: PURCHASE_REQUISITION_LINE_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a PURCHASE REQUISITION LINE over time.

name: PURCHASE_REQUISITION_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a PURCHASE REQUISITION over time.

name: PURCHASE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies whether a purchase account is to be associated the merchant categories allowed for purchases or if the account is to be associated the merchant categories that are restricted for purchases.

name: QUERY_STRING_FIELD_TYPE
description: This entity provides descriptive information regarding the types of contents stored in QUERY STRING FIELD NAME.

name: QUERY_STRING_FIELD_VALUE
description: This is the domain of parameter values that may appear in the query string of the URL for a web page.  Example: - For location, the names of retail stores such as WestSide Grocery or Mountain Ridge Suppliers.

name: QUESTION
description: Details a specific question or item contained in a survey. A question may be reused in more than one survey. Also classifies the question and its format.  Examples: - How many dependents do you have? - Are you currently under treatment for diabetes? - What is your current yearly income? - Which one

name: QUESTIONNAIRE
description: A specific predefined formal, controlled, or structured set of questions where specific responses are solicited, and responses (typically) are constrained to selecting one or more of several choices presented. Provision is also made for free-form responses to questions.  In the modeling presented, a

name: QUESTIONNAIRE_CATEGORY
description: This classifies a questionnaire into a higher-level grouping.  Examples: - General quality survey - Customer satisfaction survey - New item launch survey - Market research survey

name: QUESTIONNAIRE_QUESTION
description: The set of questions in a questionnaire and the order in which they are displayed.

name: QUESTION_CATEGORY
description: Classifies the topic or category of a question.  Examples: - Income - Products - Dependents - Services - Education - Customer satisfaction

name: QUESTION_FORMAT_TYPE
description: The type of question represented, for example, multiple-choice, yes/no, and open-ended.

name: QUOTA_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of quota that an employee has such as number of customers, number of accounts, number of transactions, and number of sales of a product.

name: RANK_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the prioritizing of each context on a web page; a web page may have multiple contexts with each having multiple functions.  Examples: - Primary - Secondary

name: RAW_LAND
description: The entity that provides details for the raw land accounts. Raw land is a type of a nondepreciable asset.

name: READER
description: This entity captures information regarding online applications that enable visitors to consume (read/view) content.

name: REAL_ESTATE
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes the real estate.

name: REAL_ESTATE_DETAIL
description: This entity represents the attributes of the real estate that may change over time.

name: REAL_ESTATE_REBUILD_AMOUNT
description: This entity tracks the history of rebuilding amounts of a real estate construction.

name: REAL_ESTATE_RIGHTS_TYPE
description: A code for the modification rights to this property such as building, water, and utilities.

name: REAL_ESTATE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the real estate type code into a description.

name: REAL_ESTATE_ZONE_TYPE
description: A code for how the real estate is zoned for usage such as commercial, residential, and commercial residential.

name: RECEIPT
description: This entity identifies an acknowledgment that a specified article or shipment of merchandise has been received. The RECEIPT can have one or more RECEIPT LINEs.

name: RECEIPT_LINE
description: This entity identifies a single line on a RECEIPT, which shows the received INTERNAL ASSET TYPE, quantity, and unit of measure for the quantity.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_DOCUMENT
description: Document that records details of items delivered from VENDORs and suppliers, for matching to items ordered on a VENDOR PO.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_DOCUMENT_TYPE
description: This entity defines a collection of information. For example, transport documents can include documents such as manifests, bills of lading, and import/export documents. Transport documents can be associated with a conveyance over one or many legs of the trip.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_INSPECTION
description: Records the status and results of a quality inspection performed on a RECEIPT LINE.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_QUALITY_TYPE
description: Defines the possible levels of quality that can be assessed to a RECEIPT LINE during inspection, for example, good, pass, and fail.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a RECEIPT LINE over time.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the receipt line status.  Examples: - Complete - Partial - Awaiting inspection

name: RECEIPT_LINE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies whether the RECEIPT LINE is associated to an order or to a purchase order.

name: RECEIPT_LINE_UNIQUE_ITEM_INSTANCE
description: This entity defines detailed specific information on a receipt of a uniquely identifiable internal asset type. For example, the receipt line may show the receipt of a quantity of three for a given internal asset type. Associated to that receipt line, would be three RECEIPT LINE UNIQUE ITEM INSTANCEs

name: RECEIPT_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a receipt over time.

name: RECEIPT_STATUS_TYPE
description: This lists the possible status types for a receipt. Possible values are pending, open, on hold, PO match, partial, and uninvoiced.

name: RECEIPT_TERM
description: This entity identifies the PO TERMs and/or conditions that are associated with a RECEIPT.

name: RECEIVABLE
description: This entity is a subtype of PARTY ASSET and describes the balance due from a business customer's debtor.

name: RECEIVABLE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of receivable such as revolving credit and corporate credit.

name: RECEIVED_QUANTITY
description: This entity identifies the actual quantity of INTERNAL ASSET TYPEs received from a planned shipment. Differences in the INTERNAL ASSET TYPE quantity in the planned shipment and the RECEIVED QUANTITY would identify shrinkage, damage during transit, and pilferage.

name: RECEIVED_QUANTITY_TYPE
description: The code assigned to a type of quantity received, for example, container, primary unit of measure, and received unit of measure.

name: RECEIVER_USER_SETTING
description: Captures information regarding the user setup values for the device.

name: RECOGNIZED_HOLIDAY
description: This entity associates a GEOGRAPHICAL AREA HOLIDAY with a GREGORIAN DATE.  Example: - Easter Sunday occurs every year in the USA, but not on the same day every year. This entity allows you to set specific calendar dates with the GEOGRAPHICAL AREA's HOLIDAY.

name: RECOVERY_STATUS_CHANGE_REASON
description: The reason this default recovery status changed.  Examples: - Foreclosure process is completed - Customer agreed to pay - Legal title of collateral being disputed

name: RECOVERY_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of collecting the owed amounts.  Examples: - Customer has agreed - In foreclosure process - In process of recovery/repossession - Recovery closed item fully recovered - Recovery closed item partially recovered - Recovery closed

name: REFERENCE_RATE_TYPE
description: A reference rate is a rate that determines pay offs in a financial contract and that is outside the control of the parties to the contract. It is often some form of LIBOR rate, but it can take many forms, such as a consumer price index, a house price index, or an unemployment rate. Parties to the co

name: REFERRAL
description: This entity is used to capture information about a customer's previous browsing history prior to making a web visit. As part of customer's previous history, only the immediate previous Uniform Resource Locator (URL) information is preserved.  For example, if a customer browsed aol->yahoo->clothing>w

name: REFERRAL_DIRECTORY
description: Information about an internet directory listing that a customer used for accessing a web site.  Example: - For instance a customer could access yahoo and then go to the 'business section' and then to 'wholesalers' to finally select 'Wholesaler A.' The corresponding directory listing information will

name: REFERRAL_SEARCH
description: An entity used to capture the outcome of an internet search that was in turn used by a customer to access a web site.  Example: - If you conduct search on yahoo for blue sweaters, the search term is embedded in the new URL created (www.yahoo.com/?p=blue+sweaters). If the search results in an enterpr

name: REFERRAL_SUBTYPE
description: This is an entity used for classifying referrals into various subtypes.  Examples: - Email referral - External location

name: REFERRING_SITE
description: An electronic site refers to an external web site such as www.yahoo.com or a proprietary site developed for subscribers such as the AOL system.

name: REFERRING_SITE_TYPE
description: This is the code used for classifying different types of web sites such as portals, aggregators, and ISPs.

name: REINSURANCE_COMPANY
description: The company that buys the insurance risk from the insurance company thereby assuming the risk.

name: REINSURANCE_PLAN_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the reinsurance plan type code into a description.  Examples: - Quota share (proportional) - Surplus share (proportion) - Per risk XOL (nonproportional – excess of loss) - Per occurrence XOL (catastrophe)

name: REINSURANCE_RESTRICT_ROLE_TYPE
description: Describes the type of restriction this subject has on the reinsurance agreement such as: - Is included in agreement - Is excluded from agreement

name: REINSURANCE_TRIGGER_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the reinsurance trigger type code into a description.  Examples: - Risks attaching - Losses occurring

name: REINSURANCE_UNDERLYING_COVERAGE
description: If the reinsurance agreement is only for certain coverages within policies (and not the entire policy) then this entity identifies those coverages for given policies for a given insurable interest that are covered by the reinsurance agreement.

name: REMEDIATION_PLAN_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity tracks the status of the remediation plan.  Examples: - Remediation plan established - Remediation plan in process - Remediation plan was able to prevent default - Remediation plan had no effect

name: REMEDIATION_PLAN_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the kinds of remediation plans to mitigate the risk of an agreement not meeting its terms.  Examples: - Put onto a payment plan - Debt counseling - Fee reduction - Renegotiate term length - Refinance

name: REPLENISH_MEDIUM_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of replenishment medium such as cash, stamps, and tickets.

name: REPORTING_PROJECT
description: An aggregate PROJECT used for reporting purposes that is different than the PROJECT identifier that is commonly used in the enterprise.

name: REPURCHASE_TRADING_BASIS_TYPE
description: Indicates if the repo is made on term or open basis.

name: REQUEST_PLACEMENT_BROADCAST
description: This entity captures information regarding broadcast platform request for the advertisement placement. The broadcast platform covers output platforms such as cinema, radio, and television.

name: REQUEST_PLACEMENT_INTERACTIVE
description: This entity captures information regarding the placement of digital ads on interactive devices.  Examples: - Radio - TV - Smartphone - ATM

name: REQUEST_PLACEMENT_OUTDOOR
description: This entity captures information regarding the display platform requested for outdoor advertisement placement. The outdoor platform covers billboards and advertisement displayed on vehicles.

name: REQUEST_PLACEMENT_PRINT
description: This is a subentity that identifies the beginning and ending page numbers for the actual delivery of an advertisement.

name: REQUEST_PLACEMENT_WEB
description: This entity captures information regarding placement of web ads.

name: RESPONSE_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of a promotion step for a party within a promotion cell.  Examples: - On hold - Active - Response received - Timeout

name: RESPONSE_TYPE
description: A code for the types of responses that could be expected from an action such as a promotion event.  Examples of a customer response to a campaign offer: - Accept offer - Reject offer - Submitted application - No response

name: RETAIL_POOL
description: This group of agreements represents the collection of retail accounts for Basel II calculation purposes.

name: RETIREMENT_PLAN
description: This is a subtype of BENEFIT PLAN OPTION. Various types of RETIREMENT PLANs may be offered including pension or defined contribution plans including 401(k) in the U.S.

name: RETROACTIVE_PAY
description: Pay for prior work time.

name: RETURN_DETAIL
description: This entity identifies a single transaction where the receiving PARTY sends back INTERNAL ASSET TYPE(s) that were previously shipped.

name: RETURN_LINE
description: This entity identifies a specific INTERNAL ASSET TYPE within a return transaction. It is possible that the same INTERNAL ASSET TYPE might appear on different lines, for example, if there were multiple RETURN REASON TYPEs.

name: RETURN_LINE_STATUS
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a returned item over time.

name: RETURN_LINE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the defined types of RETURN LINE, such as quality reject, wrong product, and received too late.

name: RETURN_LINE_UNIQUE_ITEM_INSTANCE
description: When the INTERNAL ASSET TYPE is a unique item, the identifier needs to identify uniquely each instance of an INTERNAL ASSET TYPE. It may be preferable to use the item's serial number or RFID tag number as its Item Id.

name: RETURN_REASON_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the reason the order recipient returned an INTERNAL ASSET TYPE.  Examples: - Defective - Wrong item - Wrong size - Arrived too late

name: RETURN_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the possible statuses of a returned item such as received or in transit.

name: REVENUE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the types of revenue that may be earned on an account or product. Types include net interest revenue and sale of loan to secondary market.  Examples of advertisement order revenue include: - Clicks - Click-throughs - Conversions

name: RIGHTS_ISSUE
description: Right offered to existing shareholders to purchase new issue securities, often at a discounted price. Rights may be traded in secondary market.

name: ROADWAY
description: This subtype represents one direction for a road, highway, motorway, or street. Note that it only represents one direction for these areas. The opposite direction will be represented by a different instance of ROADWAY (but they will be linked via the LOCATOR RELATED entity).  Note that the road name

name: ROADWAY_SEGMENT
description: A roadway segment is a part of a roadway going one way. Roadway segments on the same roadway can have different speed limits, no of lanes and so. One grouping of roadway segments will form the complete roadway.  Roadway segments will normally have the same name as the roadway.

name: ROOF_CONSTRUCTION_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the roof construction type code into a description.

name: ROUTING_TRANSIT_NUMBER
description: A routing transit number (RTN) or ABA number is a nine-digit code, used in the United States, which, for instance, appears on the bottom of negotiable instruments such as a check that identifies which financial institution it is drawn upon. This code is also used by the Automated Clearinghouse to pr

name: RXNORM_CODE
description: This entity holds RxNorm concept names and sources. It is based on RxNorm File RXNCONSO.RRF.  There is exactly one row in this file for each atom (each occurrence of each unique string or concept name within each source vocabulary) in RxNorm, that is, there is exactly one row for each unique RXAUI i

name: SALES_ACTIVITY_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the various types of sales activities.  Examples: - Send literature and follow up with phone calls - Invite to free workshop - Utilize references - Network and personal contacts

name: SALES_METHOD_TYPE
description: A code for the primary sales approach being used such as: - Send literature and follow up with phone calls - Invite to free workshop - Utilize references - Network and personal contacts

name: SALES_PROGRAM
description: This entity captures information regarding the specific sales program or initiative being used with this opportunity.  Examples: - Cross-sell or upsell deposit products - Cross-sell or upsell loan products - Consolidation loans - Target college loans - Target first time home buyers - Refinance oppor

name: SALES_PROGRAM_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding sales program types.  Examples: - Cross-sell or upsell deposit products - Cross-sell or upsell loan products - Consolidation loans - Target college loans - Target first time home buyers - Refinance opportunities

name: SALES_STAGE
description: The stage in the life cycle of the selling process.  Examples: - Received RFP - Planning first call - First call completed - Planning face-to-face meeting - Preparing proposal - Proposal submitted - Decision made

name: SALES_STAGE_PHASE_TYPE
description: A code for the for this stage in the life cycle from a sales perspective such as: - Unspecified - Lead discovery - Working the deal - Closing - Lost deal

name: SALES_STAGE_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the status of this sales stage such as: - Defining - Setting up - In final steps - Completed

name: SALUTATION_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of salutation such as 'Dear <first name>, Dear Mr. <last name>, or Dear Ms. <last name>.

name: SANCTION_TYPE
description: A categorization of restrictions that can be imposed on a provider based on performance and licensing limitations.

name: SCENARIO_TRIAL_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies this scenario as either a final run or a trial run. Trials can be run many times during the month but there is usually one final for a given time period.

name: SCHEDULED_INSTRUCTOR
description: Represents instructors who are assigned to lead the course. The modeling permits more than one instructor per each course, as needed.

name: SCHEDULE_GROUP_TYPE
description: This is a code for a grouping of time/scheduling methods.  Examples: - Business hours - Operational hours

name: SCORE_TYPE
description: This is a classification of the score such as FICO, FICO Bankruptcy Score, FICO Small Business Scoring Service (SBSS), FICO Small Business Risk Portfolio Solution (SBRPS) score, Beacon (Equifax), and Delphi (Experian).

name: SCREEN_RESOLUTION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor viewing screen resolution:  Examples: - 320 x 200 - 640 x 240 - 800 x 480 - 768 x 1024 - 1280 x 1024

name: SCRIPTED_MESSAGE
description: This entity identifies scripts that the financial institution customer service representatives can use when trying to sell or service a customer.  The script ID relates to a text that guides the agent. A response to one script will trigger the next message depending on the response from the prior sc

name: SCRIPTED_MESSAGE_STATUS
description: This describes the status of the scripted message such as active or under development.

name: SCRIPTED_MESSAGE_STATUS_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the script status such as active and under development.

name: SCRIPTED_MESSAGE_TYPE
description: This minor entity defines the classification of the script such as generic sales script for any product, loan sales script, deposit sales script, fraud prevention script, and past due script.

name: SEARCH_BY_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the search by selection made by the visitor. This represents the value selected in the search dropdown list.

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SYSTEM
description: This entity captures information regarding web search engine systems used by online visitors.  Examples: - Yahoo - MSN - Google

name: SEARCH_ENGINE_SYSTEM_TYPE
description: This code captures information pertaining to the visitor's search engine system type being utilized.  Examples: - Yahoo - MSN - Google

name: SEARCH_MATCH_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the type of match used on the keyword or phrase.

name: SEARCH_REFINEMENT_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding search refinement types. It provides information regarding the name of the refinement type.

name: SEARCH_TYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the type of search performed.  Examples: - Paid - Organic

name: SEASON
description: A contiguous period of time of interest to the enterprise. Can be climate and/or marketing based, for example, summer and Christmas season.

name: SECTION_CONTAINS_SECTION
description: This is a specialized relationship between text sections where one text section contains another text section.  For example, for terms within a phrase, the phrase of "the plaintiff of Jill" contains the terms of Jill and Plaintiff. The role of the term in the phrase is also identified. In our exampl

name: SECTION_CONTAINS_SECTION_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the possible role one section has with another section when the section is contained in another section.  For example, the phrase of "the plaintiff of Jill" contains the terms of Jill and Plaintiff. The role of the term in the phrase is also identified. In our example of "the

name: SECURITIES_ORIGINATION
description: These products assist the issuers of securities (businesses and governments) in creating their securities, and having them distributed to the investing public. The service may involve advising the issuer, purchasing securities and selling them (underwriting), or acting as an agent in marketing the s

name: SEGMENT_CRITERION
description: This associative entity identifies the criteria used to segment based on a scheme.

name: SEGMENT_PAGE_INTEREST_MAP
description: This entity links the web pages that a segment may be interested in.

name: SEGMENT_RELATIONSHIP_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason a segment is related to another. It is often because the segments will be grouped in a consolidation application.

name: SEGMENT_SITE_INTEREST_MAP
description: This entity links the web sites that a segment may be interested in.

name: SELECTION_CRITERION_TYPE
description: This entity identifies different criterion that can be used to segment a market such as income, age, length as customer, score, or profitability, for example, to segment a set of customers with income over $60,000 and age over 50.  This entity also contains the different criterion that can be used t

name: SELECTION_SET_CRITERION
description: This is a grouping of selection criteria for the purpose of selecting members of a list.

name: SELECTION_SET_FORMULA_TYPE
description: This is a textual description of any relationships between the selection criteria. This will contain formulas that explain complex Boolean relationships that exist between selection criterion, for example, Criterion 1 and either Criterion 2 or Criterion 3.

name: SERVICE_QUOTE_REQUEST_TYPE
description: This classifies the service request as a request for quote, a request for service or both.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST
description: This is a request for work to be performed by one party for another party. This is the highest level of work to be performed in a work breakdown structure. Service requests can include just a quote for service, the service itself, or both. This modeling can handle the requestor being the enterprise

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_ACTIVITY
description: This entity keeps track of past, current and planned actions associated with this service request. For example, if the service request is to do body work on a car as a result of an insurance claim, then the action could provide an estimate, perform work, or submit invoice.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_ACTIVITY_STATUS
description: This is the status of the action that is associated with the service request such as not yet started, in process, vendor declined work, or completed.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_ACTIVITY_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of activity that could be performed by the recipients of the service request such as 'estimating the cost of the request", "performing the request", or "service completed and bill submitted".

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_RELATED
description: This entity establishes a dependency between service requests such as one must be completed before the other starts.  Start and end dates can be added if you want to track the relationship over time.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_RELATED_ROLE
description: This is a code for the relationship of one service request to another service request such as "replaces" or "must be performed first".

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS
description: This is a history of the service request status from beginning to end. Examples include pending cost estimate, pending approval, work in process, work completed, service request not approved by enterprise, and vendor declined to perform work.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason for the status. For example, if the code is "Open On Hold," the reason may be "Pending Personnel Resources."

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This entity allows for more than one classification scheme for assigning status to the service request such as the status of work progress and the status of the quote for service.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the types of status of a service request. Examples include pending cost estimate, pending approval, work in process, work completed, service request not approved by enterprise, and vendor declined to perform work.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_SUBTYPE
description: This is a code that is used as a subtype discriminator for service requests such as a service request to service an insurance claim.

name: SERVICE_REQUEST_TYPE
description: This describes the type of service such as auto body repair, glass work, change lock, and towing.

name: SERVICE_TYPE
description: Identifies the type of pharmacy service provided.  Examples: - Rx billing - Service billing

name: SET_OF_BOOKS
description: The entity that indicates a collection of accounting transactions used by a company. A collection is typically referred to as a 'set of books.'

name: SET_OF_BOOKS_RELATED
description: This entity shows how one set of books rolls up to one or more higher level set of books for a given structure. It can also show how one set of books replaces another set of books. This entity allows for a set of books to be part of multiple set of book hierarchies where each hierarchy is a separate

name: SET_OF_BOOKS_RELATED_REASON
description: The code for the SET OF BOOKS RELATED REASON. Describes the reason two sets of books are related. For example, a GAAP set of books would be related to a tax set of books if they are for the same legal entity.

name: SET_OF_BOOKS_TYPE
description: This entity defines the type of SET OF BOOKS such as prime, U.S. GAAP, and statutory.

name: SEVERITY_TYPE
description: This is a code for the degree of severity of something that happened. Possible values include major requiring hospitalization, medium no hospitalization, medium emergency room only, or minor injuries.

name: SHARE_REPURCHASE
description: Offer by product issuing organization, typically equity issuer, to repurchase shares from existing shareholders.

name: SHOPPING_CART
description: This entity captures information regarding actions taken by visitors involving carts during their shopping experience.  Examples: - Shopping cart - Wish list cart

name: SHOPPING_SOURCE_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding source types for shopping activities.  Examples: - Affiliate - Banner ads - Email - Direct

name: SHOPPING_TOOL
description: This entity captures information regarding the tool used to assist visitors with their shopping experience. The tool provides suggestions regarding product selection characteristics.

name: SHOPPING_TOOL_TYPE
description: This entity captures information concerning the various types of shopping tools.  Examples: - Buyer's guide - Narrow by - Sort by - Compare items - Product image

name: SIC
description: A Standard Industry Classification is a statistical classification standard describing all establishments. It categorizes businesses by the type of business in which each they are engaged. Businesses engaged in the same activity, regardless of size or type of ownership, are given the same SIC code.

name: SIC_ECONOMIC_MEASURE
description: This entity identifies economic measures by industry classification by geographical area and by time. Various economic measures include the risk exposure for an industry and the expected long-term growth.

name: SIC_GROUP
description: This entity groups SIC codes into a higher level, for example, manufacturer, financial institution, and retailer.

name: SIGNATURE_SOURCE_TYPE
description: Indicates how the patient or subscriber authorization signature was obtained.  Examples: - Signed signature authorization form or forms for both HCFA-1500 Claim Form block 12 and block 13 are on file - Signed HCFA-1500 Claim Form on file - Signed signature authorization form for HCFA-1500 Claim Form

name: SITE
description: This entity identifies a physical or virtual site that is of interest. SITEs can be owned or leased by the company to support manufacturing, sales, distribution, and storage, and can belong to customers, vendors, suppliers, and partners. SITEs can contain other SITE. For example, a distribution cent

name: SITE_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This entity describes a classification scheme for the way things such as buildings, land, automobiles, and other objects are described.  For example, the scheme could be "square feet," "number of stories," "number of seats," or "color."

name: SITE_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme, this entity contains the possible values for that scheme.

name: SITE_COST
description: This entity denotes the planned and actual cost by operating cost type for a specific period of time.

name: SITE_DAILY_HOURS
description: Defines a set of scheduled hours for a group of sites for a specific date.  Examples: - Business hours for all branches in urban areas - Operational hours for all major branch sites.

name: SITE_DAY_OF_WEEK_HOURS
description: Defines a set of scheduled hours for a group of sites for a day of the week.  Examples: - Business hours for all branches in urban areas on Saturdays. - Operational hours for all major branches on Mondays.

name: SITE_MAJOR_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the types of site such as store, office building, internal facility, web site, sheltered area, vestibule, drive-up, lobby, and main area.

name: SITE_METRIC
description: This is a generic entity to contain metrics for sites such as square footage, number of conference rooms, and number of floors.  If the site is a weather station then this entity is used to capture the metrics associated with weather such as rainfall, temperature, snowfall, visibility, barometric pr

name: SITE_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code for the type of metric for this site such as square footage, number of conference rooms, and number of floors.

name: SITE_RELATED
description: This entity identifies the relationship between two SITEs. For example, one branch might be used as the replacement for another.  When there is a true hierarchical relationship, you can use the recursive relationship from SITE back to itself for relationships such as when a storage SITE exists withi

name: SITE_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the relationship of one site to another such as: - Site contains another site - Site replaces another site - Site is composed of another site

name: SITE_SCHEDULE_GROUP
description: This is a grouping of sites that share the same time-based operational measures. One instance is one group of sites. That group of sites is then classified based on whether they have the same business or operational hours.  Examples: - All sites that have the same business hours - All sites that hav

name: SITE_SCHEDULE_XREF
description: This is an assignment of a site to a group of schedules.

name: SITE_SITE_CLASS_XREF
description: This entity describes characteristics of the site such as: - Hours of operation - Square footage - Number of loading docks - Showroom floor size  This can change over time and the characteristics depend on the type of site.

name: SITE_STATUS
description: This entity keeps track of the status of a site over time such as being formed, formed, or discontinued.

name: SITE_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code for the type of status for a site such as being formed, formed, or discontinued.

name: SITE_TRAIT
description: A generic construct to describe characteristics of a SITE, for example, location operating hours, number of receiving docks, and refrigeration capability.

name: SITE_TRAIT_TYPE
description: This entity indicates the type of SITE TRAIT that is a higher-level classification for the trait as it relates to locations. For example, building related traits or occupancy related traits.

name: SITE_TRAIT_VALUE
description: The SITE TRAIT VALUE entity identifies the possible values for a site trait. Each trait value that exists across all locations will be represented in this entity.

name: SITE_TRAIT_XREF
description: This entity identifies the traits and characteristics associated with a specific site, for example, the number of teller slots, the number of stories, the number of closed offices, and the square footage.

name: SITE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the possible types of SITEs such as a branch, an administrative building, or a call center.

name: SITE_TYPE_XREF
description: This entity identifies all of the location types associated with a given SITE. For example, a SITE might be both a call center and a service center.

name: SKILL_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of proficiency or ability that that can be applied to a financial institution's employee. Examples would be sales, teller, and communication  At an individual level, skill is an art, trade, or technique, particularly one requiring use of the hands or body. It is

name: SOCIAL_CONSTRUCT_TYPE
description: This is a code for a type of social construct. A social construct is something (an idea, thought, concept, practice) created by a group of people. It is something that has its existence as a result of social interactions between and among people. Examples are marriage or money/currency.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_ACTIVITY_IMPRESSION_XREF
description: This entity links delivered ads to social media activities. It captures information regarding ads delivered during social media activities.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_AUTHOR
description: This entity captures information regarding the characteristics of authors who have posted on social media sites.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_AUTHOR_RANK
description: This entity captures information containing the usernames of the ten most prolific authors for this day, and the highest ranked authors for this day.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_CATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding social media site categories.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_CATEGORY_SCORE
description: This entity captures information regarding scores received by post within a given category.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_CATEGORY_XREF
description: This entity captures detail information regarding a specified social media site from the list of all social media sites.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_CONTENT_REVIEW
description: This entity captures information regarding reviews of the content that exist on the social media site.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_CONTENT_SOURCE
description: This entity captures information regarding sources utilized to obtain information regarding social media activities.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_GROUP
description: This entity captures information regarding the grouping of social media sites.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_INTERACTION
description: This entity captures information regarding the visitor social media activities. Activities include things such as posting messages on web pages.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_INTERACTION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding social media types being utilized by visitors.  Examples: - Message post - Retrieve social media site list - Social media site detail - Social media site results - Social media site content sources - Social media site posts - Social media site authors

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_KEYWORD_SUMMARY
description: This entity provides keyword statistics about visitor social media activities.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_LOGON
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor logons to their social media system accounts.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_RESULT
description: This entity captures result information regarding the specified social media site from the social media site list.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_RESULT_CATEGORY
description: This entity captures information regarding the categories available for specified social media interactions. The categories are areas of interest as specified by visitors to the social media site.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_RESULT_TOPIC
description: This entity captures information regarding the topics within social media result sets.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_SITE
description: This entity captures information regarding social media sites that have been visited.

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_STATUS
description: This entity captures information regarding statuses of social media site types. Examples can include "link failure" and "permission failure".  Examples: - HTTP 200 - HTTP 401 - HTTP 403 - HTTP 500

name: SOCIAL_MEDIA_STATUS_TYPE
description: This entity captures the types of social media statuses. They may be link failure related or permission failure related.  Examples: - HTTP 200 - HTTP 401 - HTTP 403 - HTTP 500

name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_AFFILIATION
description: This entity captures information regarding the various affiliations members maintain within social networks.

name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_AFFILIATION_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding types of affiliations members can have,  Examples: - Groups of friends - Relatives - Friends of relatives - Friends of friends - Coworkers - Schools - Professionals - Favorites - Likes

name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_MEMBER
description: This entity captures information regarding social network users. This includes blogs, movements, wall post, video uploading/viewing, music uploading/listening, and photo uploading/viewing.

name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_PROFILE
description: This entity captures information regarding visitor profile (demographics) information.

name: SOCIAL_NETWORK_SUMMARY_ACTIVITY
description: This entity provides statistics about visitor social network activity.

name: SOFTWARE
description: This entity describes a software application.

name: SORT_BY_VALUE_TYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding the visitors search sort by value selected.

name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_PANEL_CODE
description: This entity captures information regarding the enterprise's market code maps used to determine ratings.  The market code maps are codes used between local media systems and rating engine systems to calculate ratings.

name: SOURCE_SYSTEM_PROCESSING
description: This entity captures information regarding source system processing codes for page hits.  Examples: - Old method - Web beacon - Model status - Live log

name: SPECIALIZED_LENDING_TYPE
description: This a classification of lending instruments for Basel II reporting purposes, for example, project finance, object finance, commodities finance, income producing real estate, and high volatility commercial real estate. The specialized lending types are bank specific.

name: SPECIALTY_DRUG
description: Specialty drugs are a category of drugs created through advances in research, technology, and design. They are made up of complex molecules and include bioengineered proteins and blood derivatives. Specialty drugs target and treat specific complex conditions or illnesses such as cancer, rheumatoid a

name: SPECIALTY_TYPE
description: List of valid specialties describing the provider.  Examples: - Mechanic - Appraiser - Primary care - Pharmacy - Surgeon

name: SPECIAL_LENDING_SLOTTING_PARAMETER
description: This table lists the risk weights to be applied to specialized lending exposures under the IRB Slotting Approach.

name: SPECIAL_NEED_TYPE
description: Identifies a type of special need such as wheelchair access, sight, hearing, or speech needs.

name: SPECIAL_PROGRAM_TYPE
description: Indicates the special program under which the services rendered to the patient were performed.  Examples: - Early and Periodic Screening, Diagnosis, and Treatment (EPSDT) or Child Health Assessment Program (CHAP) - Physically handicapped children's program - Special federal funding - Disability - In

name: SPOT_TYPE
description: This is a code that indicates whether the price timing is spot or not, and if it is spot whether it is today or tomorrow.  Examples: - Not spot - Today - Tomorrow - Spot

name: STANDARD_COMMENT
description: A textual statement providing standard directions such as canned comments. STANDARD COMMENTs can be attached to application requests, claim submittals, and fraud notifications.

name: STANDARD_COMMENT_TYPE
description: This entity identifies the type of STANDARD COMMENT such as application submittal, claim request, or fraud notification.

name: STANDARD_PAY
description: Wage based on a per hour rate or a fixed salary that is paid at regular intervals.

name: STANDARD_RESULT_SET
description: This entity describes an outcome, consequence, or end result of a particular action, condition, or event.  Examples: - Testing of air particulate levels in a factory could result in a PM10 count of 42 - Humidity level inside a piece of equipment could be 37 degrees Fahrenheit -Viscosity level of a f

name: STANDARD_RESULT_SET_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the type of result set such as standard, goal, planned acceptable, planned unacceptable, and planned midrange.

name: STANDARD_RESULT_VALID_VALUE
description: This entity identifies the applicable values that can be associated to a STANDARD RESULT SET. A STANDARD RESULT SET can have a single valid value, many individual valid values, or a range of valid values. For example, measurement of humidity may be acceptable between 0% and 20%; measurement of inter

name: STANDARD_TEXT_PATTERN
description: A predefined pattern of text used to search EVENT TEXT.

name: STATE_TAX
description: This entity holds information about state taxes that employers are required to withhold from associate's pay. Types of state taxes vary depending on the employer's tax jurisdiction. Payroll withholding for state income tax is common in the U.S. for states with income tax. In some countries, Australi

name: STATION_OBSERVATION_XREF
description: This entity cross-references a list of weather observations provided by a given weather station. Additionally, information regarding completeness and accuracy of their supplied data can be captured at this level.

name: STATUTORY_RESPONSIBILITY
description: This is an obligation that is defined under some body of law (statute). The relevant body of law will also have terms for identifying the nature of the party (party classification) that comes under the purview or mandate of this set of laws.  The jurisdiction tells you where the law applies and who

name: STEP
description: This entity defines a theoretical or standard operation to be performed in the performance of a service. This is part of an overall workflow process.

name: STEP_ACTUAL_INPUT_OUTPUT
description: This entity contains the actual work products that are input and output to this step.

name: STEP_GROUP
description: This entity puts steps into groups such as all steps that require a certain skill set or that require offshore resources. These groupings can be used for analysis purposes such as to optimize the workflow process.

name: STEP_GROUP_TO_STEP
description: This entity assigns a step to a group of steps and allows for a step to be in many groups and a group to contain many steps. This grouping could be used for analysis purposes such as a grouping of all steps involving offshore resources or all steps that require a certain skill set.

name: STEP_PRIORITY_TYPE
description: This is a code for the priority of this step such as high, medium and low.

name: STEP_RELATED_ACTUAL
description: This relates one step to another step to show a sequence or dependency of steps for the actual workflow.

name: STEP_RELATED_ROLE
description: This is a code for the role that one workflow step has with another workflow step such as follows, is dependent on, is replaced by.

name: STEP_RELATED_STANDARD
description: This relates one step to another step to show a sequence or dependency of steps based on a standard.

name: STEP_SKILL_SET
description: This entity identifies the standard skill sets that are required for this step.

name: STEP_SPECIFICATION_STANDARD
description: This entity references the standard specifications that may influence the content of this step,

name: STEP_STANDARD_INPUT_OUTPUT
description: This entity contains the inputs and outputs for a step.

name: STEP_STATUS
description: This is the actual status of this step for this work process such as not yet started, in process, pending answers, completed.

name: STEP_STATUS_TYPE
description: This is a code for the status of a step such as not yet started, in process, pending answers, or completed.

name: STOCK
description: This entity includes all types of investment products related to ownership. The types are common stock, preferred stock, rights, and warrants.

name: STOCK_ISSUANCE
description: This entity contains the history of stock, such as additional issues and stock splits.

name: STOCK_ISSUE_DETAIL
description: This entity contains information about the stock from the perspective of the stock issuer.

name: STOCK_PURCHASE_PLAN
description: This is a subtype of BENEFIT PLAN OPTION. Various types of stock purchase plans may be offered including payroll based (PAYSOP), stock options, and employer funded discounted stock purchase plans.

name: STOCK_SHARE_CLASS_TYPE
description: A code for the share class such as Class A or Class B. Each class has different costs associated with buying, selling, and holding fund shares.  For example, from the perspective of availability: - Class A: Generally available through most investment dealers - Class B: Available only to investors pu

name: STOCK_SPLIT
description: A corporate action in which a company's existing shares are divided into multiple shares. Although the number of shares outstanding increases by a specific multiple, the total dollar value of the shares remains the same compared to presplit amounts, because no real value has been added as a result o

name: STOCK_TYPE
description: This entity is a classification of stock.  Examples: - Common stock - Preferred stock - Right - Warrant

name: STRATEGY
description: A business strategy is a series of steps to achieve the objective. They tell you how you are going to meet the objective. If the objective is to identify the top 10% likely to default then the strategy is how to do it such as identify the criteria and run a query against an integrated database.

name: STRATEGY_OBJECTIVE
description: This entity links the business strategy with the business objective. It allow for a strategy to have many objectives and for an objective to be for many strategies.

name: STRATEGY_TYPE
description: A code for the classification of the type of strategy used as a category discriminator. Examples include liquidity strategy, risk strategy, financial instrument strategy, and funding strategy.

name: STUDENT_ATTENDANCE
description: Records student attendance at a course presentation.  Examples: - Part 1 of a data warehousing course offered to 30 attendees. - A web training component on data modeling taken by a single student. - Company ethics course taught by two instructors to a large audience of students.

name: STUDENT_CARD
description: STUDENT CARD is a type of CREDIT CARD that provides card accounts to the students of an educational institution.

name: STUDENT_ENROLLMENT
description: This contains the list of associates enrolled in a specific course.

name: SUBJECT
description: This entity contains a generated identifier for subjects in the enterprise such as parties, agreements, and geographic areas. There is one instance for each subject value. For example, if the subject type is a geographical area then there is one instance for the subject value of California.  This wa

name: SUBJECT_TYPE
description: A classification of the subject such as: - Product - Product group - Party classification - Party group - Asset classification - Feature (coverage) - Geographic area  Each subject type corresponds to an entity in the data model.

name: SUBMISSION_CLARIFICATION_TYPE
description: Specifies that the pharmacist is clarifying the submission of the prescription.  Examples: - Not specified - No override - Other override - Vacation supply - Lost prescription - Therapy change - Starter dose - Medically necessary - Process compound for approved ingredients - Encounters - Other

name: SUBMISSION_TYPE
description: The type of submission for a PROCEDURE CODE, APG, or APC on a claim.  Examples: - Original submission - Repriced

name: SUBROGATION
description: A type of legal action. There is one instance for each subrogation legal action or filing.  Subrogation gives the insurer the right to take legal action against a third party responsible for a loss to an insured for which a claim has been paid.  The legal definition is a taking on of the legal right

name: SUBROGATION_ELIGIBILITY_REASON_TYPE
description: A code for the reason this claim is eligible for subrogation such as manufacturer's defect, product recall, insured vehicle not at fault, other insured vehicle not covered by same carrier, or insured at fault.

name: SUBROGATION_ELIGIBLE_TYPE
description: Indicates whether this claim is eligible for subrogation:  Values: - Is eligible - Is not eligible

name: SUBSCRIPTION_RIGHT
description: A security giving stockholders entitlement to purchase new shares issued by the corporation at a predetermined price (normally less than the current market price) in proportion to the number of shares already owned. Rights are issued only for a short period of time, after which they expire.

name: SUBSCRIPTION_WARRANT
description: A derivative security that gives the holder the right to purchase securities (usually equity) from the issuer at a specific price within a certain time frame. Warrants are often included in a new debt issue as a "sweetener" to entice investors.

name: SUPPLEMENTAL_FORM
description: Identifies the form the provider used to include supporting documentation (a standardized paper form) in electronic format.

name: SUPPLEMENTAL_FORM_RESPONSE
description: This contains the responses to the supplemental form provided with the professional claim service.

name: SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY_REPORT
description: Suspicious activity report ID identifies the statutory report that is sent out subsequent to identifying a fraud event.

name: SYSTEM_ABUSE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the types of financial system abuses such as kiting (taking advantage of float), stealing, lying, first party fraud, and second party fraud.

name: TACTIC
description: A tactic is a specific action step required to deliver on the strategy. Tactics are what you do and a strategy will have many tactics.  Examples: If strategy is identify the top 10% customers likely to default then the tactics could be define the criteria for the top 10% and another tactic is to dev

name: TARGETED_AMORTIZATION_CLASS
description: A type of credit derivative that is similar to a planned amortization class (PAC) in that it protects investors from prepayment; however, it is structured differently than a PAC. TACs protect investors from a rise in the prepayment rate or a fall in interest rates. They do not protect from a fall in

name: TARGET_CELL_TYPE
description: Indicates the intended type of recipients for a campaign cell.  Examples: - Party - Account - Access method - Market - Subscription

name: TASK
description: This entity describes the TASKs or activities that can make up the PROJECT.

name: TASK_ADJUSTMENT
description: TASK ADJUSTMENTs that apply to either a labor task or project task.

name: TASK_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason a TASK ADJUSTMENT TYPE was applied to a TASK ADJUSTMENT.

name: TASK_ADJUSTMENT_TYPE
description: Identifies the types of TASK ADJUSTMENTs, such as an adjustment to the quantity of labor hours.

name: TAX_BRACKET_TYPE
description: A code for the tax bracket a party is in which translates to a percentage. This can vary by country and can also be divided into one bracket for local taxes and another bracket for federal taxes.

name: TAX_LOT
description: A tax lot is a concept primarily in the United States where transactions involving the purchase of a security are grouped together because they are treated the same for tax purposes when sold. Usually, a "buy" order will create a tax lot for a given purchase date for a given security within an inves

name: TAX_LOT_METRIC
description: This entity contains metrics associated with a tax lot that can change over time. Examples of metrics include cost per share, number of shares, realized gain, short-term gain amount, long-term gain amount, and unrealized gain. These metrics are usually point-in-time metrics.

name: TAX_LOT_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of tax lot metric such as cost per share, cost basis, short-term gain, long-term gain, unrealized gain, and remaining share count.

name: TAX_METHOD_TYPE
description: This entity describes the different methods that can be chosen to tax gains such as LIFO, FIFO, average cost. This is used when deciding how to tax the gains from the sale of securities. In the United States, the concept of tax lots are used and a tax lot is associated with a taxation method.

name: TAX_STATUS_TYPE
description: A code that describes how this organization's income is taxed such as fully taxed, exempt, and charitable organization.

name: TAX_TYPE
description: A code that is assigned to a tax such as Swiss Retention Tax, New York State Sales Tax, or U.S. Federal Tax.

name: TECHNOLOGY_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the various types of technology that can be applied to items such as cards. Examples of these include smart card technology and standard magnetic strip technology.

name: TERMINATION_TYPE_JAPAN
description: Identifies whether this account has the concept of termination.

name: TERM_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of term such as fixed term, renewable term, or revolving term. If the agreement is revolving term (such as credit card) then there is no planned expiration date.

name: TEXT_DATASET
description: A type of TEXT SECTION that is an organized collection of information that typically will have a common theme such as a list of objects, results from a project, and a table of survey data.

name: TEXT_PARAGRAPH
description: A type of TEXT SECTION that is a self-contained unit of a discourse in writing dealing with a particular point or idea, or the words of an author. The start of a paragraph is indicated by beginning on a new line and ending without running to the next passage.  A paragraph can be as short as one word

name: TEXT_PATTERN_METHOD_TYPE
description: A code for the method through which a text pattern was identified.

name: TEXT_PATTERN_RESPONSE
description: Stores the occurrence of a STANDARD TEXT PATTERN within a set of EVENT TEXTs.

name: TEXT_PHRASE
description: A type of TEXT SECTION that is a group of words that functions as a single unit in the syntax of a sentence.  For example, "the house at the end of the street" is a phrase. It acts like a noun. It contains the phrase "at the end of the street," which acts like an adjective.  Most phrases have a "hea

name: TEXT_SECTION
description: This entity represents a piece of text that has gone through the first step of decomposition. A text section could be a set of paragraphs, a sentence, a phrase, or a word of text. This includes terms that are defined as "A word or group of words having a particular meaning." The raw text can be deco

name: TEXT_SECTION_RELATED
description: This entity identifies any relationships between pieces of TEXT SECTIONs such as when two TEXT TERMs are in the same TEXT SENTENCE or when a TEXT SENTENCE is part of a larger TEXT PARAGRAPH. It can also be used to identify the position of the small TEXT SECTION subtype within the larger TEXT SECTION

name: TEXT_SECTION_RELATED_REASON_SUBTYPE
description: This entity identifies the possible reasons why two pieces of text may be related such as when one TEXT SECTION is located within the parent TEXT SECTION or when one TEXT SECTION has the same meaning as another TEXT SECTION.  Examples: - Same meaning as - Replacement for - Includes - Part of - Missp

name: TEXT_SENTENCE
description: A type of TEXT SECTION that is a unit of language, characterized in most languages by the presence of a finite verb. For example, "The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog."  A sentence represents a string of words satisfying the grammatical rules of language.

name: TEXT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity identifies whether the TEXT SECTION is a complete block of writing, a single paragraph, a single sentence, a phrase, a term, or a clause.  This entity can be used to reconstruct the terms in a phrase, phrases in a sentence, sentences in a paragraph and paragraphs in a block of text.

name: TEXT_TAG
description: This entity is a type of TEXT SECTION that represents a tag that describes certain properties about the text that follows the text. It could be considered "metatext." For example, in the text "This text is bold and italic" the text enclosed in brackets <> are the tags.

name: TEXT_TERM
description: A type of TEXT SECTION that can be a word, word pair, or word group, that is used in specific contexts for a specific meaning.

name: TEXT_TYPE
description: This entity classifies text and is referenced in various entities in the model.

name: THERAPEUTIC_CLASS
description: Grouping of medications that are used to treat the same or similar conditions.  Examples: - Antibiotic - Antipsychotic - Antiasthmatic

name: THERAPEUTIC_CLASS_TYPE
description: A therapeutic classification type that groups therapeutic classes based on a standard or organization.  Example: - Generic = classify drugs according to most common use. - Specific = a very definitive classification system, for example, First Data Bank, and Medi-Span. - Standard = a classification a

name: THERAPEUTIC_SUBCLASS
description: Grouping of medications that are used to treat the same or similar conditions.  This is a subclass grouping within the larger therapeutic class  Examples: - Anti-inflammatory (within therapeutic class of analgesics) - Narcotic (within therapeutic class of analgesics) - Antianginal (within therapeuti

name: TIME_BAND
description: This entity represents an actual time band (row in a parameter table) for a given scheme or banding method.  For market risk, a time band may roll up to zones. name: TIME_BAND_CALCULATION
description: This entity contains risk metrics at the time band level.  Examples: - Vertical disallowance – once the instrument positions are slotted into the time bands then this information is derived from those positions in the band.

name: TIME_BAND_METRIC_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the type of metric that is calculated at the time band level. name: TIME_BAND_PARAMETER
description: This entity contains the parameters used to calculate interest rate risk using the duration method.  Examples are the risk weight and the assumed change in yield.  Refer to MRA Table 1 and 2 for interest rate risk; refer to Table 7 for commodity risk.  Examples: For interest rate risk: - Assumed yie

name: TIME_BAND_PARAMETER_TYPE
description: A code for the type of parameter for this time band.  Examples: Interest rate risk: - Assumed yield change rate - Risk weight rate  Commodity risk: - Spread rate

name: TIME_BAND_RELATED
description: This entity shows relationships between bands that are outside the hierarchy of bands within a scheme. This entity also relates time bands to zones.  For example, in market risk, the horizontal disallowance is between zones, which is a type of band.  Reference Table 2 in MRA for interest rate risk.

name: TIME_BAND_ROLE_TYPE
description: The reason why one time band is related to another time band such as: - Time band 1 is adjacent to time band 2 - Time band 1 is in time zone 1. - Time zone 1 is adjacent to time zone 2. - Time zone 1 is not adjacent to time zone 3

name: TIME_BAND_SCHEME
description: This entity defines a table for time banding, for example, MRA Table 1 for Maturity Method for Interest Rate Risk.

name: TIME_BAND_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes whether this is a band or a zone. Relevant for Interest Rate Risk – MRA Table 2.

name: TIME_ZONE
description: The time zone for particular locations around the world. Data may be simple or complex. Often, only an offset from Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) or Greenwich Mean Time (GMT) is recorded. Los Angeles' time zone would thus be shown as UTC-0800 (Coordinated Universal Time minus 8 hours). Honolulu, H

name: TIME_ZONE_AREA
description: A time zone is a region of Earth that has adopted the same standard time, usually referred to as the local time. Most adjacent time zones are exactly one hour apart.

name: TMY_DAY
description: A Typical Meteorological Year (TMY) attempts to provide a set of "typical" observation values for every day of the year, thereby factoring out extreme conditions.  A related method called "Rank and Average" (R&A) does something similar, with better retention of the extremes.  There are several well-

name: TMY_INTRADAY
description: This is the same as TMY, but allowing for smaller than daily intervals.

name: TOOTH_STATUS_TYPE
description: Identifies the various statuses that can be associated with a tooth.  Examples: - To be extracted - Impacted - Missing

name: TOOTH_SURFACE_TYPE
description: Identifies the surfaces of a tooth.  Examples: - Buccal - Distal - Facial - Incisal - Lingual - Mesial - Occlusal

name: TRADING_CAPACITY_TYPE
description: This is a code that indicates whether the transaction results from the executing firm carrying out matched principal trading, dealing on own account or another capacity. It is required for both trade orders and trade executions.  Possible values include: - DEAL = dealing on own account - MTCH = matc

name: TRADITIONAL_ORDER
description: This entity captures information regarding an order from a buyer (advertiser or ad agency) to an ad space seller (ad agency or publisher) indicating the buyer's desire to purchase space to display an advertisement on an off-line venue.  Examples: - Inside cover of Elle magazine for March 2009 - New

name: TRADITIONAL_PLACEMENT
description: The specifics of where an ad will be displayed in an offline venue.  Examples: - Totally Solar ad on Page 17 of March 2008 Wired Magazine - Garden Gnome ad on Page 78 of House and Gardens Magazine - Mattress Outfitters ad in March 30 LA Times final Home section inside back page 7

name: TRADITIONAL_PLACEMENT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity captures information regarding traditional ad placement types.  Examples: - Noninteractive TV - Billboard - Radio - Newspaper - Magazine

name: TRADITIONAL_REQUEST_PLACEMENT
description: This entity captures information regarding the specifics of where an ad order was requested to be displayed in a traditional venue. name: TRAILER_AD
description: This is a preview or a commercial for a title. The term "trailer" comes from their having originally been shown at the end of a feature film screening. Trailers are now shown before the title content begins.  Examples: - Video game - TV show - Book - Concert event - Movie

name: TRAIT
description: This entity defines a trait or characteristic of an object.  For example, SITE TRAIT could be square footage, number of floors, and number of entrances.

name: TRAIT_SUBTYPE
description: The classification of a trait by the major thing it describes such as sites. Used as a subtype discriminator.

name: TRAIT_TYPE
description: The classification of a trait.  Examples: - Measure of volume, such as square feet - Storage capacity - Quantity, such as number of employees - Monetary

name: TRANCHE
description: Within each securitization pool, there may be many "tranches" or subgroups. A tranche is a pool of money made up of principal and/or interest cash flows from the underlying assets. Each tranche may be composed of similar assets or loans that one can invest in. The tranche may also be composed of pri

name: TRANCHE_TYPE
description: A code for the classification of the tranche such as interest only tranche, principal only tranche, "Z" bond, targeted amortization class, or planned amortization class.

name: TRANSITIONAL_ARRANGEMENT_PARAMETER
description: This entity lists the capital floor adjustment to be used.  Reference Nov 2005 Accord paragraph 46

name: TRANSMISSION_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the transmission type into a description. Examples include manual, automatic, or semiautomatic.

name: TRANSMITTAL_MODE_TYPE
description: This entity identifies how an object was transmitted such as paper sent through the mail, EDI, or email.

name: TRAVEL_CLASS_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the class type of a travel event such as first class, business class, or coach.

name: TRAVEL_PLAN
description: This entity contains information about travel plans for customers. This information is used by the financial institution to verify that charges from different locations are valid.

name: TRAVEL_PLAN_CARD
description: These are the cards that will be used during the trip.

name: TRAVEL_PLAN_DESTINATION
description: This is the destination country or other geographical area during the trip.

name: TREASURY_BILL
description: A short-term debt obligation backed by the U.S. government with a maturity of less than one year. Treasury bills are sold in denominations of $1,000 up to a maximum purchase of $5 million and commonly have maturities of one month (four weeks), three months (13 weeks), or six months (26 weeks).

name: TREASURY_INFLATION_PROTECTED
description: A special type of Treasury note or bond that offers protection from inflation. The difference is that the coupon payments and underlying principal are automatically in

name: TREASURY_NOTE
description: A marketable U.S. government debt security with a fixed interest rate and a maturity between one and 10 years. Treasury notes can be bought either directly from the U.S. government or through a bank.

name: TREASURY_NOT_INFLATION_PROTECTED
description: A marketable, fixed interest U.S. government debt security with a maturity of more than 10 years. Treasury bonds make interest payments semiannually and the income that holders receive is only taxed at the federal level.

name: TRUST_ESTATE
description: Trust products involve one party establishing a fiduciary relationship with a second party, such that the second party manages property for the benefit of either the first party or others. Estate product is providing a trust service for planning and selling estates.

name: TV_AD

name: TV_RECEIVER_SETTING
description: Custom channel settings established by the TV receiver user.

name: TV_RECEIVER_SETTING_TYPE

name: TV_SIGNAL_RECEIVER
description: Cable or satellite receiver box used to receive cable or satellite audio/video signals.

name: TV_SIGNAL_RECEIVER_USAGE_INFORMATION

name: TV_SYSTEM_TYPE
description: This entity contains the types of TV broadcast systems.  Examples: - PAL - SECAM - NTSC

name: TWO_PERIOD_TEMPORAL_14.10
description: TWO_PERIOD_TEMPORAL_14.10 entity within the Other subject area.

name: UNDERWRITE_CLASS

name: UNIFIED_COVERAGE_CATEGORY

name: UNIT_COST_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the version of unit cost. In direct expense breakthrough, there can be multiple versions of unit cost depending on the calculation parameters such as standard costs, actual costs, and goal costs.  Examples: - Standard - Actual - Unit cost calculator

name: UNIT_DISTRIBUTION_TYPE

name: URL_CATEGORY

name: USER_SETTING_TYPE
description: This entity describes the various types of settings available to the user.

name: USER_SOURCE_INFORMATION
description: This entity captures string representations of a given user source (e.g., "internal," "external," or similar). This can in fact also be defined by any classification (measurement from a classifier) defined within the system.

name: USER_TYPE_INFORMATION

name: USPS_STATE_STANDARD

name: VENDOR
description: Vendor/Supplier information. Shared between purchasing and payables.  Vendor is considered a role that one party has with another party. The attributes about that vendor may vary by the related party.

name: VENDOR_PO

name: VENDOR_PO_COMMENT
description: This entity relates the VENDOR PO to any associated VENDOR PO COMMENT.

description: This entity indicates the predefined reason that two VENDOR PO LINEs are related, for example, replaced by, substituted for, and split in two.

name: VENDOR_PO_LINE_STATUS_ASSIGNMENT
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a vendor PO line over time.

name: VENDOR_PO_LINE_TERM
description: This entity identifies the terms and/or conditions that are associated with a VENDOR PO LINE.

name: VENDOR_PO_REASON

name: VENDOR_PO_RELATED
description: This entity allows one VENDOR PO to be related to another. For example, one VENDOR PO may replace another.

name: VENDOR_PO_RELATED_TYPE
description: This entity identifies how one VENDOR PO is related to another, such as replaced.

name: VENDOR_PO_STATUS
description: This entity contains VENDOR PO related status values, for example, open, approved, awaiting printing, canceled, closed, closed for invoice, closed for receiving, finally closed, frozen, in process, incomplete, not on hold, not reserved, on hold, open, preapproved, printed, rejected, requires reappro

name: VENDOR_PO_STATUS_ASSIGN
description: The entity tracks the various status or condition changes of a VENDOR PO over time.

name: VENDOR_PO_TERM
description: This entity identifies the terms and/or conditions that are associated with a VENDOR PO.

name: VENDOR_PO_TYPE
description: This entity distinguishes the various types of VENDOR POs, for example, regular, standing, blanket, and priority.

name: VENDOR_RECEIPT_LINE
description: This entity identifies information about a specific INTERNAL ASSET TYPE contained in a receipt from a VENDOR. It may relate to a specific VENDOR PO and include the receiving SITE, and the INTERNAL ASSET TYPE quantity.

name: VENDOR_RECEIPT_LINE_VENDOR_PO_LINE
description: This entity identifies the vendor receipt lines that have been received for a given vendor PO line. It records the actual quantity received out of the quantity ordered.

name: VENDOR_RETURN_PO_LINE
description: This entity identifies the outgoing RETURN LINEs that have been made against a VENDOR PO LINE.

name: VENDOR_TYPE
description: This entity contains one entry for each VENDOR TYPE defined within the ERP. Predefined VENDOR TYPEs include employee, public sector company, tax authority, and vendor.

name: VESSEL
description: This entity is a subtype to PARTY ASSET and describes boats and aircrafts.

name: VISION_CONDITION

description: The category of the vision condition.  Examples: - Spectacle lenses - Contact lenses - Spectacle frames

name: VISIT

name: VISIT_ACTION_TYPE
description: A classification of the visit based on the kind of action taken.  Examples: - Interest rate inquiry - Loan application - Loan product information - Refinance information request

name: VISIT_SUBTYPE
description: This entity classifies the type of visit regarding the channel visited.  Examples: - Web visit - Branch visit - Call center call

name: WARNING_ALERT
description: A type of ALERT EVENT such as below threshold test results or readings, geographical events (e.g., floods, and earthquakes) that require a response and a drop in production yield.

name: WATCH_LIST

name: WATCH_LIST_MEMBER
description: This entity contains all the members of a watch list.  The watch list contains members from various subjects including: - Agreement - Parties - Geographic areas

name: WATCH_LIST_SOURCE
description: This entity contains the sources of information used to create this watch list. The source could be from many internal systems. It could be from an externally provided watch list.

description: Weather almanac information is long-term statistics for a given day, where the extremes and averages across time are supported. description: This is an actual weather condition observed at a given time by a specific weather station. name: WEATHER_CONDITION_TYPE
description: This is an interpretive weather condition type that is represented by a code (and descriptive text), as opposed to an exact instrument measure.  Examples: - Showers - Clouds - Visibility - Winds

description: This is a prediction of a future weather observation or condition for a given time at a specific geographical area. name: WEATHER_MEASURE_TYPE
description: This is an exact instrument type of measure, as opposed to an interpretive weather condition.  Examples: - Temperature in degrees - Precipitation in inches/centimeters - Wind speed in km/h or mph - Wind direction in degrees

description: This is an actual weather observation captured, measured, or observed at a given time by a specific weather station. name: WORKSTATION_TERMINAL
description: This entity tracks all the workstation terminals that are related to potential sales or service channels such as the terminals at a branch or call center.

description: This minor entity describes the type of workstation such as teller terminal in the branch office and network PC in the call center.

name: WORK_PROCESS
description: This entity describes a standard workflow process such as approving or processing an insurance claim or a loan. The process is made up of steps. The process may result in the creation of projects where time and resources are assigned to tasks and deliverables are produced.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STATUS_TYPE
description: This describes the status of this work process such as in development, in production, or suspended.

description: This entity captures the actual steps that are involved in this process.  If you need to capture a history of estimated completion dates then you can create a separate dependent "date" entity to track the history.

description: This is a code used as a subtype discriminator to contain information about specific types of workflow processes such as the employment process.

name: WORK_PROCESS_STEP_STANDARD

name: ALERT_SETUP_NOTIFICATION_PARTY
description: This entity identifies the PARTYs to be alerted when an alert setup and its associated conditions are met. It also identified who to escalate unresolved ALERT EVENTs to and the timing for escalation.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_PARTY
description: This shows the roles that various parties might have with the analytical model such as creator, line of business owner, individual owner, or reviewer.

name: ANALYTICAL_MODEL_PARTY_ROLE
description: This is a code for the role that a party might have with an analytical model such as creator, line of business owner, individual owner, or reviewer.

name: CAMPAIGN_TARGET_CONTACT_LIST
description: This entity captures information regarding an association of a specific contact list and a campaign; multiple contact lists may be used for a given campaign.

name: CASE_PARTY
description: There may be many parties to the case such as the case manager, the case researcher(s), the party committing the fraud, the affected party, and attorneys.

name: CASE_PARTY_ROLE_TYPE
description: A code for the role that a party has with a case such as case manager, case researcher, party doing the fraud, party affected by the fraud, and attorney.

name: CELL_TARGET_CONTACT_LIST
description: An association of a specific contact list and a campaign cell. Multiple contact lists may be used for a given campaign cell.

name: CHANNEL_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: This entity relates demographic values to the financial institution channels. It keeps a history of demographic changes to the channels. name: CHANNEL_INSTANCE_LOCATOR_REASON
description: The code for the roles an address has with a channel instance.  Examples: - Used for parcel delivery - Mail address

name: CLAIM_IDENTIFICATION
description: This entity contains the identifiers for a claim.

name: CLAIM_LOCATOR_ROLE

name: CLAIM_SUBMITTING_PARTY
description: This is a subtype to PARTY CLAIM and contains those parties involved in submitting the claim.

description: This is a subtype to PARTY CLAIM and contains those parties that, other than the insured party, are parties who are the subject of the incident (damage or injury) causing the claim. description: This is the fourth digit of the Complementary Identification Code for Solvency II. It is a further classification of the asset. It is the fourth digit of a four-digit code. description: This is a code for exceptions to the country code for the Solvency II Complementary Identification Code. name: COMPLEMENTARY_IDENTIFICATION_CODE_SUBCATEGORY

name: CONTACT_ACTION
description: This entity captures information regarding actions generated during the contact.  Examples: - Promotional offer made to compensate the customer - A sale made due to an offer made to the customer - Account closing or opening

name: CONTACT_ACTION_SUBTYPE
description: This code captures information regarding the type of response made and is a subtype discriminator.

name: CONTACT_ACTION_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of action to be taken such as send out promotion material, open an account, or send out material.

name: CONTACT_EVENT
description: This is a subtype entity of EVENT and describes all events caused by having contact with the Financial Institution either of a personal nature where an employee talks to the customer, or an impersonal nature where the customer uses the ATM or automatic call center or any other touch point.
