description: This entity contains the offer(s) that were presented to the counterparty during this event and the response and action.

name: CONTACT_EVENT_SUBTYPE
description: This classifies the contact event as direct contact or self-service (indirect) and is used as a subtype discriminator.

description: This minor entity describes the type of follow-up related to a customer contact, for example, call back in one month and send out a sales rep.

name: CONTACT_FOLLOW-UP_TYPE
description: A code for the type of follow-up that is required such as call back, write letter, refer to supervisor, or no follow-up required.

description: Code that indicates the type of party that initiated the contact.  Examples: - Cus = customer - CS = customer service - SL = sales

name: CONTACT_INITIATOR_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes who initiated the event. Contact events can be initiated by a party or by the financial institution.

name: CONTACT_LEAD_SOURCE
description: This entity captures information regarding the contact lead source.  Examples: - Advertisement - Customer event - Employee referral - Google AdWords - Partner - Purchased list - Trade show - Webinar - Web site

description: A history of the roles (as specified by the attribute Campaign Party Role Cd) that a party plays in the creation and maintenance of a contact list.

name: CONTACT_LIST_SOURCE_TYPE
description: The source of a contact list.  Examples: - Competitor's customer listing - Third-party purchased mailing list - Government roll - Tax list

name: CONTACT_LIST_UPDATE
description: A history of the updates that are made to a contact list.

description: This entity describes the path that the customer took with the Voice Response Unit during a session. Each option selected is one instance in the entity. name: CREDIT_REPORTING_PARTY_SUBTYPE
description: This minor entity is a subtype discriminator to distinguish the type of party that is making the credit report such as a credit reporting agency or an internal party.

name: CUSTODIAN_BUSINESS_TYPE

name: CUSTOMER_INVESTMENT_AGREEMENT
description: This entity represents those agreements that are investment accounts where your customer is the holder of that account and you provide an investment service.

description: This minor entity describes the customer's tone when the contact was made such as happy or angry.

description: This entity contains those cases where the fraud is due to customer fraudulent activity.

description: This minor entity classifies the assets into categories such as automobile, jewelry, real estate, inventory, account receivables, equipment, animal, financial asset, and other asset. There is one instance for each asset type.

name: PARTY_ASSET_TITLE
description: The title assigned to this asset for this asset owner over time.

name: PARTY_ASSET_TITLE_TYPE
description: The type of title this asset is assigned.  Ownership title.  Further examples for motor vehicle: - Dismantled Title – The vehicle sustained major damage to one or more major component parts and the cost of repairing the vehicle for safe operation exceeds its fair market value. When a dismantled titl

name: PARTY_AUTHORIZATION_QUESTION
description: This entity contains the questions that can be used when confirming the identity of a party. Examples of questions are "mother's maiden name," "pet's name," "mother's birth month and day," "favorite teacher," and "favorite food."

name: PARTY_AUTHORIZATION_RESPONSE
description: This entity contains the response to the authorization question for this party.

name: PARTY_AUTOMOBILE_DRIVING_BEHAVIOR
description: This entity is details the driving behavior history of the combination of party and the associated automobile.  Attributes in this entity will vary from country to country and from financial institution to financial institution.  Note: To make this entity flexible add a "party driving history metric

name: PARTY_BANKRUPTCY
description: This entity tracks the occurrences of bankruptcy for a party along with the associated Chapter (American classification).

name: PARTY_BANK_IDENTIFICATION_NUMBER
description: This relates the Bank Identifier Number (BIN) to the issuing institution as an identifier for that institution. An institution can have many BIN numbers.  In this case the party is the institution and the issuing party is the ISO.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE
description: This entity represents a specific party that is used as a channel instance.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE_PREFERENCE
description: This entity identifies the preferred channel instance (e.g., phone or email address) for a given party. The protocol can also indicate whether the communication should be voice or text.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_INSTANCE_XREF
description: This associative entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a specific channel. Roles include houses, manages, and owns.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_PREFERENCE_SCORE
description: The channel preference score is a derived entity that identifies the channel type that is preferred by this party for this use. It is populated by a predictive modeling tool using other data in the model as input to the model.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason this party has this role with this channel.  For example, if the channel is a specific ATM then the reason could be "proximity" or "ease of use."

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_ROLE
description: The code for the various roles that a party may have with a channel such as houses, owns, manages, repairs, uses for marketing or sales purposes, prefers for usage, or prefers for communication.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_TYPE
description: This associative entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a channel type. Roles of a party with a channel include houses, owns, manages, repairs, uses for marketing or sales, prefers for usage, or prefers for communication.

name: PARTY_CHANNEL_TYPE_ACTIVITY_QUOTA
description: This entity contains the forecasts and actuals of various metrics for parties and channel types. For example, a business unit has a goal of reducing the number of branch visits for check deposits and increasing the number of ATM visits for that check deposits.

name: PARTY_CLAIM
description: This entity relates parties with claims and the roles that the party had with the claim. A party can have many roles with that claim, and a claim can involve many parties.  Examples: - Claiming party - Direct provider - Indirect provider - Submitting party - First party - Third party or injured part

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates a party involved with a claim with a claim amount. For example, this could be the fee charged by the lawyer who worked on the claim, or this could be the total paid by a third party associated with the claim.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION
description: This associative entity links parties to claim authorizations. Examples are the party that requested the authorization, the party that approved the authorization, and the party that withdrew the authorization from the party that the authorization is for.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_IDENTIFICATION
description: This entity identifies the party's identification(s) that were submitted on a claim authorization. More than one identification can be submitted for a party on a claim authorization. These identifications can be compared with previously acquired PARTY IDENTIFICATIONs that may have been obtained from

name: PARTY_CLAIM_AUTHORIZATION_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity converts the party claim authorization role code into a description.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_EXPOSURE
description: This entity identifies the various parties that may be involved with a claim exposure such as adjuster, business unit owner, or claim owner.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity associates the party to the claim with the thing being insured (insurable interest).

name: PARTY_CLAIM_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity contains the roles that a party plays with a claim or a claim service, such as claimant, injured, facility, or in the case of health care, the billing provider, attending provider, referring provider, supervising provider, and rendering provider.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE
description: This entity relates parties with claims services and the roles that the party had with the claim service. A party can have many roles with that claim service, and a claim can involve many parties.

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE_AMOUNT
description: This entity associates a party involved with a claim service with a claim service amount. Examples can include the laboratory that billed a lab fee on the claim, or it can be the number of inpatient visits associated with the patient, or it can be the amount billed by a specific doctor for the claim

name: PARTY_CLAIM_SERVICE_DIAGNOSIS_AMOUNT
description: This entity contains metrics for claim, service (procedure), party, and diagnosis combination. For example, for a bodily injury claim, the injury/diagnosis might be hairline fracture, the service might be sling fitting, and the metric could be the amount charged by the provider.

name: PARTY_CLASSIFICATION_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are classifications of parties. There is one instance for each party classification, such as males over 50 years.

name: PARTY_CLASS_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity contains the risk grade for a given classification of parties for a given period of time. Examples of classifications include large business, small business, sovereign, and individual.

name: PARTY_CLASS_SCHEME_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the schemes for classifying parties. Examples of schemes include legal tax purposes, Basel II risk purposes, and marketing purposes.

name: PARTY_CLASS_VALUE
description: For a given classification scheme these value codes represent the various values for a given classification scheme. For example, if the classification scheme is for Basel II risk purposes then the possible values could be sovereign, central bank, bank, corporate, municipality, small business, and in

name: PARTY_COST
description: This entity describes the types of costs that a party incurs that are used when calculating profitability. These are costs allocated to parties that cannot be derived from the event or agreement levels. These costs are usually allocated as indirect costs such as the cost for administrative functions

name: PARTY_CREDIT_INQUIRY
description: This entity contains the credit inquiry information for this obligor party for this date as requested by one lender.  Usually, there is one inquiry for each lending party many times triggered by an application for a loan or credit card with that institution.

name: PARTY_CREDIT_INQUIRY_SUMMARY
description: This entity tracks credit inquiry counts as reported by credit bureaus for the party being queried.

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT
description: This entity represents the running of a credit report by a third party for a party usually an obligor.  This entity contains the credit rating for this party for this date. It is related to party rather than customer to allow for ratings at the household level where a household is also a type of par

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT_COMMENT
description: This entity contains a summary of comment types about this obligor from this reporting party for this credit report and the impact to the score.  Examples of comments are: - 2 = level of delinquency on accounts - 18 = number of accounts with delinquency - 24 = no recent revolving balances - 11 = amo

name: PARTY_CREDIT_REPORT_SCORE
description: This entity contains the value of the score as reported by the score provider on an external credit report. It allows one credit report to have many scores such as FICO score and bankruptcy score.

name: PARTY_CURRENCY
description: This entity identifies the currency associated with a party. For example, stock markets may trade in a given currency that might be different from the country it resides. In Europe, the stock markets moved to the Euro before the countries did.

name: PARTY_CURRENCY_ROLE_TYPE
description: A code for the type of role the currency has with a party. For example, if the party is a stock exchange then the currency is the reporting currency.

name: PARTY_DEFAULT_RECOVERY_ROLE
description: This is the role that this party plays with the amount that was recovered such as the repossession agency, the auctioneer, the insurance agent, or the investigator.

name: PARTY_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: Provides the relationship of a PARTY to a specific DEMOGRAPHIC VALUE.  Examples: - INDIVIDUAL: Rachel has an income of $120,000 - HOUSEHOLD: The Smiths have five children. - ORGANIZATION: Acme Gifts has annual sales revenue of $4M.

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates a party with the document. The party may be the originator or recipient of the document. The party may be the auditor, notary, agent, customer, and other financial institution.

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT_LOCATOR
description: This entity identifies where documents are sent for those parties that have some involvement with the document and where the party is a recipient of the document. For example, a party (who is the payor) received a statement (a type of document), at an address (locator). Instances of this entity coul

name: PARTY_DOCUMENT_ROLE_TYPE
description: This entity translates the Party Document Role Cd into a description.  Examples of roles of parties to interchange document are: - Owner - Notary - Auditor - Beneficiary - Reporting - Reported - For information only - Payer

name: PARTY_DRIVING_HISTORY
description: This entity records driving history for a party regardless of the vehicle. The attributes will change depending on the source of information.  Note: To make this entity flexible add a "party driving history metric code" to the primary key and make the non-key attributes counts and amounts in additio

name: PARTY_DRIVING_LICENSE
description: This is a subtype to PARTY IDENTIFICATION. This entity consists of the external identification that is a driving license.

name: PARTY_DRIVING_LICENSE_ISSUANCE
description: This associative entity specifies at what date the individual obtained his/her first driving license for the associated type of vehicle, such as passenger car, motorcycle, lorry, and bus.

name: PARTY_EXTERNAL_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores that are calculated outside the enterprise such as the FICO score from Fair Isaac.  Either this entity or entity PARTY CREDIT REPORT can be used for externally provided credit scores.

name: PARTY_FEATURE
description: This associative entity defines the relationship that parties have with product features. For example, relationships include the parties that service the affiliated services associated with the credit card account such as travel insurance or rental car insurance.

name: PARTY_FEATURE_ROLE_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the various roles that a party has with a product feature such as services or offers.

name: PARTY_FINANCIAL_DOCUMENT
description: This entity associates a party (business or individual) with their financial information. The information is used by the financial institution to evaluate the loan applications, to perform loan reviews, and to do risk management analysis. When examiners review a bank's loan portfolio, it usually inv

name: PARTY_FINANCIAL_DOCUMENT_ITEM
description: This entity describes the type of items and their value amount that a party reported to the financial institution for the specified financial document type.

name: PARTY_GOAL
description: This is the party that is related to the goal. The party could be the one that set the goal or could be the party that is affected by the goal.

name: PARTY_GRIEVANCE
description: This associative entity defines the parties related to this grievance. Examples include witness, advocate, union steward, mediator, arbiter, governing body, lawyer, union representative, or management representative.

name: PARTY_GRIEVANCE_ROLE
description: This minor entity defines the various roles that parties have with the grievance. Examples include grievant, witness, advocate, union steward, mediator, arbiter, governing body, lawyer, union representative, or management representative.

name: PARTY_GROUP
description: This entity identifies artificial groupings of parties not including households. Examples are all businesses that have anything to do with golf or all stamp collector clubs. They share some common characteristics. This entity would also include marketing clusters created to identify common character

name: PARTY_GROUP_DEMOGRAPHIC
description: This entity tracks demographics about groups of parties where the grouping was created by the enterprise for analysis purposes.

name: PARTY_GROUP_LIMIT
description: This entity contains information about limits at the party group level such as credit limit.

name: PARTY_GROUP_METRIC
description: This entity contains metrics for a grouping of parties. For example, when calculating risk, parties of similar characteristics may be grouped and then the risk is measured for that group.

name: PARTY_GROUP_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason this grouping of parties was created such as for risk management, for Basel II, or for marketing analysis.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RELATED
description: This entity relates one group of parties to another group of parties for any reason. This structure allows a group to be in more than one parent group and those parent groups to also be in more than one parent group. This structure can handle multiple hierarchies and network structures.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RELATED_REASON
description: This is the reason why a group of parties is related to another group of parties such as for risk analysis purposes, for marketing purposes, or for financial analysis purposes.

name: PARTY_GROUP_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity represents the risk grade assignment for a given grouping of parties for a given period of time.  This can be an externally acquired list of an internally generated list of parties. One use could be for anti-money laundering.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores related to a group of parties. An example of a party group would be all individuals that are more than 90 days past due on a loan and at high risk of not paying.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SELECT_CRITERION
description: This entity identifies the selection criterion that can be used to group parties together, such as age <30 or income >50,000.

name: PARTY_GROUP_SUBJECT
description: This entity contains those subjects that are groups of parties. There is one instance for each grouping such as airline companies.

name: PARTY_HOLIDAY_CALENDAR
description: In capital markets, holiday calendars can be tied to security exchanges. This is used when determining next business day. The holiday calendar may not be the same as the country holiday calendar.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION
description: The numbers that may be assigned to a party for identification purposes, as specified by PARTY IDENTIFICATION TYPE.  Examples: - Social Security number - Passport identification - Driver license - Federal Tax Identification Number - National Identity Card Number  In the case of internal identificati

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_CATEGORY
description: This is a high-level categorization of party identification type.  Examples: - Personal identification - Internal identification - Professional identification

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_DOCUMENT
description: This identifies the documents that were used to validate the information, and which are stored in the enterprise. Such proof could be documents such as drivers license or birth certificate.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_EVENT
description: This entity tracks activities related to creating, validating, processing, reviewing, and disabling an identifier such as the Legal Entity Identifier. The activity code is in the EVENT entity.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_LOCATOR
description: This entity relates party identifications to locators (i.e., addresses) and tracks changes over time. A party identification can have many addresses and an address can be used by many party identifications.  Example: - A party's passport issuing location and how it can be used at that location are t

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_LOCATOR_USAGE_TYPE
description: This entity describes the way a locator (e.g., country or address) is used for party identification purposes.  Example: - A party's passport that was issued by country A is valid in country B. "Valid in" is the value for the type of usage.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_ROLE
description: This entity specifies the role the identification has for the party and the related item that has the identification (e.g., the claim, claim authorization, or the COB adjudication).  Examples are: - Primary - Secondary - Tertiary - Requested - Submitted - Withdrawn

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS
description: This entity tracks the status and status date of assigning the identifier to the party such as requested, not active, active, disabled.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_STATUS_TYPE
description: This describes the codes for the status of assigning an identifier to a party such as requested, in review, active, and disabled.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE
description: The types of party identification that is internally issued or externally obtained by the financial institution.  Example for individuals: - Social Security number - Passport identification - Driver license  Examples for organizations: - Federal Tax Identification Number - CAGE Code (U.S. Commercial

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one type of party identification to another type of identification such as in lieu of a Legal Entity Identifier an Employer Identification Number can be used, or in lieu of a driver license, a passport can be used.

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_TYPE_RELATED_REASON
description: This is a code for the reason one party identification type is related to another party identification type such as one can be used in lieu of another. For example, in lieu of a legal entity identifier an employer identification number can be used. Alternatively, in lieu of a driver license a passpo

name: PARTY_IDENTIFICATION_VALIDATION
description: This entity keeps track of party identification validations and the date planned for the next validation. The result of each validation is also tracked. If the validation fails then that could affect the status. This supports Legal Entity Identifier and Know Your Customer.

name: PARTY_INFORMATION_DOCUMENT
description: This identifies the documents used to prove and support the information provided by the party. These documents would be stored in the enterprise.

name: PARTY_INFORMATION_VALIDATION
description: This entity tracks when certain type of information was validated for a party. This can include such information as validating the residence address, validating income, validating employment, and validating length at current location.

name: PARTY_INSURABLE_INTEREST
description: This entity contains those insurable interests that are a person's life or a person's performance.

name: PARTY_INSURABLE_INTEREST_EVENT
description: This entity contains those events that are related to claims for each party for a given insurable interest.  An example of an event is a claim payment to a claimant or a payment to a provider. The role code describes the role of the party as the claimant or the provider.

name: PARTY_INSURANCE_RISK_CATEGORY
description: The association of a risk category to a party.

name: PARTY_INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR
description: This entity associates parties with their habits, conditions, or activities that are considered risk factors.

name: PARTY_INVESTMENT_OBJECTIVE
description: This entity contains the investment objectives of this party such as capital appreciation or steady income.

name: PARTY_INVESTMENT_RISK_TOLERANCE
description: This entity keeps track of how tolerant someone is to risk of losing money when it comes to investment decisions such as: - Aggressive/speculative - Moderate - Conservative - Very conservative

name: PARTY_LANGUAGE_PROFICIENCY
description: The degree of proficiency this party has for this language. The degree is expressed as a number on a scale with the highest being the most proficient.

name: PARTY_LANGUAGE_USAGE
description: This entity relates languages to parties and tracks changes over time. A party can be addressed using many languages and a language can be used by many parties.

name: PARTY_LEGAL_ACTION
description: This entity contains the various parties to the legal action and their role.  Examples: - Your organization – filed the law suit - Your organization – recipient of law suit - Your insured –- the injured party in a subrogation suit - Responsible party – the party being sued

name: PARTY_LIABILITY
description: This associative entity relates party to liabilities where the liabilities are from the customer's perspective. A party can have many liabilities, and a liability can be held by many parties. An example of a liability could be a loan on a car, or a specific credit card. There is one instance for eac

name: PARTY_LIABILITY_CREDIT_RATING
description: This entity contains a history of credit reports for a specific party liability.

name: PARTY_LIFECYCLE
description: This entity tracks the lifecycle changes to a party over time.  Examples of lifecycles include for a business inactive, just formed and not operational, fully operational, closed and not operational, and fully active. For an individual it might be child, high school, college, young single, young mar

name: PARTY_LIMIT
description: This entity contains information about limits at the party level such as credit limit. A credit limit at the party (customer) level may not be the sum of related account limits and is usually less than the sum.

name: PARTY_LOCATOR
description: This entity relates PARTYs to LOCATORs and tracks changes over time. A PARTY can have many street addresses, telephone numbers, and email addresses. The Locator Usage Type Cd will identify how each LOCATOR is used by the PARTY.  For example, this entity may represent all forms of party locators such

name: PARTY_MARKET_IDENTIFIER_CODE
description: For parties that are securities exchanges, trading platforms, or other trade reporting facilities, this is the ISO 10383 standard market identifier.

name: PARTY_METRIC
description: This entity tracks the party metrics over time.

name: PARTY_METRIC_PROJECTION
description: This entity contains a projection of metrics for a given party.

name: PARTY_METRIC_TYPE
description: This is a code for the type of party metric.  Examples: - Party exposure amount - Party outstanding amount - Party total guarantee amount

name: PARTY_OBJECTIVE
description: This is an associative entity between OBJECTIVE and PARTY. It identifies the objectives assigned to a party, which could be an individual or an organization.

name: PARTY_OPPORTUNITY_ROLE_TYPE
description: A code for the role that this party plays with this opportunity such as: - Prospect decision maker - Enterprise decision maker - Competitor - Influencer - Sales rep - Prospect - Referral - Partner - Agent - Broker  A party could play multiple roles.

name: PARTY_PARTY_CLASS_XREF
description: This entity relates a PARTY CLASS VALUE with a PARTY. A PARTY can be classified many ways.  This entity contains the various descriptive classifications for parties. For example, for risk (scheme) this could include whether the party is a person, business, household, internal organization, your ente

name: PARTY_PLAN_ROLE
description: This is the role that a party has in the planning process such as the one that set the goals or the one that is affected by the goals.

name: PARTY_PORTFOLIO
description: This entity associates PARTY with PORTFOLIO. A party may manage zero, one or more portfolios. A portfolio may be managed by zero, one or more parties.

name: PARTY_PORTFOLIO_ROLE_TYPE
description: This is a code for the reason a party is related to a portfolio.  Examples: - Party supervises portfolio - Party manages portfolio

name: PARTY_PRIVACY_PREFERENCE
description: This entity contains a party's privacy preferences for the collection and use of personal data.  For example, Mary Jones permits direct marketing to a specific address but not to any of her telephone numbers and does permit release of certain types of personal information.  It is expected that only

name: PARTY_PRODUCT_FUNCTION
description: This associative entity describes the function that a party has with a different product for a given role. For example, if the role is "develops" then the functions could be "identifies market," "conducts survey," "prices product," or "creates marketing material."

name: PARTY_PRODUCT_GROUP_QUOTA
description: This entity contains sales quotas that a party has for a given time period for a given product group.

name: PARTY_PRODUCT_QUOTA
description: This entity contains quotas that a party has for a given time period for a given product.

name: PARTY_PRODUCT_SCORE
description: This derived entity keeps track of changes to scores, which predict the likelihood of a party to order a new product or service. There is one instance for each party product score date combination. The score uses other data in the model to derive the score.

name: PARTY_PROFIT
description: This entity identifies the profitability of parties. This will be a derived entity when the model is populated with all the cost and revenue components.

name: PARTY_PROJECT_ROLE
description: The entity that indicates the role of a PARTY associated with a project. Examples of roles could be project manager, project sponsor, or project consultant.

name: PARTY_PROJECT_TASK_ROLE
description: The entity that indicates the role of an individual on a project.

name: PARTY_PUBLIC_RECORD
description: A report of the kinds of public records the credit bureau has received such as reports of bankruptcy, liens, and judgments filed against this party along with the count, and last filing date and status.

name: PARTY_QUOTA
description: This entity contains sales quotas that a party has for a given time period regardless of product such as number of new customers.

name: PARTY_QUOTATION
description: This associative entity defines the relationship that this quotation has with parties. For example, relationships include the party that receives the quotation, the party that provided the quotation, and the party that authorized the quotation.

name: PARTY_QUOTATION_ROLE
description: This entity describes the role that a party has with a quotation such as requestor and supplier.

name: PARTY_RELATED
description: This entity defines the relationships between parties – individual and individual; individual and organization; organization and organization; individual and household and household and household relationships. A party can be part of many relationships. A party can have many types of relationships w

name: PARTY_RELATED_FUNCTION
description: This entity describes the functions that a party performs within the specified party-to-party relationship role. For example, within the employer employee party relationship role this employee can perform claim-processing function.

name: PARTY_RELATED_FUNCTION_GEOGRAPHIC_AREA
description: This entity describes the functions that a party performs within the specified party-to-party relationship role within a specific geographic area. For example, within the employer-employee party relationship role this employee can perform claim-processing function in northwest region.

name: PARTY_RELATED_METRIC
description: This entity contains the various metrics associated with party relationships such as percent ownership, invested capital amount, voting right percent, and percent of business dealing.

name: PARTY_RELATED_ROLE
description: Indicates the relationship of one party to another party. This role code can represent both sides of the relationship.  Examples: - Manager-employee - Employer-employee - Vendor to the enterprise - Customer service provider to the enterprise - Account executive for the enterprise - Father-son - Hous

name: PARTY_RELATED_STATUS_REASON
description: A reason why a particular Party Related Status Type Cd may be assigned to a party relationship.  For example, the reason for 'unmarketable' status may be 'deceased' or the reason for 'inactive' status may be 'out of the county.'

name: PARTY_RELATED_STATUS_TYPE
description: The domain of classifications tracked to the relationship role for a party.  Examples: - Active - Inactive - Prospective - Unmarketable customer (i.e., deceased).

name: PARTY_RELATED_SUBTYPE
description: A subtype discriminator for PARTY RELATED.  For financial services the FSDM is subtyped into business ownership (party 1 owns x% of party 2), vendor (party 1 is a vendor of party 2) and insurer-insured (party 1 insures party 2).

name: PARTY_RELATIONSHIP_COST
description: This is a child entity of PARTY RELATED.  This entity contains cost made by the party because of its relation with the related party, in the two following cases: - The Party Structure Type Cd in PARTY RELATED indicates a relation between two internal organizations. - The Party Related Role Cd in PAR

name: PARTY_REVENUE
description: This entity contains the direct and indirect revenue allocated to a party. A party can be an individual or organization.

name: PARTY_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity represents the risk grade assignment for a given party for a given period of time.

name: PARTY_RISK_GRADE_RELATED
description: This entity relates one risk grade assessment to another risk grade assessment to identify when one risk assessment replaces or overrides another risk assessment for a party. Risk assessments done by different methods or parties can result in different assessments.  This structure allows for one ass

name: PARTY_RISK_GRADE_ROLE
description: This is a code for the role that a party has in the assignment of a rating to a party or agreement such as the rating officer or the reviewing officer.

name: PARTY_ROLE_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This is a code for why one party role is related to another party role such as "belongs to," "is part of," and "consists of." These roles can be used to derive a hierarchical structure between roles.

name: PARTY_ROLE_TO_PARTY_ROLE
description: This entity relates one party role to another party role. This entity can accommodate a network or hierarchical structure. For example, if one role at a high-level is approval authority then lower level roles could be signature authority and power of attorney. This structure creates the relationship

name: PARTY_ROUTING_TRANSIT_NUMBER
description: This entity associates a financial institution with a routing transit number along with the date assigned and by whom. This allows a financial institution to have more than one routing transit number such as due to mergers and acquisitions.

name: PARTY_SALES_ACTIVITY_ROLE
description: This entity captures information regarding the role that this party plays with this sales activity.  Examples: - Assigned owner - Creator - Sales rep - Prospect - Referral - Partner - Agent  Note: A party could play multiple roles.

name: PARTY_SANCTION
description: A history of sanctions for the parties such as prohibited from practicing medicine.

name: PARTY_SCORE
description: A relative value, or 'score' produced by an ANALYTICAL MODEL after reviewing business information. This can provide a measure or way to group and treat PARTYs that the business interacts with.  Example: - Parties can be 'scored' for profitability, frequency of purchases, and propensity to buy. Vendo

name: PARTY_SCORE_RELATED
description: This entity contains information about one score related to another score for a party. For example, if one way of determining probability of default overrides another way for this specific party, then this shows those scores that were overridden and why.

name: PARTY_SCRIPT
description: This is a derived entity that is required for the call center Integration. It identifies the script that should be used to sell this product to this party using this channel. This entity is populated using a predictive modeling tool that uses other data in the model to derive this entity.

name: PARTY_SEGMENT
description: An associative entity that maps a party into a market segment. A party can be a member of multiple market segments, and vice versa.

name: PARTY_SEGMENT_SCORE
description: This entity contains scores (e.g., probability of default) for this party segment. A party segment is created as the result of an internal segmentation scheme.

name: PARTY_SOLICITATION_PREFERENCE
description: This entity describes the days and time periods when it is best to contact this party via a specific channel type. For example, the party may prefer to be contacted by phone only during certain time periods of certain days, or may prefer no solicitations by phone at all. These preferences may have o

name: PARTY_SPECIALTY
description: This associative entity relates parties with their specialties, such as mechanic, and surgeon.

name: PARTY_STATUS
description: This entity contains the history of the status of the party.

name: PARTY_STATUS_REASON_TYPE
description: The reason for the change in party status such as opened first account, closed last account, and avoid doing business due to fraud.

description: The entity that indicates the type of currency translation.  Possible examples may be: - Minimum bid rate - Minimum ask rate - Average bid rate - Average ask rate - Maximum bid rate - Maximum ask rate

description: This is a cross-reference mapping custom weeks to the month(s) they fall in.

name: CUSTOM_CALENDAR_QUARTER
description: Defines the quarters belonging to a custom calendar. In the context of finance, it is a fiscal quarter, for example, "Q1 Fiscal 2005."

description: Defines the weeks belonging to a custom calendar. In the context of finance, it is a fiscal week, for example, "Fiscal Week 5, 2005."

description: This is a code for the role that a currency has with a geographical area such as the primary currency or the currency that the country's currency is pegged to.

description: This entity identifies a calendar that is used to determine business days. This is used in capital markets when determining next business day. It is not necessarily tied to a geographic area. Some holiday schedules are tied to security exchanges.

name: HOLIDAY_CALENDAR_DATE
description: This entity contains dates that are considered holidays and weekends. This is used in capital markets when determining next business day. It is not necessarily tied to a geographic area. Some holiday schedules are tied to security exchanges.

name: INSURABLE_INTEREST_EXPOSURE_TYPE
description: A code for the characteristic of the insurable interest that affects the exposure. For example, if the insurable interest is a car then "car years" affects the exposure.

name: INSURABLE_INTEREST_TO_EXPOSURE_TYPE
description: This entity allows an insurable interest to have many types of exposures. For example, if the insurable interest is a car then exposure types could be "car years" and "car model."

name: INSURANCE_RISK_CATEGORY
description: This minor entity translates the risk category codes into a description.  Examples of risk categories: - Low - Medium - High - Preferred - Nonpreferred

name: INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR_RELATED
description: Identifies the risk factor that has a common relationship to another risk factor for the purpose of providing an enhanced understanding of the compounding impact risk factors have on a party.

name: INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR_RELATIONSHIP_TYPE
description: This minor entity identifies the relationship between two risk factors such as caused or is part of.

name: INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR_RISK_CATEGORY
description: This is an associative entity that links the risk factors with the risk categories.

name: INSURANCE_RISK_FACTOR_TYPE
description: Habits, conditions, or activities that may increase the likelihood of a loss or injury.  Examples: - 1 = smoker - 2 = skydiver - 3 = astronaut - 4 = diabetic - 5 = airbags - 6 = sprinkler system

name: INSURANCE_RISK_UNDERWRITE_CLASS
description: This entity associates risk factors to underwriting classes.

name: INTEREST_INDEX_RISK_FACTOR
description: This entity contains risk factors that can affect the value of interest index rates.

name: INTEREST_RATE_CAPITAL_PARAMETER
description: When calculating interest rate risk using the standardized approach, the capital charge is a function of the type of instrument: - Government issued paper - Qualifying – issued by public sector and multilateral development banks and others with a certain investment grade - Refer to the Market Risk A

description: This entity contains interest rate market risk metrics for each financial instrument that is part of an agreement that has market risk. name: INVESTMENT_RISK_TOLERANCE_TYPE
description: A classification of how tolerant someone is to risk of losing money when it comes to investment decisions such as: - Aggressive/speculative - Moderate - Conservative - Very conservative

name: INVESTMENT_SECURITY_RISK_GRADE
description: Financial instruments are also graded by third parties such as Standard & Poor's.  For example, if the agency (method) is Standard & Poor's then the Risk Grade Id would represent the assessment value such as AAA to AA-, A+ to A-, BBB+ to BBB-, BB+ to B-, Below B-, and Unrated.

name: LOCATION_OF_LOSS_TYPE
description: This classifies the loss as either on premises or off premises.

description: This entity is a subtype of RISK GRADE VALUE. description: This is the Market Risk Amendment Tables 4 and 5, which show for a given group of products (e.g., government debt security) whether there is a specific risk charge and the method for general market risk charge (e.g., charge as two positions or as one position in each currency).

name: MARKET_RISK_HORIZONTAL_DISALLOWANCE_CALCULATION
description: This entity contains the horizontal disallowance that is calculated within and between banding zones when calculating interest rate market risk using the standardized approach.

name: MARKET_RISK_NATIONAL_MARKET_GROUP
description: This entity contains those investments in financial instruments such as equities (e.g., stock) that are grouped according to the national market the instrument belongs for general market risk calculation purposes. For example, all equities for corporations in India may be grouped together.

name: MARKET_RISK_TYPE
description: The classification of market risk this banking agreement is exposed to.  Examples: - Equity market price fluctuations - Interest rate price fluctuations - Foreign exchange price fluctuations - Commodity market risk - No market risk exposure

name: MORTALITY_TABLE_RISK_FACTOR
description: This entity associates the mortality table with any risk factors that were considered when determining the mortality statistics in the mortality table. Risk factors can include smoking.

name: NETTED_MARKET_RISK_GROUP
description: This entity contains those agreements/deals that are grouped together for the purpose of netting when calculating market risk. name: NETTED_MARKET_RISK_GROUP_TYPE
description: This minor entity describes the type of grouping of instruments when calculating market risk.  Examples: - Interest rate risk grouping based on time band and netted - Commodity risk grouping based on time band and commodity (time band scheme) and netted matched long and short - Commodity risk group

name: NETTING_POOL
description: This is a type of pool created for netting purposes.

name: NON-IRB_EXPOSURE_SUMMARY
description: This summary entity tracks exposure amounts related to credit portfolios that are subject to the standardized approach or the supervisory risk weight calculation in the IRB approaches. It is intended to support Table 5 reporting in the Basel Accord, and Pillar 3 (market disclosure).

name: NONRETAIL_RISK_ASSESSMENT_SUMMARY
description: This entity tracks risk parameters (e.g., PD, LGD) and exposure values over time for the nonretail portfolios of a bank or subsidiary. It is intended to support Basel II market disclosure requirements (Pillar 3), particularly Table 6.

name: OPERATIONAL_LOSS_TYPE
description: This entity classifies the possible types of operational losses that can be used to measure operational risk. See Basel II Operational Risk Consultative document Annex 4. description: The measure from which operational risk is based for Basel II Operational Risk Standardized Approach and Internal Measurement Approach. name: OPPORTUNITY_RISK_GRADE
description: This entity tracks the risk of this opportunity over time.

name: PORTFOLIO_VALUE_AT_RISK
description: This entity contains the calculated Value at Risk (VAR) for a group or portfolio of investment holdings. name: PROBABILITY_DEFAULT_FLOOR_TYPE
description: This will identify which probability of default floor should be applied such as: - Floor of 0% - Floor of 0.03%.

name: PROBABILITY_OF_DEFAULT_MODEL
description: A probability of default model is a type of analytical model where the purpose is to predict the likelihood that a party will default on an agreement.

name: PROVISION_TYPE
description: A code describing whether this is for a general or specific provision.

name: PURCHASED_RECEIVABLE_POOL_RISK
description: This entity tracks risk related metrics for pools of purchased receivable client agreements over time.

name: RETAIL_RISK_ASSESSMENT_SUMMARY
description: This entity tracks risk parameters (e.g., PD, and LGD) and exposure values over time for the retail portfolios of a bank or subsidiary by retail pool. It is intended to support Basel II market disclosure requirements (Pillar 3), particularly Table 6.

name: RISK_ADJUSTMENT_METRIC_TYPE
description: A code that identifies the types of metrics that are used in the calculation of the adjustment.  Examples: - Haircut rate - Holding period days used in haircut calculation - Calculated haircut amount

name: RISK_ADJUSTMENT_REASON_TYPE
description: A code for the reason for the adjustment such as Basel II Haircut Calculation. name: RISK_ASSESS_OVERRIDE_TYPE
description: This entity contains the reason why one risk assessment overrides another risk grade assessment, for example, human judgment overrides automated model.

name: RISK_CALCULATION_SCENARIO
description: This entity contains information about the execution of the calculation of risk metrics. name: RISK_GRADE_RELATION_TYPE
description: A code that explains the relationship between two risk grades such as "has precedence over" or "is equivalent to."

description: This entity contains the grading schemes when assigning a risk grade to a subject. One scheme exists for each method and purpose combination. description: This entity contains the values for the various risk grades or ratings. These values are expressed as a range or grading versus a continuous number. description: This entity tracks the risk grade for a roadway segment and also allows a roadway segment to have different ratings at the same time.

description: This entity contains parameters for Basel II risk calculation purposes based on seniority level.

description: This entity contains information specific to the calculation scenarios for stress testing including the time period being tested.

name: STRESS_TEST_RESULT
description: This entity contains the result of a stress test such as the loss amount for a given risk factor or the high and low extreme amounts for this time period.

name: STRESS_TEST_TYPE
description: This minor entity classifies the type of stress test as either:  Examples: - Supervisory scenario requiring no simulation by the bank - Scenario requiring simulation by the bank - Scenario developed by the bank

name: TRANCHE_RISK_METRIC
description: This entity tracks risk related metrics for a securitization tranche over time.

name: VALUE_AT_RISK_BACKTEST_PARAMETER
description: This entity tracks the Value at Risk (VAR) for a sample of counterparties over time.  Reference paragraph 180 in June 2004 Accord.

description: This entity contains the multiplier factor to scale up the VAR (Value at Risk) model back test output exceptions.  Reference paragraph 180 in June 2004 Accord. name: WATCH_LIST_RISK_TYPE
description: A classification of whether this list includes subjects of high risk or subjects that are trustworthy.

name: YIELD_CURVE_MATURITY_RISK_FACTOR
description: This is the risk factor associated with the yield curve maturity segment when calculating market risk for interest rates using the internal model's approach.

name: BROWSER_APPLICATION_TYPE
description: This entity represents the web browser application being used.  Examples: - Internet Explorer - Firefox - Safari - AOL - Playstation - iPhone - Xbox

description: This entity provides a cross-reference of a visitors browser to its plug-ins.

name: BROWSER_VERSION
description: This is the version of web browser application a being used.  Examples: - Internet Explorer 7.0 - Safari 3.1 - Firefox 2.0

description: This is a code for the page action such as paging click, scrolling click, submit click, cancel click. The enterprise will have defined codes for the various actions a user might take with a click on their web site.

name: CLICK_ACTIVITY
description: This entity captures clickmap information; it is the information contained in the address of the link the user clicked on (URL/JS function).

name: CLICK_CONTEXT_TYPE
description: This entity indicates whether the page name or URL was used for the click activity (such as submitting information, requesting information, or moving around the page).

name: COOKIE
description: This entity captures user cookie information. It contains the content of cookies for all cookie types.

name: CRAWLER
description: This entity contains a list of crawler sites that have visited the web site of the business entity. A crawler is a program search engine that takes information from a web site.

name: CRAWLER_PERMISSION_TYPE
description: This is a code used to specify the type of permission that a crawler is allowed when accessing a web site or web page.

name: CRAWLER_WEB_PAGE_PERMISSION
description: This entity contains the access rights granted to a crawler for a specified web page.

name: CRAWLER_WEB_SITE_PERMISSION

description: This entity captures information about the software being utilized by the web server.  Examples: - Apache - IIS

name: WEB_SERVER_STATUS
description: This entity contains information regarding the status of the web server utilized by the enterprise.

name: WEB_SESSION_COOKIE
